english: The banners etc., the crows, lions, elephants and goats are excellent. The others are auspicious. Among the primary notes of Indian gamut, the first one, second one and the fifth one confer good.

sanskrit: bhūteṣu ca śubhā bhūḥ syādagniṣvāhavanīyakaḥ / uktāyāmasya cārdhāṃśe nāgāṃśair bhājite kramāt // rasabhūtāṃśaṣaṣṭhāṃśatryaṃśādhikaśarair bhavet /
english: Among the elements, the earth is auspicious. Among the fires, the consecrated fire from the household’s perpetual fire is auspicious. Half of the said length having been divided in order into seven, eight, five, nine and five parts there would be symmetrical representation of Śiva, Viṣṇu and Brahman.

sanskrit: pañcamaṃ vardhamānākhyaṃ vyāsānnāhapravṛddhitaḥ / dvidhā bhedā bahūnyatra vakṣyante viśvakarmataḥ //
english: The fifth one is known as the Vardhamāna. There would be two kinds based on the increase of breadth and length. Many kinds are described according to Viśvakarma the divine architect.

sanskrit: āḍhyādīnāṃ tridhā sthaulyādyavadhūtaṃ tadaṣṭadhā / tridhā hastājjinākhyañca yuktaṃ sarvasamena ca //
english: The āḍhya class would be of three kinds on account of the size. Measured by the barley grains it would be eight parts, by the arm it would be three parts. The last one endowed equally is known as jina.

sanskrit: pañcaviṃśatiliṅgāni nādye devārcite tathā /
english: There would be twentyfive liṅgas in the first variety which are worshipped by the celestials.

sanskrit: caturdaśasahasrāṇi caturdaśaśatāni ca /
english: Then being divided into thirtyfive there would be 000 and 00 varieties.

sanskrit: evamaṣṭāṅgulavistāro navaikakaragarbhataḥ //
english: Thus we have the eight aṅgula’s extent from the nine cubit adytum.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ koṇārdhakoṇasthaiścintyāt koṇāni sūtrakaiḥ /
english: One has to mark the angular points by means of threads placed at the angular and middle ofangular points.

sanskrit: vistāraṃ madhyamaḥ kṛtvā sthāpyaṃ vā madhyatastrayaṃ //
english: Having made the expansion from the middle, three parts should be fixed from the middle.

sanskrit: vibhāgādūrdhvamaṣṭāsro dvyaṣṭāsraḥ syācchivāṃśakaḥ /
english: There would be eight angular parts above the division. Two angular parts represent the part of Śiva.

sanskrit: pādājjānvantako brahmā nābhyanto viṣṇurityataḥ //
english: From the knee to the navel is Viṣṇu. From the navel upto the head is the part of Śiva.

sanskrit: mūrdhvānto bhūtabhāgeśo vyakte 'vyakte ca tadvati /
english: Similarly, it is in the case of distinct and indistinct forms.

sanskrit: pañcaliṅgavyavasthāyāṃ śiro vartulamucyate //
english: In the liṅga of five parts, the head part is said to be circular.

sanskrit: chatrābhaṃ kukkuṭābhaṃ vā bālendupratimākṛtiḥ /
english: The images may be of the shape of an umbrella, cock or crescent moon.

sanskrit: ekaikasya caturbhedaiḥ kāmyabhedāt phalaṃ vade //
english: shall describe the merits of the four varieties. in each class differing on account of one’s option.

sanskrit: liṅgamastakavistāraṃ vasubhaktantu kārayet /
english: The head portion of the liṅga should be divided into eight parts.

sanskrit: ādyabhāgaṃ caturdhā tu vistārocchrāyato bhajet //
english: The first part of the longitudinal portion should be divided into four parts.

sanskrit: catvāri tatra sūtrāṇi bhāgabhāgānupātanāt /
english: There should be four lines successively drawn in order to divide into parts.

sanskrit: puṇḍarīkantu bhāgena viśālākhyaṃ vilopanāt // triśātanāttu śrīvatsaṃ śatrukṛdvedalopanāt / śiraḥ sarvasame śreṣṭhaṃ kukkuṭābhaṃ surāhvaye //
english: We have by one part the lotus, the one called viśāla by cutting off, the śrīvatsa by thinning out and the śatrukṛt by elision of the fourth part. In the sarvasama class the top portion is the excellent and the cockshaped in the sura class among the liṅga of four parts.

sanskrit: caturbhāgātmake liṅgetrapuṣaṃ dvayalopanāt / anādyasya śiraḥ proktamardhacandraṃ śiraḥ śṛṇu //
english: By the elision of two, three and four parts in order, one gets the full, crescent moon and lotus shape. Listen then to the description of forms having four or three faces or one face and mukhaliṅga.

sanskrit: aṃśāt prānte yugāṃśaiś ca tvekāhānyāmṛtākṣakaṃ / pūrṇabālendukumudaṃ dvitrivedakṣayāt kramāt //
english: The part to be worshipped is to be made set with nine parts. Having left out twelve parts for the arms and eyes, as before, the head, forehead, nose, face, chin, neck are then to be made.

sanskrit: catustrirekavadanaṃ mukhaliṅgamataḥ śṛṇu /
english: have described the fourfaced form. Listen! The threefaced form is described now.

sanskrit: pūjābhāgaṃ prakartavyaṃ mūrtyagnipadakalpitaṃ //
english: The ear and feet are made. One has to mark the forehead etc.

sanskrit: arkāṃśaṃ pūrvavat tyaktvā ṣaṭ sthānāni vivartayat / śironnatiḥ prakartavyā lalāṭaṃ nāsikā tataḥ //
english: Then the arms should be made with four parts quite strong. The projection of the frontispiece should be oneeighth of the breadth. One face has to be made such as to have beautiful eye on the eastern side.

sanskrit: karṇapādādhikāstasya lalāṭādīni nirdiśet / bhujau caturbhirbhāgaistu kartavyau paścimorjitaṃ //
english: It should be made round at the forehead, nose, face and neck. By onefifth from the arm one should make it round.

sanskrit: vistārasya ṣaḍaṃśena mukhair nirgamanaṃ hitaṃ / sarveṣāṃ mukhaliṅgānāṃ trapuṣaṃ vātha kukkuṭaṃ //
english: less by one’s arm length. It is good to have the projections in the frontispiece as onesixth of the breadth for all the mukhaliṅgas whether it is trapuṣa or kukkuṭa ? .

sanskrit: ataḥ paraṃpravakṣyāmi pratimānāntu piṇḍikām /
english: shall describe the characteristics of the pedestal of images .

sanskrit: dairghyeṇa pratimātulyā tadardhena tu vistṛtā // ucchritāyāmatordhena suvistārārdhabhāgataḥ / tṛtīyena tu vā tulyaṃ tattribhāgeṇa mekhalā //
english: They have the same length as the height of the image and have breadth half the height of the image. Or the breadth should be half or onethird of the measure of the height. The girdle should be equal to onethird of its breadth.

sanskrit: khātaṃ ca tatpramāṇaṃ tu kiñciduttarato natam /
english: The cavity should be of the same measure and should be inclined towards the posterior part.

sanskrit: vistārasya caturthena praṇālasya vinirgamaḥ // samūlasya vistāramagre kuryāttadardhataḥ /
english: A quarter of the breadth should be left out for the canal as outlet. The width of the forepart of the channel should be half of the breadth of the base.

sanskrit: vistārasya tṛtīyena toyamārgantu kārayet //
english: The watercourse should be onethird of the breadth of the base.

sanskrit: piṇḍikārdhena vā tulyaṃ dairghyamīśasya kīrtitam / īśaṃ vā tulyadīrghañca jñātvā sūtraṃ prakalpayet //
english: Or else the length of the liṅga is said to be equal to half the length of the base or equal to the length of the base. The height of the pedestal should be divided into sixteen parts as before.

sanskrit: adhaḥ ṣaṭkaṃ dvibhāgantu kaṇṭhaṃ kuryāttribhāgakam //
english: The lower six divisions should be made to comprise two parts. The neck should be three parts.

sanskrit: śeṣāstvekaikaśaḥ kāryāḥ pratiṣṭhānirgamās tathā / paṭṭikā piṇḍikā ceyaṃ sāmānyapratimāsu ca //
english: The foundation, projections, joint, seat and other remaining parts should each comprise one part. This will hold good in the case of ordinary images.

sanskrit: prāsādadvāramānena pratimādvāramucyate /
english: The doorway leading to the image is said to be proportionate to the doorway of the temple.

sanskrit: gajavyālakasaṃyuktā prabhā syāt pratimāsu ca //
english: The canopy over the image should be endowed with elephants and tigers.

sanskrit: piṇḍikāpi yathāśobhaṃ kartavyā satataṃ hareḥ /
english: The pedestal of the image of Hari also should always be made beautiful.

sanskrit: sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ śiṣṇūktaṃ mānamucyate / devīnāmapi sarvāsāṃ lakṣmyuktaṃ mānamucyate //
english: The measures laid down for the images of Viṣṇu shall apply to the images of all gods. Those measures set forth for the image of Lakṣmī shall apply to all images of the goddesses.

sanskrit: pratiṣṭhāpañcakaṃ vakṣye pratimātmā tu pūruṣaḥ /
english: shall now describe the five divisions of an installation.

sanskrit: prakṛtiḥ piṇḍikā lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhā yogakastayoḥ //
english: The image is the embodiment of the supreme being, the real principle, the pedestal is the symbol of nature or the Goddess Lakṣmi.

sanskrit: icchāphalārthibhistasmātpratiṣṭhā kriyate naraiḥ /
english: Hence, the installation is done by men who desire to have their wishes fulfilled.

sanskrit: aṣṭaṣoḍaśaviṃśāntaṃ maṇḍapañcādhamādikam / snānaṃ kalaśārthañca yāgadravyārthamardhataḥ //
english: The officiating priest has to arrange sheds measuring eight, sixteen or twenty cubits in front of the temple for bathing, the pitchers, and things required for the sacrifice by extending the side lines of the adytum.

sanskrit: tribhāgeṇārdhabhāgena vediṃ kuryāttu śobhanām /
english: The auspicious sacrificial platform should be made ready with one third or half of the above space.

sanskrit: kalaśair ghaṭikābhiś ca vitānādyaiś ca bhūṣayet //
english: It should be decked with pitchers big and small and canopies etc.

sanskrit: pañcagavyena samprokṣya sarvadravyāṇi dhārayet /
english: All the materials to be used in the rite should be cleansed with pañcagavya the five things extracted from a cow.

sanskrit: alaṅkṛto gururviṣṇuṃ dhyātvātmānaṃ prapūjayet //
english: The priest should adorn himself with ornaments. Having contemplated his own self as lord Viṣṇu, he should begin worship.

sanskrit: aṅgulīyaprabhṛtibhirmūrtipān valayādibhiḥ / kuṇḍe kuṇḍe sthāpayecca mūrtipāṃstatra pāragān //
english: The expert idolworshippers should be established in front of each pit intended for the rite. They should be endowed with rings, bracelets and other things.

sanskrit: catuṣkoṇe cārdhakoṇe vartule padmasannibhe / pūrvādau toraṇārthantu pippaloḍumbarau vaṭaṃ //
english: Logs of the pippala, udumbara, vaṭa trees should be planted at the doorways of the place for the sake of arches. The place may be quadrangular, semicircular, circular or lotusshaped.

sanskrit: plakṣaṃ suśobhanaṃ pūrvaṃ subhadrandakṣatoraṇaṃ / sukarma ca suhotrañca āpye saumye samucchrayam //
english: Log of the fig tree should adorn the east, of the subhadra the south, of the sukarma and suhotra the northern and western doorways respectively.

sanskrit: pañcahastaṃ tu saṃsthāpya syonāpṛthvīti pūjayet / toraṇastambhamūle tu kalaśānmaṅgalāṅkurān //
english: The pitchers having young sprouts of mango trees should be placed five cubits apart at the toot of each one of the supporting columns of the arches and be worshipped with the sacred syllables syonā pṛthivī.

sanskrit: pradadyādupariṣṭācca kuryāccakraṃ sudarśanaṃ /
english: The sudarśana disc of Viṣṇu should be placed at the top.

sanskrit: pañcahastapramāṇantu dhvajaṃ kuryāddvicakṣaṇaḥ //
english: A wise man has to make the banner five cubits long.

sanskrit: vaipulyaṃ cāsya kurvīta ṣoḍaśāṅgulasanmitaṃ /
english: It should be made sixteen fingers broad.

sanskrit: saptahastocchritaṃ vāsya kuryāt kuṇḍaṃ surottama //
english: O excellent among the celestials! the height should be seventeen cubits in the alternative.

sanskrit: aruṇogninibhaś caiva kṛṣṇaḥ śuklotha pītakaḥ /
english: The pit should be duly reddish, flamecoloured,. black, white, yellow, deep red, white and again white.

sanskrit: kumudaḥ kumudākṣaś ca puṇḍarīkotha vāmanaḥ / śaṅkukarṇaḥ sarvanetraḥ sumukhaḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ // pūjyā koṭiguṇair yuktāḥ pūrvādyā dhvajadevatāḥ /
english: The presiding deities of the banners hoisted in the quarters east etc., such as Kumuda, Kumudākṣa, Puṇḍarīka, Vāmana, Saṅkarṣaṇa, Sarvanetra, Sumukha and Supratiṣṭhita, who are endowed with countless divine qualities should. be worshipped.

sanskrit: jalāḍhakasupūrāstu pakvavimbopamā ghaṭāḥ // aṣṭāviṃśādhikaśataṃ kālamaṇḍanavarjitāḥ / sahiraṇyā vastrakaṇṭhāḥ sodakāstoraṇādvahiḥ //
english: One hundred and eight pitchers resembling the ripe bimba fruit in colour, not having black spots and having been filled with water and gold and having pieces of cloth around their necks should be placed outside the arches.

sanskrit: ghaṭāḥ sthāpyāś ca pūrvādau vedikāyāś ca koṇagān /
english: Pitchers should be placed at the east and other directions.

sanskrit: caturaḥ sthāpayet kumbhānājighreti ca mantrataḥ //
english: Four pitchers should be placed at the corners of the sacrificial altar with the sacred syllable ājighra.

sanskrit: kumbheṣvāvāhya śakrādīn pūrvādau pūjayet kramāt /
english: After having invoked Indra and others in the pitchers. in the east etc. one should worship Indra.

sanskrit: indrāgaccha devarāja vajrahasta gajasthita //
english: O Indra, the lord of celestials, the wielder of thunderbolt, seated on the elephant you come.

sanskrit: pūrvadvārañca me rakṣa devaiḥ saha namostu te /
english: You protect the eastern door in the company of celestials. May salutations be to you.

sanskrit: trātāramindramantreṇa arcayitvā yajed budhaḥ //
english: After having worshipped Indra with the sacred syllable trātāram indra, the wise man should invoke him.

sanskrit: āgacchāgre śaktiyuta cchāgastha balasaṃyuta /
english: O Agni! endowed with a trident, seated on a goat and possessing strength you come and accept my worship.

sanskrit: rakṣāgneyīṃ diśaṃ devaiḥ pūjāṃ gṛha namostu te //
english: You protect the southeast in the company of celestials. Salutations to you.

sanskrit: agnimūrdhetimantreṇa yajedvā āgneya namaḥ /
english: One should worship Agni with the sacred syllable agnir mūrddhā. Salutations to Agni.

sanskrit: mahiṣastha yamāgaccha daṇḍahasta mahābala //
english: O Yama! seated on the buffalo, wielding the mace, and possessing great strength.

sanskrit: rakṣa tvaṃ dakṣiṇadvāraṃ vaivasvata namostu te /
english: you come. You protect the southern gate. O Yama! salutations to you.

sanskrit: vaivasvataṃ saṅgamanamityanena yajedyamaṃ //
english: Yama should be propitiated with the sacred syllable vaivasvataṃ saṅgamanam.

sanskrit: nairṛtāgaccha khaḍgāḍhya balavāhanasaṃyuta /
english: O Nairṛta! carrying a sword accompanied by an army and riding an animal, you come.

sanskrit: idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ rakṣa tvaṃ nairṛtīṃ diśaṃ //
english: Here is the offering and water for washing the feet. You guard the southwestern direction.

sanskrit: eṣa te nairṛte mantreṇa yajedarghyādibhir naraḥ /
english: Men should worship with the sacred syllable eṣa te nirṛte and with offerings.

sanskrit: makarārūḍha varuṇa pāśahasta mahābala //
english: O Varuṇa! riding the crocodile, holding the noose and possessing great strength you come and protect the western doorway.

sanskrit: āgaccha paścimaṃ dvāraṃ rakṣa rakṣa namostu te /
english: Salutations to you.

sanskrit: uruṃ hi rājā varuṇaṃ yajedarghyādibhirguruḥ //
english: The preceptor should worship with the sacred syllable uruṃ hi rājā varuṇam and offerings.

sanskrit: āgaccha vāyo sabala dhvajahasta savāhana /
english: O Vāyu! endowed with strength, holding the banner, together with a vehicle you come.

sanskrit: vāyavyaṃ rakṣa devaistvaṃ samarudbhir namostu te //
english: You guard the northwestern direction in the company of celestials and Maruts groups of celestial gods. Salutations to you.

sanskrit: vāta ity ādibhiścārvedonnamo vāyavepi vā /
english: He should be worshipped with the sacred syllables vāta etc. or with ‘Oṃ! Salutations to Vāyu’.

sanskrit: āgaccha soma sabalā gadāhasta savāhana //
english: O Soma! you come with strength, wielding the mace and riding the vehicle.

sanskrit: rakṣa tvamuttaradvāraṃ sakuvera namostu te /
english: You protect the northern gate along with Kubera. Salutations to you.

sanskrit: somaṃ rājānamiti vā yajetsomāya vai namaḥ //
english: One should worship with the sacred syllable somaṃ rājānam or Salutations to Soma’.

sanskrit: āgaccheśāna sabala śūlahasta vṛṣasthita / yajñamaṇḍapasyaiśānīṃ diśaṃ rakṣa namostu te //
english: O Īsāna! you come along! possesser of strength, riding the bull. You guard the northeastern direction of the ritual pavilion. Salutations to you. He should be worshipped with the sacred syllable.

sanskrit: īśānamasyeti yajedīśānāya namopi vā /
english: īśānamasya or ‘Salutations to Īsāna’.

sanskrit: brahmannāgaccha haṃsastha sruksruvavyagrahastaka // salokordhvāṃ diśaṃ rakṣa yajñasyāja namostu te /
english: O Brahman! you come. Seated on a swan! Carrying the sacrificial vessel and ladle! You defend the direction above the sacrificial place, O unborn! Salutations to you.

sanskrit: hiraṇyagarbheti yajennamaste brahmaṇepi vā //
english: One should worship with the sacred syllable hiraṇyagarbha or ‘salutations to Brahman’.

sanskrit: anantāgaccha cakrāḍhya kūrmasthāhigaṇeśvara / adhodiśaṃ rakṣa rakṣa ananteśa namostu te /
english: O Ananta! you come. Endowed with the disc! Seated on the tortoise! Lord of the gaṇas. You protect the bottom of the sacrificial place. O Lord Ananta! Salutations to you.

sanskrit: namostu sarpeti yajedanantāya namopi vā //
english: One should worship with the sacred syllable ‘Salutations to serpent’ or ‘Salutations to Ananta’.

sanskrit: bhūmeḥ parigrahaṃ kuryāt kṣipedbrīhīṃś ca sarṣapān / nārasiṃhena rakṣoghnān prokṣoghnān prokṣayet pañcagavyataḥ //
english: One should do the ceremony of taking possession of the ground. One should scatter grains and mustard seeds uttering the sacred syllable ‘Nārasiṃha’ which destroys demons. One should sprinkle pañcagavya the five things got from a cow.

sanskrit: bhūmiṃ ghaṭe tu sampūjya saratne sāṅgakaṃ hariṃ / astramantreṇa karakaṃ tatra cāṣṭaśataṃ yajet //
english: Having worshipped the earth in the pitcher containing gems as well as Hari and his retinue, worship the eighteen pitchers therein with the sacred syllable of weapons.

sanskrit: acchinnadhārayā siñcan brīhīn saṃskṛtya dhārayet / pradakṣiṇaṃ paribhrāmya kalaśaṃ vikiropari //
english: The rice grains should be purified by an incessant shower of water and scattered around. The pitcher should be placed in their midst.

sanskrit: savastre kalaśe bhūyaḥ pūjayedacyutaṃ śriyaṃ /
english: Lord Acyuta and his consort Śrī should again be worshipped in the pitcher provided with a cloth.

sanskrit: yoge yogeti mantreṇa nyasecchayyāntu maṇḍale // kuśopari tūlikāñca śayyāyāṃ digvidikṣu ca / vidyādhipān yajedviṣṇuṃ madhughātaṃ trivikramaṃ //
english: The bed as well as the mattress should be spread on the kuśa grass on a drawn circle with the recitation of the sacred syllable yoge yoge. Lord Viṣṇu, the slayer of the demon Madhu and the lord of the three divisions of the universe and also the different lords of learning are worshipped on the bed.

sanskrit: vāmanaṃ dikṣu vāyvādau śrīdharañca hṛṣīkapaṃ / padmanābhaṃ dāmodaramaiśānyāṃ snānamaṇḍape // abhyarcya paścādaiśānyāṃ catuṣkumbhe savedike / snānamaṇḍaṣake sarvadravyāṇyānīya nikṣipet //
english: Having worshipped Vāmana, Śrīdhara, Hṛṣīkeśa, Padmanābha different forms of Viṣṇu in the northwest and other corners of the bathing place and the Dāmodara form of Viṣṇu in the northeast and having brought all the materials to the bathing pavilion they should be deposited in the four pitchers and the altar in the northeast.

sanskrit: snānakumbheṣu kumbhāṃstāṃś caturdikṣvadhivāsayet /
english: These pitchers should be consecrated in the four quarters with the pitchers containing water for the consecration.

sanskrit: kalaśāḥ sthāpanīyāstu abhiṣekārthamādarāt //
english: The pitchers should be placed with due regard for the purpose of consecration.

sanskrit: vaṭodumbarakāśvatthāṃś campakāśokaśrīdrumān / palāśārjunaplakṣāṃstu kadambavakulāmrakān //
english: The young sprouts from the vaṭa udumbara, aśvattha, campaka, aśoka, śrīdruma, palāśa, arjuna, plakṣa, kadamba, bakula and mango trees should be brought and put in the eastern pitcher.

sanskrit: padmakaṃ rocanāṃ dūrvāṃ darbhapiñjalameva ca // jātīpuṣpaṃ kundapuṣpacandanaṃ raktacandanaṃ / siddhārthaṃ tagarañcaiva taṇḍulaṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset //
english: The lotus, rocanā a kind of yellow pigment, dūrvā grass, darbha grass, piñjala yellow orpiment, the flowers jāti and kunda, pieces of sandal wood, red sandal, white mustard, tagara a kind of herb, and rice should be put on the southern one.

sanskrit: nadyāḥ samudragāminyā viśeṣāt jāhnavīmṛdaṃ // gomayañca yavān śālīṃstilāṃś caivāpare nyaset /
english: Silver and gold and earth from the two banks of rivers flowing into the ocean especially the earth from the river Jāhnavi Ganges, the urine of a cow, barley grains, paddy and sesamum should be placed in another pitcher.

sanskrit: viṣṇuparṇīṃ śyāmalatāṃ bhṛṅgarājaṃ śatāvarīṃ // sahadevāṃ mahādevīṃ balāṃ vyaghrīṃ salakṣmaṇāṃ /
english: The viṣṇuparṇī, śyāmalatā, bhṛṅgarāja, śatāvarī, sahadevī, mahādevī, balā and vyāghnī ?, the auspicious things are put in the other pitcher in the northeast.

sanskrit: valmīkamṛttikāṃ saptasthānotthāmapare nyaset / jāhnavīvālukātoyaṃ vinyasedapare ghaṭe //
english: The earth from an anthill obtained from seven different places should be put in another pitcher. The sand from the Ganges and its water should be put in another pitcher.

sanskrit: varāhavṛṣanāgendraviṣāṇoddhṛtamṛttikāṃ / mṛttikāṃ padmamūlasya kuśasya tvapare nyaset //
english: The earth loosened by the boars, bulls, and elephants. with their horns and tusks as well as earth from the root of the lotus and the kuśa grass should be placed in another pitcher.

sanskrit: tīrthaparvatamṛdbhiś ca yuktamapyapare nyaset /
english: One should put in another pitcher earth got from sacred places and hills.

sanskrit: nāgakeśarapuṣpañca kāśmīramapare nyaset // candanāgurukarpūraiḥ puṣpaṃ caivāpare nyaset /
english: The flowers of nāgakeśara and kāśmira should be put in another pitcher. Flowers together with the sandal wood, agallochum and camphor should be placed in another pitcher.

sanskrit: vaidūryaṃ vidrumaṃ muktāṃ sphaṭikaṃ vajrameva ca // etānyekatra nikṣipya sthāpayeddevasattama /
english: The gems lapis lazuli, coral, pearl, crystal, and diamond should be put earlier in one pitcher and placed firmly by the holy priests.

sanskrit: nadīnadataḍāgānāṃ salilair aparaṃ nyaset //
english: Another pitcher should be filled with the waters of the rivers and tanks.

sanskrit: ekāśītipade cānyānmaṇḍape kalaśān nyaset / gandhodakādyaiḥ sampūrṇān śrīsūktenābhimantrayet //
english: Another set of pitchers filled with perfumes etc. should be placed at eightyone places and consecrated with the śrīsūkta.

sanskrit: yavaṃ siddhārthakaṃ gandhaṃ kuśāgraṃ cākṣataṃ tathā / tilān phalaṃ tathā puṣpamarghyārthaṃ pūrvato nyaset // padmaṃ śyāmalatāṃ dūrvāṃ viṣṇuparṇīṃ kuśāṃs tathā /
english: Barley grains, white mustard, perfumes, tips of kuśa grass, unbroken rice, sesamum, fruits and flowers should be first placed for the sake of worship. The lotus, the creeper called śyāmalatā, dūrvā grass, leaf of holy basil and kuśa grass should be kept on the righthand side for being offered at the foot.

sanskrit: pādyārthaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge madhuparkaṃ tu dakṣiṇe //
english: The madhuparka is also placed on the right side.

sanskrit: kakkolakaṃ lavaṅgañca tathā jātīphalaṃ śubhaṃ / uttare hy ācamanāya agnau dūrvākṣatānvitaṃ //
english: The kaṅkola, cloves and nutmeg along with the dūrvā grass and unbroken rice should be offered in the fire on the north for the sake of rinsing the mouth.

sanskrit: pātraṃ nīrājanārthaṃ ca tathodvartanamānile / gandhapuṣpānvitaṃ pātramaiśānyāṃ pātrake nyaset //
english: A vessel for offering camphor and perfumes to be applied on the body should be placed on the southeast. A vessel containing perfumes and flowers should be placed on the northeast.

sanskrit: murāmāṃsī cāmalakaṃ sahadevāṃ niśādikaṃ /
english: The murā, māṃsī, myrabolan, sahadevā and niśā and sixty lamps should be placed.

sanskrit: ṣaṣṭidīpānnyasedaṣṭau nyasennīrājanāya ca //
english: Eight lamps should be kept for the nirājana showing the light in adoration.

sanskrit: śaṅkhaṃ cakrañca śrīvatsaṃ kuliśaṃ paṅkajādikaṃ /
english: The conch, disc, śrīvatsa mark on the breast of Viṣṇu, thunderbolt, lotus etc.

sanskrit: hemādipātre kṛtvā tu nānāvarṇādipuṣpakaṃ //
english: should be placed in a golden vessel along with flowers of variegated colours.

sanskrit: aiśānyāṃ janayet kuṇḍaṃ gururvahniñca vaiṣṇavaṃ / gāyatryaṣṭaśataṃ hutvā sampātavidhinā ghaṭān //
english: The priest should get ready a pit for sacrificial fire in the northeast. The fire relating to Viṣṇu should be kindled with the recitation of gāyatrī one hundred and eight times.

sanskrit: prokṣayet kāruśālāyāṃ śilpibhirmūrtipair vrajet / tūryaśabdaiḥ kautukañca bandhayeddakṣiṇe kare //
english: Having cleansed the pitchers thoroughly and established the priest he should go to the shed where the image has been made ready accompanied by the sculptors and custodians of the idol and along with music of the instrument tūrya.

sanskrit: viṣṇave śipiviṣṭeti ūrṇāsūtreṇa sarṣapaiḥ /
english: The woollen thread containing mustard seeds should be tied on the right arm of the idol with the syllables Viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya etc.

sanskrit: paṭṭavastreṇa kartavyaṃ deśikasyāpi kautukaṃ //
english: The priest should also have a piece of silk cloth tied to his arm.

sanskrit: maṇḍape pratimāṃ sthāpya savastrāṃ pūjitān stuvan / namastercye sureśāni praṇīte viśvakarmaṇā // prabhāvitāśeṣajagaddhātri tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ /
english: Having placed the idol in the pavilion and having adored and worshipped the dressed idol one has to say “ bow to you the sovereign lady of celestials who has been made ready by Viśvakarman the divine architect.” make obeisance to you who is resplendant and is the sustainer of the entire universe.

sanskrit: tvayi sampūjayāmīśe nārāyaṇamanāmayaṃ //
english: worship in you the healthy Lord Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit: rahitā śilpidoṣaistvamṛddhiyuktā sadā bhava /
english: Be thou always prosperous goddess devoid of defects due to the sculptors.

sanskrit: evaṃ vijñāpya pratimāṃ nayettāṃ snānamaṇḍapaṃ // śilpinantoṣayeddravyair gurave gāṃ pradāpayet /
english: Having submitted thus that idol should be carried to the bathing pavilion . The sculptor should be satisfied by offering articles of present. A cow should be given as gift to the priest.

sanskrit: citraṃ deveti mantreṇa netre conmīlayettataḥ //
english: Then the eyes of the idol should be made open with the recitation of the syllable citraṃ deva.

sanskrit: agnirjyotīti dṛṣṭiñca dadyādvai bhadrapīṭhake / tataḥ śuklāni puṣpāṇi ghṛtaṃ siddhārthakaṃ tathā //
english: The sight should be endowed with the recitation of the syllable agnir jyoti. Then white flowers, ghee and mustard seeds should be placed on the pedestal.

sanskrit: dūrvāṃ kuśāgraṃ devasya dadyācchirasi deśikaḥ /
english: The priest should place dūrvā grass and tips of kuśa grass on the head of the deity.

sanskrit: madhuvāteti mantreṇa netre cābhyañjayedguruḥ //
english: Then the priest should anoint the eyes of the deity with the syllables madhu vātā.

sanskrit: hiraṇyagarbhamantreṇa imaṃ meti ca kīrtayet /
english: The syllables hiraṇyagarbha and imam me should be recited.

sanskrit: ghṛtenābhyañjayet paścāt paṭhan ghṛtavatīṃ punaḥ // masūrapiṣṭe nodvartya ato deveti kīrtayan / kṣālayeduṣṇatoyena sapta te 'greti deśikaḥ //
english: Then the idol should be anointed with ghee reciting the hymn ghṛtavatā. The flour paste of masūra a variety of grain should be rubbed on the deity reciting the hymn ato devā. Then the priest should wash the deity with hot water with the recitation of sapta te agne.

sanskrit: drupadādivetyanulimpedāpo hi ṣṭheti secayet / nadījaistīrthajaiḥ snānaṃ pāvamānīti ratnajaiḥ //
english: The image should be bathed with the waters of the rivers and sacred places with the syllables āpo hi ṣṭḥā and with the waters containing gems with the pāvamāna.

sanskrit: samudraṃ gaccha candanaistīrthamṛtkalaśena ca /
english: The image should be bathed with the waters of an earthern pot with the syllable samudraṃ gaccha.

sanskrit: śanno devīḥ snāpayecca gāyatryāpyuṣṇavāriṇā //
english: It should be consecrated with śanno devī and bathed with hot water consecrated by gāyatrī.

sanskrit: pañcamṛddhirhiraṇyeti snāpayetparameśvaraṃ /
english: The supreme god should be bathed with five kinds of earth with the syllable hiraṇya.

sanskrit: sikatādbhirirmaṃ meti valmīkodaghaṭena ca //
english: With pot made of earth of an anthill and sand waters and the syllable imam me it should be bathed.

sanskrit: tadviṣṇoriti oṣadhyadbhiryā oṣadhīti mantrataḥ / yajñāyajñeti kāṣāyaiḥ pañcabhirgavyakaistataḥ //
english: The image should be bathed with herbal waters with the syllable tadviṣṇoḥ and yā oṣadhī, with herbal decoctions with the syllable yajñāajñā and then with the pañcagavya the five things got from a cow.

sanskrit: payaḥ pṛthivyāṃ mantreṇa yāḥ phalinī phalāmbubhiḥ / viśvataś cakṣuḥ saumyena pūrveṇa kalasena ca //
english: The image should be bathed with the waters containing fruits with the syllables payaḥ pṛthivyām and yāḥ phalinī and with the contents of the pitchers kept in the north and east with the syllables viśvataścakṣuḥ.

sanskrit: somaṃ rājānamityevaṃ viṣṇo rarāṭaṃ dakṣataḥ / haṃsaḥ śuciḥ paścimena kuryādudvartanaṃ hareḥ //
english: The cleansing of the image of Hari Viṣṇu should be done with the recitation of the syllables somaṃ rājānam, viṣṇo rarāṭamasi from the right and with haṃsaḥ śuci on the west

sanskrit: mūrdhānandivamantreṇa dhātrīṃ māṃsīṃ ca ke dadet /
english: One should offer the dhātrī and māṃsī herbs on the head with the sacred syllables mūrdhānaṃ divā.

sanskrit: mānastoketi mantreṇa gandhadvāreti gandhakaiḥ //
english: One should bathe the image with perfumes with the syllables gandhadvāra and mā nas toka.

sanskrit: idamāpeti ca ghaṭair etāśītipadasthitaiḥ /
english: One has to pour over its head the contents of the pitchers placed in the eightyone squares with the syllables idam ȧpaḥ.

sanskrit: ehyehi bhagavan viṣṇo lokānugrāhakāraka //
english: O Lord Viṣṇu! the bestower of grace on the universe! you come.

sanskrit: yajñabhāgaṃ gṛhāṇemaṃ vāsudeva namostu te / anenāvāhya deveśaṃ kuryāt kautukamocanaṃ //
english: You accept this share in the sacrificial offerings. O Vāsudeva! Salutations to you! Having invoked the lord in this way, the wrist thread on the hand of the image should be unfastened.

sanskrit: muñcāmi tveti sūktena deśikasyāpi mocayet / hiraṇmayena pādyaṃ dadyādato deveti cārghyakaṃ //
english: The wrist thread on the hand of the priest should also be unfastened with the hymn muñcāmi tvā. The water for washing the feet should be offered with the syllable hiraṇmaya and the offering with ato devā.

sanskrit: madhuvātā madhuparkaṃ mayi gṛhṇāmi cācamet / akṣannamīmadanteti kireddarvākṣataṃ budhaḥ //
english: The madhuparka should be offered with the syllables madhuvātā and the ācamana the ceremonial sipping of waters at the commencement of any rite should be done with mayi gṛhṇāmi. The learned priest should scatter the unbroken ricewith the syllable akṣannamīmadanta.

sanskrit: kāṇḍānnirmañchanaṃ kuryādgandhaṃ gandhavatīti ca / unnayāmīti mālyañca idaṃ viṣṇuḥ pavitrakaṃ //
english: The image should be rubbed part by part and perfumes should be offered with the syllable gandhavat , garland with the syllable unnayāmi and the sacred thread with the syllable idaṃ viṣṇu.

sanskrit: vṛhaspate vastrayugmaṃ vedāhamityuttarīyakaṃ /
english: Pair of cloth pieces should be offered with the syllable bṛhaspate and the upper cloth with the syllable vedāham.

sanskrit: mahāvratena sakalīpuṣpaṃ cauṣadhayaḥ kṣipet //
english: The herbs and the flower of concluding worship should.. be placed with the mahāvrata.

sanskrit: dhūpaṃ dadyāddhūrasīti vibhrāṭsūktena cāñjanaṃ / yuñjantīti ca tilakaṃ dīrghāyuṣṭveti mālyakaṃ //
english: Incense should be offered with dhūrasi and the collyrium to the eyes of the image with the hymn called vibhrāṭ. The mark on the forehead should be made with the syllable yuñjanti and the garland should be offered with dīrghāyuṣṭvā.

sanskrit: indracchatreti chatrantu ādarśantu virājataḥ / cāmarantu vikarṇena bhūṣāṃ rathantareṇa ca //
english: One should offer an umbrella with the syllable indra cchatra, mirror with virāja, the chowrie with vikarṇa and_ the ornaments with rathantara.

sanskrit: vyajanaṃ vāyudaivatyair muñcāmi tveti puṣpakaṃ /
english: One should offer the fan with the syllable vāyu daivatya and flowers with muñcāmi tvā.

sanskrit: vedādyaiḥ saṃstutiṃ kuryāddhareḥ puruṣasūktataḥ //
english: One should sing in praise of Lord Hari Viṣṇu with vedic hymns and the hymn called puruṣasūkta.

sanskrit: sarvametatsamaṃ kuryāt piṇḍikādau harādike /
english: All these rites should be performed similarly relating to pedestals of Hara Śiva and other gods.

sanskrit: devasyotthānasamaye sauparṇaṃ sūktamuccaret //
english: The hymn called sauparṇa should be recited at the time of raising the image of the deity.

sanskrit: uttiṣṭheti samutthāpya śayyāyā maṇḍape nayet / śākunenaiva sūktena devaṃ brahmarathādinā //
english: The image having been raised by reciting the syllable uttiṣṭha, the lord should be led to the bed in the pavilion with the recitation of the hymn śakuna and with the syllable brahmaratha.

sanskrit: ato deveti sūktena prātimāṃ piṇḍikāṃ tathā / śrīsūktena ca śayyāyāṃ viṣṇostu śakalīkṛtiḥ //
english: Then the image and the pedestal should be laid in the bed with the hymn ato devā. With the recitation of śrīsūkta the rite for Viṣṇu is completed.

sanskrit: mṛgarājaṃ vṛṣaṃ nāgaṃ vyajanaṃ kalaśaṃ tathā / vaijayantīṃ tathā bherīṃ dīpamityaṣṭamaṅgalaṃ //
english: The eight auspicious things are the lion, bull, serpent, fan, pitcher, banner, trumpet and lamp.

sanskrit: darśayedaśvasūktena pādadeśe tripāditi /
english: The priest should show these at the foot with the hymn called aśvasūkta and the tripād gāyatrī.

sanskrit: muṣalolūkhalaṃ dadyācchilāṃ sammārjanīṃ tathā / tathā bhojanabhāṇḍāni gṛhopakāraṇāni ca //
english: One should submit a cooking vessel, covering pan, ladle, pestle, crushing stone, grinding stone, groomstick, utensils for eating and other household things should be given to the goddess.

sanskrit: śirodeśe ca nidrākhyaṃ vastraratnayutaṃ ghaṭaṃ / khaṇḍakhādyaiḥ pūrayitvā snapanasya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ //
english: A pitcher known as nidrā provided with clothes and gems and filled with edibles should be placed at the headside of the image. This is the mode of bathing the image.

sanskrit: hareḥ sānnidhyakaraṇamadhivāsanamucyate /
english: ... The act of causing the presence of God Hari is said tobe the adhivāsana preliminary consecration.

sanskrit: sarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ dhyātvā ātmānaṃ puruṣottamaṃ // oṃkāreṇa samāyojya cicchaktimabhimāninīṃ / niḥsāryātmaikatāṃ kṛtvā svasmin sarvagate vibhau // yojayenmarutāṃ pṛthvīṃ vahnivījena dīpayet / saṃharedvāyunā cāgniṃ vāyumākāśato nayet //
english: Having contemplated on the self as the omniscient, allpervasive and supreme spirit and having united one’s selfconceited conscious energy with the syllable oṃ and after having drawn it out and identifying one’s own self with the allpervasive lord, the priest should unite the earth with the wind, illuminate it with the fire particle mentally, draw the fire with the wind particle and lead the wind into the ethereal space.

sanskrit: adhibhūtādidevaistu sādhyākhyair vibhavaiḥ saha / tanmātrapātrakān kṛtvā saṃharettat kramād budhaḥ //
english: The wiseman should draw in the same order the other gross elements after having made them the receptacles of subtle principles along with the gross principles, the supreme being and the secondary forms such as the sādhyas.

sanskrit: ākāśaṃ manasāhatya manohaṅkaraṇe kuru / ahaṅkārañca mahati tañcāpyavyākṛte nayet //
english: The ethereal space should be drawn into the mind principle, the mind in its turn should be drawn into the principle of ego, the principle of ego in the principle of mahat first principle.

sanskrit: avyākṛtaṃ jñānarūpe vāsudevaḥ sa īritaḥ /
english: The unmanifest is led into the absolute knowledge known as Vāsudeva.

sanskrit: saṅkarṣaṇaṃ saṃ śabdātmā sparśākhyamasṛjat prabhuḥ /
english: Being desirous to create he, the Lord of sound by means of the unmanifest brought into being Saṅkarṣaṇa the principle known as touch.

sanskrit: kṣobhya māyāṃ sa pradyumnaṃ tejorūpaṃ sa cāsṛjat //
english: He created Pradyumna the form of splendour by agitating the illusion.

sanskrit: aniruddhaṃ rasamātraṃ brahmāṇaṃ gandharūpakaṃ /
english: He created Aniruddha, consisting of taste only and Brahmā of the form of smell.

sanskrit: aniruddhaḥ sa ca brahmā apa ādau sasarja ha //
english: That Aniruddha, the Brahmā created water at first.

sanskrit: tasmin hiraṇmayañcāṇḍaṃ so 'sṛjat pañcabhūtavat / tasmin saṅkrāmite jīve śaktirātmopasaṃhṛtā //
english: He also laid the golden egg of the five principles in that water. Impregnated with consciousness this generated a peculiar force within.

sanskrit: prāṇo jīvena saṃyukto vṛttimāniti śabdyate / jīvovyāhṛtisañjñastu prāṇeṣvādhyātmikaḥ smṛtaḥ //
english: The breath united with life force is spoken as existence. The inner being also known as the vyāhṛti is a spiritual entity amidst the five winds prāṇāḥ .

sanskrit: prāṇair yuktā tato buddhiḥ sañjātā cāṣṭamūrtikī /
english: Then intellect came into being associated with the prāṇa and with eightfold modifications.

sanskrit: ahaṅkārastato jajñe manastasmādajāyata //
english: Egoism was born then and the mind came out from it.

sanskrit: arthāḥ prajajñire pañca saṅkalpādiyutāstataḥ /
english: Then the five abstract things were born possessing determination.

sanskrit: śabdaḥ sparśaś ca rūpañca raso gandha iti smṛtā //
english: They are known as sound, touch, sight, taste and smell.

sanskrit: jñānaśaktiyutānyetair ārabdhānīndriyāṇi tu /
english: The senseorgans possessing consciousness were brought about by these.

sanskrit: tvakśrotraghrāṇacakṣūṃṣi jihvābuddhīndriyāṇi tu //
english: The skin, ear, nose, eyes, tongue are the senseorgans.

sanskrit: pādau pāyuḥs tathā pāṇī vāgupasthaś ca pañcamaḥ / karmendriyāṇi caitāni pañcabhūtānyataḥ śṛṇu //
english: The feet, anus, arms, speech mouth and the genitals are the five organs of action. Listen shall describe the five elements. The ether, wind, light, water and earth are the five elements.

sanskrit: sthūlamebhiḥ śarīrantu sarvādhāraṃ prajāyate //
english: The gross body is composed of these elements and becomes the support for all.

sanskrit: eteṣāṃ vācakā mantrā nyāsāyocyanta uttamāḥ /
english: shall presently describe the mystic syllables signifying these and for being mentally placed on the different parts of the body.

sanskrit: jīvabhūtaṃ makārantu devasya vyāpakaṃ nyaset // prāṇatattvaṃ bhakārantu jīvopādhigataṃ nyaset /
english: The letter ma which is the symbol of the inner self should be located to coextend with the body of the deity. The letter bha which is the emblem of life should be lodged in the differentiating individuality of the god.

sanskrit: hṛdayasthaṃ bakārantu buddhitattvaṃ nyased budhaḥ //
english: The letter ba which represents the intellect should be located in the region of the heart.

sanskrit: phakāramapi tatraiva ahaṅkāramayaṃ nyaset /
english: The letter pha representing the sense of ego should also be located there itself.

sanskrit: manastattvaṃ pakārantu nyasetsaṅkalpasambhavaṃ //
english: The letter pa representing the mind should be located in the mental resolve. .

sanskrit: śabdatanmātratattvantu nakāraṃ mastake nyaset / sparśātmakaṃ dhakārantu vaktradeśe tu vinyaset // dakāraṃ rūpatattvantu hṛddeśe viniveśayet /
english: The letter na which is a symbol of the principle of sound should be placed on the forehead. The letter dha which is the symbol of sense of touch should be placed in the region of the face of image. The letter da denoting the gradations should be placed in the region of the heart.

sanskrit: thakāraṃ vastideśe tu rasatanmātrakaṃ nyaset // takāraṃ gandhatanmātraṃ jaṅghayorviniveśayet /
english: The letter tha symbolising the sense of taste should be placed in the region of pelvis. The letter ta signifying the sense of smell should be located on the shanks.

sanskrit: ṇakāraṃ śrotrayor nyasya ḍhakāraṃ vinyasettvaci // ḍakāraṃ netrayugme tu rasanāyāṃ ṭhakārakaṃ / ṭakāraṃ nāsikāyāntu ñakāraṃ vāci vinyaset //
english: After having located the letter ṇa in the ears, the letter ḍha should be located on the skin. The letter ḍa should be located in the two eyes, the letter ṭha in the tongue, the letter ṭa in the nose and the letter ña in the speech.

sanskrit: jhakāraṃ karayor nyasya pāṇitattvaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ /
english: Having placed the letter jha representing the hands in.

sanskrit: jakāraṃ padayor nyasya chaṃ pāyau camupasthake // vinyaset pṛthivītattvaṃ ṅakāraṃ pādayugmake /
english: the hands, a wise man should place the letter ja in the feet, cha in the anus and ca in the genitals. The letter ṅa symbolising the principle of earth should be placed on the feet.

sanskrit: vastau ghakāraṃ gaṃ tattvaṃ taijasaṃ hṛdi vinyaset //
english: The letter gha should be placed in the pelvis. The letter ga representing the principle of lustre should.

sanskrit: khakāraṃ vāyutattvañca nāsikāyāṃ niveśayet /
english: The letter kha which represents the principle of wind should be placed in the nose.

sanskrit: kakāraṃ vinyasennityaṃ khatattvaṃ mastake budhaḥ //
english: The letter ka signifying the principle of ether should be assigned to the forehead by the wise.

sanskrit: hṛtpuṇḍarīke vinyasya yakāraṃ sūryadaivataṃ / dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi hṛdayādabhiniḥsṛtāḥ //
english: The letter ya denoting lord Sun having been placed in the lotus of the heart, the letter sa possessing sixteen digits should be placed in the seventytwo thousand rays emanating from the lotus heart.

sanskrit: kalāṣoḍaśasaṃyuktaṃ makāraṃ tatra vinyaset / tanmadhye cintayenmantrī vinduṃ vahnestu maṇḍalaṃ //
english: The priest fully initiated in the mystic syllables should contemplate on the point bindu representing the region of fire in the middle of it. The excellent letter ha along with the syllable oṃ praṇava should be placed there.

sanskrit: oṃ āṃ parameṣṭhyātmane āṃ namaḥ puruṣātmane //
english: Oṃ, āṃ, salutations to the parameṣtyātman. Āṃ, salutations to puruṣātman.

sanskrit: oṃ vāṃ manonivṛttyātmane nāñca viśvātmane namaḥ / oṃ vaṃ namaḥ sarvātmane ity uktāḥ pañca śaktayaḥ //
english: Oṃ, Vāṃ, salutations to the eternal being! Nāṃ, salutations to the soul of the universe! Oṃ, vāṃ, salutations to the soul of all beings! Thus the five forms of energies have been described.

sanskrit: sthāne tu prathamā yojyā dvitīyā āsane matā / tṛtīyā śayane tadvaccaturthī pānakarmaṇi //
english: The first one of the above five syllables should be used for the place, the second one for the seat, the third one for the bed, and the fourth one for the drink.

sanskrit: pratyarcāyāṃ pañcamī syātpañcopaniṣadaḥ smṛtāḥ /
english: The fifth one is used at every worship. These five mystic syllables are known as the five upaniṣads.

sanskrit: hūṅkāraṃ vinyasenmadhye dhyātvā mantramayaṃ hariṃ //
english: The syllable huṃ should be placed in the middle after having contemplated on Hari, composed of mystic syllables.

sanskrit: yāṃ mūrtiṃ sthāpayettasmāt mūlamantraṃ nyasettataḥ /
english: Whichever form of the deity is being installed one should assign the particular principal mystic syllable of that form afterwards.

sanskrit: oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya mūlakaṃ //
english: The principal syllable of Vāsudeva is Oṃ, salutations to Lord Vāsudeva!

sanskrit: śiroghrāṇalalāṭeṣu mukhakaṇṭhahṛdi kramāt / bhujayorjaṅghayoraṅghyroḥ keśavaṃ śirasi nyaset //
english: The different forms of the god should be mentally assigned to the different parts of the body such as the head, nose, forehead, face, neck, heart, arms, shanks and feet in order.

sanskrit: nārāyaṇaṃ nyasedvaktre grīvāyāṃ mādhavaṃ nyaset / govindaṃ bhujayornyasya viṣṇuṃ ca hṛdaye nyaset //
english: The manifestation known as Keśava should be assigned to the head of the image. Nārāyaṇa should be assigned to the face, Madhava to the neck, Govinda to the arms, and Viṣṇu to the heart.

sanskrit: madhusūdanakaṃ pṛṣṭhe vāmanaṃ jaṭhare nyaset / kakṣyāntrivikramaṃ nyasya jaṅghāyāṃ śrīdharaṃ nyaset //
english: Madhusūdana should be assigned to the hinder part, Vāmana to the belly, Trivikrama to the hip and Śrīdhara to the shank.

sanskrit: dāmodaraṃ pādayoś ca hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgakaṃ //
english: Hṛṣīkeśa should be assigned on the right side, Padmanābha on the ankle, Dāmodara on the feet.

sanskrit: etat sādhāraṇaṃ proktamādirmūrtestu sattama /
english: This is assignment in the six limbs commencing with the heart.

sanskrit: athavā yasya devasya prārabdhaṃ sthāpanaṃ bhavet // tasyaiva mūlamantreṇa sajīvakaraṇaṃ bhavet /
english: In the alternative, the installation of which form of the deity has been begun, one should infuse life into the image with the principal mystic syllable of that form.

sanskrit: yasyā mūrtestu yannāma tasyādyaṃ cākṣaraṃ ca yat // tat svairair dvādaśair bhedya hy aṅgāni parikalpayet /
english: The first letter of the name of any form of a deity should be used along with the twelve vowels and assigned to the different parts of image such as the heart.

sanskrit: hṛdayādīni deveśa mūlañca daśamākṣaraṃ //
english: O Lord of celestials! the principal mystic syllable should consist of ten syllables.

sanskrit: yathā deve tathā dehe tattvāni viniyojayet /
english: The principles should be placed in the body in the same order as they are found in the god.

sanskrit: cakrābjamaṇdale viṣṇuṃ yajedgandhādinā tathā //
english: Lord Viṣṇu should be worshipped with perfumes etc., in the diagram of a lotus inscribed in a circle.

sanskrit: pūrvavaccāsanaṃ dhyāyetsagātraṃ saparicchadaṃ /
english: One should contemplate on the seat as before together with the limbs and cover.

sanskrit: śubhañcakraṃ dvādaśāraṃ hy upariṣṭādvicintayet //
english: Then one should imagine an auspicious disc over that as having twelve radii.

sanskrit: trinābhicakraṃ dvinemi svaraistacca samanvitaṃ /
english: The circle should be imagined as having three concentric naves and two outer circles and filled with the vowels.

sanskrit: pṛṣṭhadeśe tataḥ prājñaḥ prakṛtyādīnniveśayet //
english: The wise man should then place the prakṛti the nature, the source of the material world and other principles.

sanskrit: pūjayedārakāgreṣu sūryaṃ dvādaśadhā punaḥ / kalāṣoḍaśasaṃyuktaṃ somantatra vicintayet //
english: The sun god should again be worshipped at the tips of the spokes in the twelvefold way and the moon possessing threefold armies and sixteen phases should be contemplated therein.

sanskrit: padmañca dvādaśadalaṃ padmamadhye vicintayet // tanmadhye pauruṣīṃ śaktiṃ dhyātvābhyarcya ca diśikaḥ /
english: The excellent worshipper should contemplate on a lotus flower of twelve petals. The effulgent energy of the supreme being should be contemplated and worshipped in the centre of the lotus flower by the priest.

sanskrit: pratimāyāṃ hariṃ nyasya tatra taṃ pūjayet surān //
english: Having located Lord Hari in that image, one should worship him as well as the celestials.

sanskrit: gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ samyak sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ kramāt / dvādaśākṣaravījaistu keśavādīn samarcayet //
english: Keśava and others should be worshipped well with twelve mystic letters with perfumes, flowers etc. and with their attendants and enclosures in due order.

sanskrit: dvādaśāre maṇḍale tu laukapālādikaṃ kramāt /
english: The twiceborn should worship the guardian deities of quarters and others in the circular diagram of twelve radii.

sanskrit: pratimāmarcayet paścādgandhapuṣpādibhirdvijaḥ // pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena śriyāḥ sūktena piṇḍikāṃ / jananādikramāt paścājjanayedvaiṣṇavānalaṃ //
english: The image should then be worshipped with perfumes and flowers and with the puruṣasūkta. The pedestal should be worshipped with the śrīsūkta. The sacrificial fire relating to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: hutvāgniṃ hutamiti kuṇḍegniṃ praṇayedbudhaḥ / agnipraṇayane mantrastvamagne hy agnirucyate //
english: Having made oblation unto the fire with the sacred syllables the wise priest should sanctify waters and consecrate the image by sprinkling waters.

sanskrit: dakṣiṇegniṃ hutamiti kuṇḍegniṃ praṇayedbudhaḥ / agnimagnīti pūrve tu kuṇḍegniṃ praṇayedbudhaḥ // uttare praṇayedagnimagnimagnī havāmahe / agnipraṇayane mantrastvamagne hy agnirucyate //
english: The wise priest should kindle fire in the pit on thesouth with the mystic syllable agniṃ hutaṃ and in the pit on the east with the syllable agnim agnim. In the fire pit on the north, the fire should be kindled with the mystic syllable agnim agniṃ havīmabhiḥ and the sacred syllable to be used to kindle fire in general is tvam agnehyagnirucyase.

sanskrit: palāśasamidhānāntu aṣṭottarasahasrakaṃ / kuṇḍe kuṇḍe homayecca vrīhīn vedādikais tathā // sājyāṃstilān vyāhṛtibhirmūlamantreṇa vai ghṛtaṃ /
english: One should place one thousand and eight twigs of the palāśa tree in each one of the fire pits and offer grains with vedic hymns. Clarified butter and sesamum should be offered to fire with the vyāhṛtis Oṃ bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, suvaḥ and ghee with the principal mantra.

sanskrit: kuryāttataḥ śāntihomaṃ madhuratritayena ca //
english: One should perform the appeasing oblation with the three sweet things.

sanskrit: dvādaśārṇaiḥ spṛśet pādau nābhiṃ hṛn mastakaṃ tataḥ /
english: One should then touch the feet, navel, heart and forehead with the utterance of twelve mystic syllables of the god.

sanskrit: ghṛtaṃ dadhi payo hutvā spṛśenmūrdhanyatho tataḥ //
english: After having offered ghee, curd and milk, the head of the image should again be touched.

sanskrit: spṛṣṭvā śironābhipādāṃś catasraḥ sthāpayennadīḥ / gaṅgā ca yamunā godā kramānnāmnā sarasvatī //
english: After having touched the head, navel, and feet, the priest should make four rivers Gaṅgā, Yamunā, Godāvarī and Sarasvatī present there by pronouncing their names.

sanskrit: dahettu viṣṇugāyatryā gāyatryā śrapayeccaruṃ /
english: The rivers should be dried up by the recitation of the viṣṇugāyatrī and the sacrificial gruel should be boiled with the recitation of the gāyatrī.

sanskrit: homayecca baliṃ dadyāduttare bhojayeddvijān // sāmādhipānāṃ tuṣṭyarthaṃ hemagāṃ gurave dadet / dikpatibhyo baliṃ dattvā rātrau kuryācca jāgaraṃ /
english: One should offer oblation, offer the victim and feed the twiceborns afterwards. For the satisfaction of the singer of sāmans one should give gold and cows to the spiritual preceptor. Having made offerings to the guardian deities of the quarters, one should spend night in vigil.

sanskrit: brahmagītādiśabdena sarvabhāgadhivāsanāt //
english: By singing the praise of the brahman one gets fruits of the consecration rite.

sanskrit: piṇḍikāsthāpanārthantu garbhāgāraṃ tu saptadhā /
english: One should divide the length of adytum into seven parts for the installation of the pedestal.

sanskrit: vibhajed brahmabhāge tu pratimāṃ sthāpayed budhaḥ //
english: The wise man should fix the image on the part of Brahman.

sanskrit: devamanuṣapaiśācabhāgeṣu na kadācana / brahmabhāgaṃ parityajya kiñcidāśritya cāṇḍaja //
english: One should never fix it in the parts presided over by the celestials, mortals and goblins, leaving out the part presided over by Brahman.

sanskrit: devamānuṣabhāgābhyāṃ sthāpyā yatnāttu piṇḍikā /
english: The pedestal should be carefully fixed off the regions of celestials and mortals.

sanskrit: napuṃsakakaśilāyāntu ratnanyāsaṃ samācaret // nārasiṃhena hutvā ratnanyāsaṃ ca tena vai /
english: Gems should be imbedded in the case of a hermaphrodite stone. Having performed oblation with the mantra sacred to Narasiṃha the manlion form of Viṣṇu, the gems.

sanskrit: vrīhīn ratnāṃstridhātūṃś ca lohādīṃś candanādikān // pūrvādinavagarteṣu nyasen madhye yathāruci /
english: Rice grains, gems, three kinds of minerals, iron and other metallic substances, sandal wood etc., should be placed in the nine holes commencing with the east at the centre as one likes.

sanskrit: atha cendrādimantraiś ca garto guggulunāvṛtaḥ // ratnanyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā pratimāmālabhedguruḥ / saśalākair darbhapuñjaiś ca sahadevaiḥ samanvitaiḥ //
english: Then the holes should be filled with the guggulu a kind of fragrant gum resin with the recitation of the mantrasindra etc. After having performed the insertion of gems, the preceptor should rub the image with sticks of sahadeva tree and bunches of darbha grass.

sanskrit: savāhyantaiś ca saṃskṛtya pañcagavyena śodhayet /
english: The outer and inner surface of the image should be cleansed and then purified with the pañcagavya the five things got from a cow.

sanskrit: prokṣayeddarbhatoyena nadītīrthodakena ca //
english: Water should be sprinkled with the darbha. grass as well as with the waters of the river.

sanskrit: homārthe khaṇḍilaṃ kuryāt sikatābhiḥ samantataḥ /
english: The ground for kindling the sacrificial fire should be made ready with sand.

sanskrit: sārdhahastapramāṇaṃ tu caturasraṃ suśobhanaṃ //
english: An excellent site should be of the measure of a. cubit and a half on all sides.

sanskrit: aṣṭadikṣu yathānyāsaṃ kalaśānapi vinyaset / pūrvādyānaṣṭavarṇena agnimānīya saṃskṛtaṃ //
english: The pitchers also should be placed in the eight directions commencing with the east. The consecrated fire should be brought in uttering the eight letters described already.

sanskrit: tvamagnedyubhiriti gāyatryā samidho hunet /
english: The twigs should be offered into the fire with the mantrastvam agne dyubhiḥ and gāyatrī.

sanskrit: aṣṭārṇenāṣṭaśatakaṃ ājyaṃ pūrṇāṃ pradāpayet //
english: Clarified butter should be offered with the recitation of eight letters, eight hundred times.

sanskrit: śāntyudakaṃ āmrapatraiḥ mūlena śatamantritaṃ / siñceddevasya tanmūrdhni śrīś ca te hy anayā ṛcā //
english: The appeasing water sanctified hundred times by the principal mantra should be sprinkled on the head of the image with the recitation of the hymn śrīśca te.

sanskrit: brahmayānena coddhṛtya uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate / tadviṣṇoriti mantreṇa prāsādābhimukhaṃ nayet //
english: The image should be lifted up with the mantra brahmajajñāna and should be led to the temple with the mantra uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaṣpate and tadviṣṇoḥ.

sanskrit: śivikāyāṃ hariṃ sthāpya bhrāmayīta purādikaṃ / gītavedādiśabdaiś ca prāsādadvāri dhārayet //
english: Lord Hari should be placed in a palanquin and carried towards the divine edifice accompanied by songs and vedic hymns. He should be held at the gates of the temple.

sanskrit: strībhirviprair maṅgalāṣṭaghaṭaiḥ saṃsnāpayeddhariṃ /
english: Lord Hari should be bathed with waters from eight auspicious pitchers by women and brahmins.

sanskrit: tato gandhādinābhyarcya mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ //
english: Then the priest should worship the image with perfumes etc. and with the principal mantra.

sanskrit: ato deveti vastrādyamaṣṭāṅgārghyaṃ nivedya ca /
english: Then the dress, the devotional offerings of eight kinds should be offered with the mantra ato devā.

sanskrit: sthire lagne piṇḍikāyāṃ devasya tveti dhārayet //
english: The image should be fixed on the pedestal at the fixed moment with the recitation of devasya tvā.

sanskrit: oṃ trailokyavikrāntāya namastestu trivikrama /
english: “O Conqueror of three spaces! Oṃ! salutations to you who surpassed the three regions”.

sanskrit: dhruvā dyauriti mantreṇa viśvataś cakṣurityapi / pañcagavyena saṃsnāpya kṣālya gandhadakena ca //
english: The image should be bathed with the pañcagavya five things got from a cow with the recitation of the mantra dhruvā dyauḥ and viśvatascakṣuḥ and bathed again with perfumed water.

sanskrit: pūjayet sakalīkṛtya sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ hariṃ /
english: Lord Hari should be worshipped along with the attendants and paraphernalia.

sanskrit: dhyāyet svaṃ tasya mūrtintu pṛthivī tasya pīṭhikā // kalpayedvigrahaṃ tasya taijasaiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ /
english: The heavens should be contemplated as his form and the earth as the seat. His body should be imagined as composed of lustrous minute particles.

sanskrit: jīvamāvāhayiṣyāmi pañcaviṃśatitattvagaṃ //
english: One should say, “ am invoking his spirit pervading the twentyfive principles.”

sanskrit: caitanyaṃ paramānandaṃ jāgratsvapnavivarjitaṃ / dehendriyamanobuddhiprāṇāhaṅkāravarjitaṃ // brahmādistambaparyantaṃ hṛdayeṣu vyavasthitaṃ / hṛdayāt pratimāvimbe sthiro bhava pareśvara //
english: O Supreme Lord! you become firmly established in the image. invoke you, the spirit of supreme happiness, one devoid of three states waking, dreaming and deep sleep, one who is devoid of a body, senseorgans, intellect, life and egoism, and one who resides in the hearts of all beings beginning with Brahman and ending with a dump of grass.

sanskrit: sajīvaṃ kuru bimbaṃ tvaṃ savāhyābhyantarasthitaḥ /
english: You make the image imbued with your soul both inside and outside.

sanskrit: aṅguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣo dehopādhiṣu saṃsthitaḥ //
english: You have taken your abode in this image of the size of a thumb with attributes.

sanskrit: jyotirjñānaṃ paraṃ brahma ekamevādvitīyakaṃ / sajīvīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā praṇavena nibodhayet //
english: Having invoked the god in the image, the supreme brahman, lustrous form of knowledge and who is one without a second, that is deemed as alive by the use of the mantra Oṃ.

sanskrit: sānnidhyakaraṇannāma hṛdayaṃ spṛśya vai japet /
english: The act of bringing the god near consists in uttering the mantra and touching the heart of the image.

sanskrit: sūktantu pauruṣaṃ dhyāyan idaṃ guhyamanuṃ japet //
english: The priest should recite the puruṣasūkta and should recite the following mantra in secret.

sanskrit: namastestu sureśāya santoṣavibhavātmane / jñānavijñānarūpāya brahmatejonuyāyine //
english: Salutations to the Lord of celestials who is of the form of happiness and fortune, of the form of knowledge and wisdom and who attends on the lustre of the supreme brahman.

sanskrit: guṇātikrāntaveśāya puruṣāya mahātmane /
english: Salutations to the one who is beyond properties, the great being, devoid of decay, old age.

sanskrit: akṣayāya purāṇāya viṣṇo sannihito bhava //
english: O Viṣṇu, you be present here.

sanskrit: yacca te paramaṃ tattvaṃ yacca jñānamayaṃ vapuḥ / tat sarvamekato līnamasmindehe vibudhyatāṃ //
english: Whichever is the supreme principle in you and that which is your form verily made up of knowledge, all that be present here in this form. May you awake!

sanskrit: ātmānaṃ sannidhīkṛtya brahmādiparivārakān / svanāmnā sthāpayedanyānāyudhān svamudrayā //
english: Stationing oneself in from of the deity, the priest should establish Brahman and other attendant gods as well as the respective weapons by showing the mudrā different postures shown with the hand.

sanskrit: yātrāvarṣādikaṃ dṛṣṭvā jñeyaḥ sannihito hariḥ /
english: The priest should infer the presence of the god from the yātrā and varṣā.

sanskrit: natvā stutvā stavādyaiś ca japtvā cāṣṭākṣarādikaṃ // caṇḍapracaṇḍau dvārasthau nirgatyābhyarcayedguruḥ / agnimaṇḍapamāsādya garuḍaṃ sthāpya pūjayet //
english: Having saluted and sung the glories and recited the mantras of eight syllables etc., the priest should come out and worship Caṇḍa and Pracaṇḍa the two guardians at the gate. The priest should go to the place of sacrificial fire, install the image of Garuḍa the vehicle bird of Lord Viṣṇu and worship.

sanskrit: digīśān diśi devāṃś ca sthāpya sampūjya deśikaḥ / viśvaksenaṃ tu saṃsthāpya śaṅkhacakrādi pūjayet //
english: Having installed and worshipped the images of different presiding deities of the quarters in their respective quarters, the priest should install the image of Lord Viṣvaksena and worship the conch, disc etc.

sanskrit: sarvapārṣadakebhyaś ca baliṃ bhūtebhya arcayet / paramavastrasuvarṇādi gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadet //
english: Offerings should be made to the attendant gods and to the goblins. The priest should be given the feeswhich may be of the form of proprietary right over a village, clothes and gold.

sanskrit: yāgopayogidravyādyamācāryāya narorpayet / ācāryadakṣiṇārdhantu ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadet //
english: The materials required for the performance of sacrificial ceremony should be given to the principal priest. The attendant priests should be paid fees half of what was paid to the principal priest.

sanskrit: anyebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādbhojayed brāhmaṇāṃstataḥ /
english: The other priests should be paid their fees. The brahmins should then be fed.

sanskrit: avāritān phalān dadyādyajamānāya vai guruḥ //
english: Without any restraint the benefits of sacrifice should be extended to the patronemployer by the principal priest.

sanskrit: viṣṇuṃ nayet pratiṣṭhātā cātmanā sakalaṃ kulaṃ /
english: The consecrator of the image of Viṣṇu leads the self,. as well as his entire family to the region of the god.

sanskrit: sarveṣāmeva devānāmeṣa sādhāraṇo vidhiḥ /
english: This is the general mode of performance for all gods.

sanskrit: mūlamantrāḥ pṛthakteṣāṃ śeṣaṃ kāryaṃ samānakaṃ //
english: Only the principal mantra would be different. The other formalities are the same. ṚV. ...

sanskrit: vakṣe cāvabhṛtasnānaṃ viṣṇor natveti homayet /
english: An epithet of Viṣṇu. shall describe the purificatory bathing of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: ekāśītipade kumbhān sthāpya saṃsthāpayeddhariṃ //
english: Having placed eightyone pitchers at their respective places Lord Hari should be invoked and installed.

sanskrit: pūjayed gandhapuṣpādyair baliṃ datvā guruṃ yajet /
english: He should be worshipped with perfumes and flowers. Having made the offering, the priest should be worshipped.

sanskrit: dvārapratiṣṭhāṃ vakṣyāmi dvārādho hema vai dadet //
english: l shall describe the mode of consecrating the door.

sanskrit: aṣṭabhiḥ kalaśaiḥ sthāpya śākhodumbarakau guruḥ / gandhādibhiḥ samabhyarcya mantrair vedādibhirguruḥ //
english: A piece of gold should be placed beneath the door frame. The priest should place shoots of udumbara fig tree in the mouth of the eight pitchers and worship them with perfumes etc. and vedic mantras.

sanskrit: kuṇḍeṣu homayedvahniṃ samillājatilādibhiḥ /
english: Twigs, fried paddy and sesamum should be offered unto the fire in the pits.

sanskrit: datvā śayyādikañcādho dadyādādhāraśaktikāṃ //
english: Having offered the bed etc., the supporting energy should be placed underneath.

sanskrit: śākhayorvinyasenmūle devau caṇḍapracaṇdakau / ūrdhvodumbarake devīṃ lakṣmīṃ suragaṇārcitāṃ //
english: Gods Caṇḍa and Pracaṇḍa should be located at the bottom of the shoots, Goddess Lakṣmī worshipped by the celestials should be placed above the shoot of the fig tree.

sanskrit: nyasyābhyarcya yathānyāyaṃ śrīsūktena caturmukhaṃ / datvā tu śrīphalādīni ācāryādestu dakṣiṇāṃ //
english: Having assigned the fourfaced Brahman and duly worshipping him by reciting the śrīsūkta the fruits of the bilva tree should be offered to him and the fees should be paid to the priest.

sanskrit: pratiṣṭhāsiddhadvārasya tvācāryaḥ sthāpayeddhariṃ / prāsādādasya pratiṣṭhantu hṛtpratiṣṭheti tāṃ śṛṇu //
english: shall describe the consecration of the divine edifice the doors of which have been consecrated and wherein the image of Hari has been duly installed. It is in the consecration of the adytum. Listen.

sanskrit: sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ kumbhamathavā śuklanirmitaṃ // aṣṭaratnauṣadhīdhātuvījalauhānvitaṃ śubhaṃ / savastraṃ pūritaṃ cādbhirmaṇḍale cādhivāsayet //
english: Pitcher made of gold, silver or bellmetal filled with eight kinds of gems, herbs, minerals, seeds of grains, iron and water and covered with a cloth should be placed on the darbha grass in a circle to the east of the altar after the śukanāsa the keystone has been got ready.

sanskrit: sapallavaṃ nṛsiṃhena hutvā sampātasañcitaṃ / nārāyaṇākhyatattvena prāṇabhūtaṃ nyasettataḥ //
english: Fallen twigs which have been gathered should be offered into fire with the mantra of Nṛsiṃha. Then the temple should be enlivened with the principle known as nārāyaṇatattva.

sanskrit: vairājabhūtāntaṃ dhyāyet prāsādasya sureśvara /
english: That lord who is the life of the temple should be contemplated as “O Lord of celestials”.

sanskrit: tataḥ puruṣavatsarvaṃ prāsādaṃ cintayed budhaḥ //
english: Then a wise man has to imagine the temple as the god himself.

sanskrit: adho datvā suvarṇaṃ tu tadvavad bhūtaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyaset /
english: A piece of gold should be placed below the golden pitcher.

sanskrit: gurvādau dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād brāhmaṇādeś ca bhojanaṃ //
english: The priests and others should be paid their fees and the brahmins should be fed.

sanskrit: kaṇṭhopariṣṭāt kartavyaṃ vimalāmalasārakaṃ // tadūrdhvaṃ vṛkalaṃ kuryāccakrañcādyaṃ sudarśanaṃ /
english: Threads should be wound round the altar, neck, top and the globe of the temple after that. Then the metallic ring known as the sudarśana disc should be placed.

sanskrit: mūttiṃ śrīvāsudevasya grahaguptāṃ nivedayet //
english: It should be known as the form of Lord Vāsudeva offering protection from fear.

sanskrit: kalaśaṃ vātha kurvīta tadūrdhvaṃ cakramuttamaṃ /
english: Alternatively a pitcher should be placed in the place of a globe and the disc above that.

sanskrit: vedyāś ca paritaḥ sthāpyā aṣṭau vighneśvarāstvaja //
english: O birthless one! eight lords of obstacles Vighneśvara should be placed around the altar in the temple.

sanskrit: catvāro vā caturdikṣu sthāpanīyā garutmataḥ /
english: Or four images of Garuḍa vehicle of Lord Viṣṇu should be placed in the four quarters.

sanskrit: dhvajārohaṃ ca vakṣyāmi yena bhūtādi naśyati //
english: shall describe now the erection of the flagstaff which destroys the evil spirits.

sanskrit: prāsādavimbadravyāṇāṃ yāvantaḥ paramāṇavaḥ / tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi tatkartā viṣṇulokabhāk //
english: One who performs this remains in the regions of Viṣṇu for so many thousands of years as the number of atoms in the image of the god in the temple.

sanskrit: kumbhāṇḍavedivimbānāṃ bhramaṇādvāyunānagha / kaṇṭhasyāveṣṭanāj jñeyaṃ phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ dhvajāt //
english: O sinless! It should be known that a man gets a crore times more merit by erecting the flagstaff,since it surrounds the neck of the temple and it wafts the wind around the globe, altar and image.

sanskrit: patākānāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi daṇḍaṃ puruṣarūpiṇaṃ / prāsādaṃ vāsudevasya mūrtibhedaṃ nibodha me //
english: The flag should be known as the prakṛti and the staff as the puruṣa and you know that the temple is another form of image of Vāsudeva Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: dhāraṇāddharaṇīṃ viddhi ākāśaṃ śuṣirātmakaṃ / tejastat pāvakaṃ viddhi vāyuṃ sparśagataṃ tathā //
english: In a temple the dharaṇī earth is so called from its ability to hold, its internal cavity stands for the sky, the illumination inside represents the fire, and its touch represents the wind.

sanskrit: pāṣāṇādiṣveva jalaṃ pārthivaṃ pṛthivīguṇaṃ /
english: The earthly waters found in the stone slabs of the temple represent the earthly attributes.

sanskrit: pratiśabdodbhavaṃ śabdaṃ sparśaṃ syāt karkaśādikaṃ //
english: Its echo stands for the principles of sound. Its touch represents roughness.

sanskrit: śuklādikaṃ bhavedrūpaṃ rasamannādidarśanaṃ / dhūpādigandhaṃ gandhantu vāg bheryādiṣu saṃsthitā //
english: Its colour which may be white or otherwise stands for the subtle principle of colour. The food and other eatables offered to the deity stand for the sense of taste. The perfumes represent the sense of smell.

sanskrit: śukanāśāśritā nāsā bāhū tadrathakau smṛtau /
english: The two apertures on either side represent the two hands.

sanskrit: śirastvaṇḍaṃ nigaditaṃ kalaśaṃ mūrdhajaṃ smṛtaṃ // kaṇṭhaṃ kaṇṭhamiti jñeyaṃ skandhaṃ vedī nigadyete /
english: Its neck should be known as the neck. The platform over the fault is spoken as the shoulder. The outlets for water are the anus and genitals. The limeplaster is spoken as the skin.

sanskrit: mukhaṃ dvāraṃ bhavedasya pratimā jīva ucyate /
english: The door would be the mouth. The image installed in the temple is said to be its life.

sanskrit: tacchaktiṃ piṇḍikāṃ viddhi prakṛtiṃ ca tadākṛtiṃ //
english: The pedestal should be known as its energy. Its shape should likewise be known as its animation.

sanskrit: niś calatvañca garbhosyā adhiṣṭhātā tu keśavaḥ /
english: Its cavity is its inertia. Lord Keśava is its controller.

sanskrit: evameva hariḥ sākṣātprāsādatvena saṃsthitaḥ //
english: In this way Lord Hari Himself remains in the form of the temple.

sanskrit: jaṅghā tvasya śivo jñeyaḥ skandhe dhātā vyavasthitaḥ /
english: God Śiva should be known as the shank.

sanskrit: ūrdhvabhāge sthito viṣṇurevaṃ tasya sthitasya hi //
english: God Brahman is located in the shoulder. Lord Viṣṇu remains in the upper portion of a temple as it is.

sanskrit: prāsādasya pratiṣṭhāntu dhvajarūpeṇa me śṛṇu /
english: Listen to me. shall describe the consecration of a temple by means of a banner.

sanskrit: dhvajaṃ kṛtvā surair daityā jitāḥ śastrādicihnitaṃ //
english: The demons were defeated by the celestial gods by erecting banners impressed with the signs of divine weapons.

sanskrit: aṇḍordhvaṃ kalaśaṃ nyasya tadūrdhvaṃ vinyaseddhvajaṃ /
english: The pitcher shaped part of the temple should be placed over the top and the flag should be placed over the same.

sanskrit: vimbārdhamānaṃ daṇḍasya tribhāgenātha kārayet // aṣṭāraṃ dvādaśāraṃ vā madhye mūrtimatānvitaṃ /
english: The post should be made to measure a half or one third of the height of the image. The flag should have a mark of a circle of eight or twelve radii.

sanskrit: nārasiṃhena tārkṣyeṇa dhvajadaṇḍastu nirbraṇaḥ // prāsādasya tu vistāro mānaṃ daṇḍasya kīrtitaṃ /
english: There should be the figure of the manlion form of Viṣṇu or the Garuḍa Tārkṣya inside the circle in the middle. The staff of the flag should not have any cut. The length of the staff is spoken as the measure of the breadth of edifice.

sanskrit: śikharārdhena vā kuryāt tṛtīyārdhena vā punaḥ //
english: It should be made either half of the terrace or a third part of it.

sanskrit: dvārasya dairghyād dviguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ vā parikalpayet / dhvajayaṣṭirdevagṛhe aiśānyāṃ vāyavethavā //
english: The staff should otherwise be made twice the length of the door. The flag staff should be planted on the northeast or the northwest of the divine edifice.

sanskrit: kṣaumādyaiś ca dhvajaṃ kuryādvicitraṃ vaikavarṇakaṃ / ghaṇṭācāmarakiṅkiṇyā bhūṣitaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ //
english: The flag should be made of a piece of silk cloth, of a single or variegated colours. It should be adorned with bells, chowries and small bells. It is said to be destroyer of sins.

sanskrit: daṇḍāgrāddharaṇīṃ yāvaddhastaikaṃ vistareṇa tu / mahādhvajaḥ sarvadaḥ syātturyāṃśāddhīnatorcitaḥ //
english: A flag which touches the ground and measures a cubit in breadth at its extremity or has a breadth equal to one fourth of its length at its base is called a mahādhvaja. It grants all things when worshipped.

sanskrit: vistareṇa dhvajaḥ kāryo viṃśadaṅgulasannibhaḥ //
english: The banner should measure half the dimension of the staff. The breadth should measure twenty fingers.

sanskrit: adhivāsavidhānena cakraṃ daṇḍaṃ dhvajaṃ tathā / devavat sakalaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍapasnapanādikaṃ //
english: All the rites relating to the consentration of an image should be done for the consecration of the disc, flag and the staff. They should be bathed in the shed.

sanskrit: netronmīlanakaṃ tyaktā pūrvoktaṃ sarvamācaret /
english: The priest should duly perform all rites described earlier except that of opening the eyes.

sanskrit: adhivāsayecca vidhinā śayyāyāṃ sthāpya deśikaḥ //
english: The consecration should be done in the prescribed manner leaving them in the resting position.

sanskrit: tataḥ sahasraśīrṣeti sūktaṃ cakre nyased budhaḥ /
english: Then the learned priest should assign mentally the hymn called sahasraśīrṣā in the disc.

sanskrit: tathā sudarśanaṃ mantraṃ manastattvaṃ niveśayet //
english: Then the sudarśana mantra and the principle of mind should be assigned.

sanskrit: manorūpeṇa tasyaiva sajīvakaraṇaṃ smṛtaṃ /
english: It is known as imbued with life by mental formation.

sanskrit: areṣu mūrtayo nyasyāḥ keśavādyāḥ surottama //
english: O excellent among gods, the different forms of Viṣṇu such as Keśava etc.

sanskrit: nābhyabjapratinemīṣu nyasettattvāni deśikaḥ /
english: should be assigned to the spokes.

sanskrit: nṛsiṃhaṃ viśvarūpaṃ vā abjamadhye niveśayet //
english: The form of Nṛsiṃha the manlion form of Viṣṇu representing the universe should be assigned to the middle of the lotus.

sanskrit: sakalaṃ vinyaseddaṇḍe sūtrātmānaṃ sajīvakaṃ /
english: The sakala endowed with parts forms should be assigned to the staff as the living soul of it.

sanskrit: niṣkalaṃ paramātmānaṃ dhvaje dhyāyan nyaseddhariṃ //
english: Lord Hari, the supreme being of the niṣkala undivided form should be contemplated and assigned to the flag.

sanskrit: tacchaktiṃ vyāpinīṃ dhyāyed dhvajarūpāṃ balābalāṃ /
english: The energies Bala and Abala which manifest in the form of the banner should be contemplated.

sanskrit: maṇḍape sthāpya cābhyarcya homaṃ kuṇḍeṣu kārayet //
english: Having placed it in the shed and worshipped it, oblation should be made in the pit.

sanskrit: kalaśe svarṇakalaśaṃ nyasya ratnāni pañca ca / sthāpayeccakramantreṇa svarṇacakramadhastataḥ // pāradena tu samplāvya netrapaṭṭena cchādayet /
english: Having placed the golden pitcher over the pitcher and putting five kinds of gems at the top of the temple a golden disc should be placed underneath that with the mantra of the disc. The disc should be washed with mercury and covered with the eyecover.

sanskrit: tato niveśayeccakraṃ tanmadhye nṛhariṃ smaret //
english: The disc should then be placed. Lord Nṛhari manlion form of Viṣṇushould be imagined there in the middle.

sanskrit: oṃ kṣoṃ nṛsiṃhāya namaḥ pūjayet sthāpayeddhariṃ /
english: Oṃ, kṣauṃ, salutations to Lord Nṛsiṃha. Lord Hari should be invoked and worshipped.

sanskrit: tato dhvajaṃ gṛhītvā tu yajamānaḥ sabāndhavaḥ // dadhibhaktayute pātre dhvajasyāgraṃ niveśayet /
english: Then the yajamāna the person who has arranged for the consecration accompanied by his relatives should hold banner and dip the tip of the banner in a vessel full of curd.

sanskrit: dhruvādyena phaḍantena dhvajaṃ mantreṇa pūjayet //
english: The banner should be worshipped with the mantra commencing with dhruvā and ending with phaṭ.

sanskrit: śirasyādhāya tat pātraṃ nārāyanamanusmaran / pradakṣiṇaṃ tu kurvīta turyamaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ //
english: Holding that vessel on the head and remembering Lord Nārāyaṇa the yajamiina should go around the temple along with auspicious sounds from the tūrī a musical instrument.

sanskrit: tato niveśayet daṇḍaṃ mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇa tu /
english: The staff should then be placed with the recitation of the eightsyllabled mantra.

sanskrit: muñcāmi tveti sūktena dhvajaṃ muñcedvicakṣaṇaḥ //
english: Then the flag should be hoisted and unfurled with the recitation of the hymn muñcāmi tvā by the learned person.

sanskrit: pātraṃ dhvajaṃ kuñjarādi dadyādācāryake dvijaḥ /
english: The twiceborn yajamāna should give the priest the vessel, banner and elephant etc.

sanskrit: eṣa sādhāraṇaḥ prokto dhvajasyārohaṇe vidhiḥ //
english: Mode of consecration of the flag has been thus described in general.

sanskrit: yasya devasya yaccihnaṃ tanmantreṇa sthiraṃ caret /
english: The mark which represents a particular god should be planted with the respective mantra.

sanskrit: svargatvā dhvajadānāttu rājā balī bhavet //
english: By the offer of a banner one goes to heaven and becomes a strong monarch on the earth in the next birth.

sanskrit: samudāyena devādeḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ pravadāmi te /
english: shall describe to you the mode of installation of all divine images.

sanskrit: lakṣmyāḥ pratiṣṭhā prathamaṃ tathā devīgaṇasya ca //
english: At first shall describe the mode of installation of the image of Lakṣmī and her attendant goddesses.

sanskrit: pūrvavat sakalaṃ kuryānmaṇḍapasnapanādikaṃ /
english: As before, one should do all rites such as bathing the image in the shed.

sanskrit: bhadrapīṭhe śriyaṃ nyasya sthāpayedaṣṭa vai ghaṭān //
english: The image of goddess Lakṣmī should be placed on the pedestal. One should place eight pitchers.

sanskrit: ghṛtenābhyajya mūlena snapayet pañcagavyakaiḥ /
english: The image should be anointed with ghee with the principal mantra and washed with the five things got from a cow.

sanskrit: hiraṇyavarṇā hariṇī netre conmīlayecchriyāḥ //
english: The eyes of the goddess Lakṣmī should be opened with the recitation of the mantra hiraṇyavarṇām hariṇīm.

sanskrit: tanma āvaha ity evaṃ pradadyānmadhuratrayam /
english: The three sweet things should be offered with the recitation of the mantra tāṃ ma āvaha.

sanskrit: aśvapūrveti pūrveṇa tāṃ kumbhenābhiṣecayet //
english: She the image should be bathed with the waters of the pitcher on the east with the recitation of the hymn aśvapūrva.

sanskrit: kāmosmiteti yāmyena paścimenābhiṣecayet / candraṃ prabhāsāmuccāryādityavarṇeti cottarāt //
english: The image should then be bathed with the waters of.pitchers on the south, west and north with the recitation of hymns kāmosmi te, candram prabhāsām, āditya varṇa respectively

sanskrit: upaitu meti cāgneyāt kṣutpipāseti nairṛtāt / gandhadvāreti vāyavyāṃ manasaḥ kāmamākṛtim //
english: Waters from the pitchers placed in the southeast, southwest, northwest and northeast should be poured on the image accompanied by the recitation of the mantras upaitu mā, kṣut pipāsā, gandhadvāra, manasaḥ kāmamākṛti.

sanskrit: ekāśītighaṭaiḥ snānaṃ mantreṇāpaḥ sṛjan kṣitim //
english: The image should subsequently be bathed with the waters of eightyone pitchers accompanied by āpaḥ sṛjan kṣitim.

sanskrit: ārdrāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ gandhair ārdrāmityādipuṣpakaiḥ / tanmayāvaha mantreṇa ya ānanda ṛcākhilaṃ //
english: The priest should worship the image with perfumes accompanied by ārdrām puṣkariṇīm, with flowers accompanied by tāṃ ma āvaha and ya ānanda.

sanskrit: śāyantīyena śayyāyāṃ śrīsūktena ca sannidhim / lakṣmīvījena cicchaktiṃ vinyasyābhyarcayet punaḥ //
english: The goddess should be worshipped in the bed with the mantra śāyantī yena and her presence is accomplished by śrīsūkta. Her consciousness is invoked and worshipped again with.

sanskrit: śrīsūktena maṇḍapetha kuṇḍeṣvabjāni homayet /
english: the principal mantra of the goddess.

sanskrit: karavīrāṇi vā hutvā sahasraṃ śatameva vā //
english: Thousand or hundred lotus flowers or karavīra flowers.

sanskrit: gṛhopakaraṇāntādi śrīsūktenaiva cārpayet /
english: should be offered in the fire pit at the shed accompanied by śrīsūkta.

sanskrit: tataḥ prāsādasaṃskāraṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā tu pūrvavat //
english: Then the consecration of edifice should be performed as described earlier.

sanskrit: mantreṇa piṇḍikāṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhānaṃ tataḥ śriyaḥ /
english: The pedestal should be made with the recitation of the mantra. The installation of the goddess is done subsequently.

sanskrit: śrīsūktena ca sānnidhyaṃ pūrvavat pratyṛcaṃ japet //
english: Her presence is accomplished with the śrīsūkta. Everyone of the hymns stated earlier should be recited as before.

sanskrit: cicchaktiṃ bodhayitvā tu mālāt sānnidhyakaṃ caret /
english: Having invoked consciousness in the image, her presence is accomplished by the principal mantra.

sanskrit: bhūsvarṇavastragonnādi gurave brahmaṇerpayet /
english: The priest and the brahmins should be presented with land, gold, clothes, cow and food.

sanskrit: evaṃ devyo 'khilāḥ sthāpyāvāhya svargādi bhāvayet //
english: The images of all other forms of goddesses should be installed in the same way.

sanskrit: evaṃ tārkṣyasya cakrasya brahmaṇo nṛhares tathā /
english: One who invokes and consecrates in this way is held as going to heaven.

sanskrit: pratiṣṭhā viṣṇuvat kāryā svasvamantreṇa tāṃ śṛṇu //
english: . The installation of the images of Garuḍa vehicle of Viṣṇu Brahman, Nṛhari manlion form of Viṣṇu and of the sudarśana disc should be done in the same way as that of Viṣṇu with their respective mantras. Listen to me.

sanskrit: sudarśana mahācakra śānta duṣṭabhayaṅkara /
