english: O Sudarśana! The great disc that is tranquil! Dreadful to the wicked! Kill kill, pierce pierce, cut through and cut through.

sanskrit: abhyarcya cakraṃ cānena raṇe dārayete ripūn //
english: Having worshipped the disc with this mantra one destroys the enemies in the battle.

sanskrit: narasiṃhasya mantroyaṃ pātālākhyasya vacmi te /
english: Oṃ kṣauṃ Narasiṃha manlion! of fierce form! burn, burn, blaze up, blaze up, svāhā.

sanskrit: narasiṃhasya vidyeyaṃ harirūpārthasiddhidā // trilokyamohanair mantraiḥ sthāpyastrailokyamohanaḥ /
english: The captivator of the three worlds trailokyamohana the image of the lord should be installed with the mantras known as trailokyamohana captivating the three worlds described above.

sanskrit: gado dakṣe śāntikaro dvibhujo vā caturbhujaḥ //
english: The image should be made to have two or four arms, holding the mace in the right hand and conferring benediction.

sanskrit: vāmordhve kārayeccakraṃ pāñcajanyamatho hy adhaḥ /
english: The disc should be placed in the upper left arm and the conchshell pāñcajanya on the lower arm.

sanskrit: śrīpuṣṭisaṃyuktaṃ kuryād balena saha bhadrayā //
english: The two right hands should be provided with śrī riches and puṣṭi nourishment along with strength and welfare.

sanskrit: prāsāde sthāpayedviṣṇuṃ gṛhe vā maṇḍape 'pi vā / vāmanaṃ caiva vaikuṇṭhaṃ hayāsyamaniruddhakaṃ //
english: The images of Viṣṇu, Vāmana dwarf form of Viṣṇu, Vaikuṇṭha, Hayāsya horsefaced form of Viṣṇu and Aniruddha should be installed in a shed or house or edifice.

sanskrit: sthāpayejjalaśayyāsthaṃ matsyādīṃścāvatārakān /
english: The images of manifestations of Viṣṇu such as the fish etc. should be installed in waters.

sanskrit: saṅkarṣaṇaṃ viśvarūpaṃ liṅgaṃ vai rudramūrtikaṃ // ardhanārīśvaraṃ tadvaddhariśaṅkaramātṛkāḥ / bhairavaṃ ca tathā sūryaṃ grahāṃstadvināyakam // gaurīmindrādikāṃ lepyāṃ citrajāṃ ca balābalāṃ /
english: The images of Saṅkarṣaṇa, Viśvarūpa, liṅga, the form of Rudra, hermaphrodite form of Śiva Ardhanārīśvara, Hari Viṣṇu, Śaṅkara, Śiva, the divine mothers, Bhairava, Sūrya, the planets, Vināyaka, Gaurī consort of Śiva worshipped by Indra and others, Bala and Abala should also be installed similarly.

sanskrit: pustakānāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣye likhanatadvidhiṃ //
english: shall describe the mode of consecration of books and the mode of writing them.

sanskrit: svastike maṇḍale 'bhyarcya śarapatrāsane sthitaṃ / lekhyañca likhitaṃ pustaṃ gururvidyāṃ hariṃ yajet //
english: Having worshipped the manuscript and the written book on a seat made of kuśa grass placed on a svastika figure, the preceptor should worship the spell and Lord Hari Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: yajamāno guruṃ vidyāṃ hariṃ lipikṛtaṃ naraṃ / prāṅmukhaḥ padminīṃ dhyāyet likhitvā ślokapañcakaṃ // raupyasthamasyā haimyā ca lekhanyā nāgarākṣaraṃ /
english: The yajamāna the person at whose instance a rite is performed should face the east and contemplate the spiritual guide, the spell, lord Hari, the copyist and the goddess Padminī after having written five verses on a silver plate with golden pen and devanāgarī letters.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇān bhojayecchakyā śaktyā dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ //
english: The brahmins should be fed according to one’s capacity and fees should be paid as much as one could give.

sanskrit: guruṃ vidyāṃ hariṃ prārcya purāṇādi likhennaraḥ /
english: After having worshipped the preceptor, the spell and Lord Hari, one should write the purāṇas etc.

sanskrit: pūrvavanmaṇḍalādye ca aiśānyāṃ bhadrapīṭhake //
english: as before in a figure in an auspicious seat in the northeast.

sanskrit: darpaṇe pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā secayet pūrvavad ghaṭaiḥ / netronmīlanakaṃ kṛtvā śayyāyāṃ tu nyasennaraḥ //
english: Having seen the book in the mirror in the pitcher it should be consecrated as described earlier. After opening up the eyes one should place it in the bed.

sanskrit: nyasettu pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ devādyaṃ tatra pustake /
english: The puruṣasūkta and the Vedas etc.

sanskrit: kṛtvā sajīvīkaraṇaṃ prārcya hutvā caruṃ tataḥ // samprāśya dakṣiṇābhistu gurvādīn bhojayeddvijān /
english: After having infused life to it, it should be worshipped and the porridge offered. Having fed the preceptor and given the fees, the twiceborns should be fed.

sanskrit: rathena hastinā vāpi bhrāmyet pustakaṃ naraiḥ //
english: The book should be carried by men in a car, or on the elephant.

sanskrit: gṛhe devālayādau tu pustakaṃ sthāpya pūjayet / vastrādiveṣṭitaṃ pāṭhādādāvante samarcayet //
english: The book should be established and worshipped on its return in a house or temple. That which is wrapped up in a cloth should be worshipped at the commencement and end of reading.

sanskrit: jagacchāntiñcāvadhārya pustakaṃ vācayennaraḥ / adhyāyamekaṃ kumbhādbhiryajamānādi secayet //
english: Having resolved to have universal peace a chapter of the book should be read out. The yajamāna and others should be sprinkled with water from the pitcher.

sanskrit: dvijāya pustakaṃ datvā phalasyānto na vidyate /
english: The merit of presenting a book to the twiceborn is. unlimited.

sanskrit: trīṇyāhuratidānāni gāvaḥ pṛthvīṃ sarasvatī //
english: Three things are said to be gifts par excellence. They are cows, land and knowledge.

sanskrit: vidyādānaphalaṃ datvā masyantaṃ patrasañcayaṃ /
english: O sinless one! the merits of imparting knowledge is great.

sanskrit: yāvattu patrasaṅkhyānamakṣarāṇāṃ tathānagha // tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṇuloke mahīyate /
english: One who presents a bundle of written leaves, remains. and enjoys in the region of Viṣṇu for so many years as the number of leaves and letters in the manuscript.

sanskrit: pañcarātraṃ purāṇāni bhāratāni dadannaraḥ / kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya pare tattve tu līyate //
english: One who gives away pañcarātra, purāṇas, bhārata as gift elevates twentyone generations of his family and gets merged in the supreme being. ṚV.0.0.

sanskrit: kūpavāpītaḍāgānāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vacmi tāṃ śṛṇu /
english: shall describe the mode of consecration of wells, tanks and ponds .

sanskrit: jalarūpeṇa hi hariḥ somo varuṇa uttama //
english: Listen! Lord Hari Viṣṇu as Soma and excellent Varuṇa remains in the form of water.

sanskrit: agnīṣomamayaṃ viśvaṃ viṣṇurāpastu kāraṇaṃ /
english: The universe is permeated by fire and water. Viṣṇu in the form of water is its cause.

sanskrit: haimaṃ raupyaṃ ratnajaṃ vā varuṇaṃ kārayennaraḥ //
english: The image of Lord Varuṇa the presiding deity of waters should be made of gold, silver or gems.

sanskrit: dvibhujaṃ haṃsapṛṣṭhasthaṃ dakṣiṇenābhayapradaṃ / vāmena nāgapāśaṃ taṃ nadīnāgādisaṃyutaṃ //
english: The image should have two hands, the right conferring refuge and the left should hold the snakenoose and as seated on the haṃsa along with the rivers and serpents.

sanskrit: yāgamaṇḍapamadhye syādvedikā kuṇḍamaṇḍitā /
english: There should be an altar at the centre of sacrificial shed having a firepit.

sanskrit: toraṇaṃ vāruṇaṃ kumbhaṃ nyasecca karakānvitaṃ //
english: There should be an arch. A pitcher made of stone for Lord Varuṇa should be placed.

sanskrit: bhadrake cārdhacandre vā svastike dvāri kumbhakān /
english: Pitchers should be placed at the entrance to the fire receptacle which may be of a semicircular shape or a svastika of auspicious nature.

sanskrit: agnyādhānaṃ cāpyakuṇḍe kṛtvā pūrṇāṃ pradāpayet //
english: Having done the agnyādhāna rite in the pit for water the final oblation should be done.

sanskrit: varuṇaṃ snānapīṭhe tu ye te śateti saṃspṛśet /
english: The image of Varuṇa should be touched in the bathing seat with the mantra ye te śate.

sanskrit: ghṛtenābhyañjayet paścānmūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ //
english: It should then be anointed with ghee by the priest with the recitation of the principal mantra.

sanskrit: śanno devīti prakṣālya śuddhavatyā śivodakaiḥ / adhivāsayedaṣṭakumbhān sāmudraṃ pūrvakumbhake //
english: Having washed the eight pitchers with pure water with the recitation of śaṃ no devī they should be consecrated. Sea water should be kept in the eastern pitcher.

sanskrit: gāṅgamagnau varṣatoyaṃ dakṣe rakṣastu nairjharaṃ / nadītoyaṃ paścime tu vāyavye tu nadodakaṃ // audbhijjaṃ cottare sthāpya aiśānyāṃ tīrthasambhavaṃ /
english: Having kept the Ganges water in the pitcher on the southeast, rain water in the pitcher on the south, water from waterfalls in the pitcher on the southwest, river water in the west, water from a masculine river in the northwest, spring water in the north, waters from sacred places should be kept in the northeast.

sanskrit: alābhe tu nadītoyaṃ yāsāṃ rājeti mantrayet //
english: In the absence of all the above, river water should be poured into these pitchers with the chanting of yāsāṃ rājā.

sanskrit: devaṃ nirmārjya nirmañchya durmitriyeti vicakṣaṇaḥ / netre conmīlayeccitraṃ taccakṣurmadhuratrayaiḥ //
english: After having cleansed and anointed the eyes with the three sweet things honey, sugar and clarified butter with the mantra durmitriya, they should be opened with Citram and taccakṣuḥ.

sanskrit: jyotiḥ sampūrayeddhaimyāṃ gurave gāmathārpayet /
english: Having invoked lustre in them the priest should be offered a golden cow.

sanskrit: samudrajyeṣṭhetyabhiṣiñcayedvaruṇaṃ pūrvakumbhataḥ //
english: The image of Varuṇa should be consecrated with the waters of the pitcher on the east with the recitation of samudrajyeṣṭhā.

sanskrit: samudraṃ gaccha gāṅgeyāt somo dhenviti varṣakāt / devīrāpo nirjharādbhir nadādbhiḥ pañcanadyataḥ // udbhidadbhyaścodbhidena pāvamānyātha tīrthakaiḥ / āpo hi ṣṭhā pañcagavyāddhiraṇyavarṇeti svarṇajāt //
english: The waters of the Ganges should be poured with the mantra samudraṃ gaccha, rain waters with somo dhenum, water from waterfalls with devīrāpa, the water of the masculine rivers with pañca nadyaḥ, the spring water with udbhid, the waters from sacred places with pāvamānī, the pañcagavya the five things from a cow with āpo hi ṣṭhā and from the golden pitcher with hiraṇyavarṇām.

sanskrit: āpo asmeti varṣoptyair vyāhṛtyā kūpasambhavaiḥ /
english: The image should be bathed with rain water with āpo asmā, with well waters with the vyāhṛtis bhuḥ, bhuvaḥ, suvaḥ.

sanskrit: varuṇañca taḍāgoptyair varuṇādbhistu vaśyataḥ //
english: Image of Varuṇa should be consecrated with the waters of the tank with varuṇādbhiḥ.

sanskrit: āpo devīti girijair ekāśīvighaṭaistataḥ /
english: Waters from the hills should be poured with the mantra āpo devī and then with the waters from eightyone pitchers.

sanskrit: snāpayedvaruṇasyeti tvanno varuṇā cārghyakaṃ //
english: Then the image should be bathed with varuṇasya and waters for sipping should be given with tvanno varuṇa.

sanskrit: vyāhṛtyā madhuparkantu vṛhaspateti vastrakaṃ / varuṇeti pavitrantu praṇavenottarīyakaṃ //
english: The madhuparka should be given with the vyāhṛtis, clothes with bṛhaspat, pavitra with varuṇa, the upper garment with praṇava Om.

sanskrit: yadvāraṇyena puṣpādi pradadyādvaruṇāya tu / cāmaraṃ darpaṇaṃ chatraṃ vyajanaṃ vaijayantikāṃ //
english: Flowers etc. chowrie, mirror, umbrella, fan and banner should be offered to the image of Varuṇa with the mantra yadvāruṇya.

sanskrit: mūlenottiṣṭhetyutthāpya tāṃ rātrimadhivāsayet /
english: The image should be raised up with the principal mantra saying ‘Rise up’ and the preliminary consecration is made that night.

sanskrit: varuṇañceti sānnidhyaṃ yadvāraṇyena pūjayet //
english: The presence of divinity is accomplished by varuṇaṃ ca. It should be worshipped with yadvāruṇya.

sanskrit: sajīvīkaraṇaṃ mūlāt punargandhādinā yajet / maṇḍape pūrvavat prārcya kuṇḍeṣu samidādikaṃ //
english: Life should be infused into the image with the principal mantra and should again be worshipped with perfume etc. Having worshipped it well in the shed as before after having offered twigs etc.

sanskrit: vedādimantrair gandhādyāś catasro dhenavo duhet /
english: into the fire pits with the recitation of the praṇava the first word of the Vedas, four cows should be milched.

sanskrit: dikṣvatho vai yavacaruṃ tataḥ saṃsthāpya homayet //
english: in the four directions. Then gruel of barley should be prepared, and offered to the fire.

sanskrit: vyāhṛtyā vātha gāyatryā mūlenāmantrayettathā /
english: The invocation should be performed with the vyāhṛtis, gāyatrī and the principal mantra.

sanskrit: sūryāya prajāpataye dyauḥ svāhā cāntarikṣakaḥ //
english: Oblation should be done with the mantra sūryāya prajāpataye dyauḥ svāhā cāntarikṣakaḥ.

sanskrit: iha ratyai ceha ramatyā ugro bhīmaś ca raudrakaḥ //
english: Ceremony is to be performed for the earth, Dehadhṛti, Svadhṛti, Rati, Ugra, Bhīma, Raudraka.

sanskrit: viṣṇuś ca varuṇo dhātā rāyaspoṣo mahendrakaḥ / agniryamo nairṛto 'tha varuṇo vāyureva ca //
english: Viṣṇu, Varuṇa, Dhātṛ, Mahendra the furtherer of riches, Agni, Yama, Nairṛta, Varuṇa, Vāyu, Kubera, Īśa, Ananta, Brahman and the lord of waters should be propitiated.

sanskrit: tasmai svāhedaṃ viṣṇuś ca tadviprāseti homayet //
english: with oblations reciting svāhā and the mantras idaṃ viṣṇuḥ and tad viprāsa.

sanskrit: somo dhenviti ṣaḍ hutvā imaṃ meti ca homayet /
english: Having made oblation six times with somo dhenu, oblation should be made with imaṃ me.

sanskrit: āpo hi ṣṭheti tisṛbhirimā rudreti homayet //
english: be done thrice with āpo hi ṣṭhā and once with imā rudrā.

sanskrit: daśādikṣu baliṃ dadyāt gandhapuṣpādinārcayet /
english: Bali offering should be made in the ten directions. The image should be worshipped with perfumes and flowers.

sanskrit: pratimāṃ tu samutthāpya maṇḍale vinyased budhaḥ //
english: The image should be lifted and placed in a mystic diagram by a wise man.

sanskrit: pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyair hemapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt /
english: The image should be worshipped with perfumes. and flowers as well as golden flowers duly.

sanskrit: jalāśayāṃstu digbhāge vitastidvayasammitān // kṛtvāṣṭau sthaṇḍilān ramyān saikatān deśikottamaḥ /
english: The excellent priest should lay eight raised platforms filled with sand after having made ready the water tanks measuring two feet. Then clarified.

sanskrit: varuṇasyeti mantreṇa sājyamaṣṭaśataṃ tataḥ // caruṃ yavamayaṃ hutvā śāntitoyaṃ samācaret /
english: butter should be given as oblation hundred and eight times with the mantra varuṇasya. Then the barley gruel should be offered in the fire and. purificatory water sprinkled over the image.

sanskrit: secayenmūrdhni devaṃ tu sajīvakaraṇaṃ caret // dhyāyettu varuṇaṃ yuktaṃ gauryā nadanadīgaṇaiḥ /
english: The rite to bring. life into the image should be performed. Lord Varuṇa should be contemplated as being accompanied by goddess Gaurī and the host of masculine and feminine rivers.

sanskrit: oṃ varuṇāya namo 'bhyarcya tataḥ sānnidhyamācaret //
english: Then having worshipped with the mantra “oṃ salutations to Varuṇa”, the act of bringing near should be done.

sanskrit: utthāpya nāgapṛṣṭhādyair bhrāmayettaiḥ samaṅgalaiḥ /
english: The image should be lifted and carried around on the back of elephant etc.

sanskrit: āpo hi ṣṭheti ca kṣipettrimadhvākte ghaṭe jale //
english: With the recitation of āpo hi ṣṭhā, it should be immersed in the water of the pitcher into which the three sweet things have been put.

sanskrit: jalāśaye madhyagataṃ suguptaṃ viniveśayet /
english: The image should be placed in the midst of the tank unseen.

sanskrit: snātvā dhyāyecca varuṇaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmāṇḍasañjñikāṃ //
english: The priest should bathe and contemplate on Varuṇa, the creation known as the primordial egg.

sanskrit: agnivījena sandagddhya tadbhasma plāvayeddharāṃ / sarvamapomayaṃ lokaṃ dhyāyet tatra jaleśvaraṃ //
english: Having purified it with the principal letter of the mantra of the fire, the ashes should be scattered over the earth. The entire world consists of water.

sanskrit: toyamadhyasthitaṃ devaṃ tato yūpaṃ niveśayet /
english: Hence, the lord of waters is contemplated.

sanskrit: caturasramathāṣṭāsraṃ vartulaṃ vā pravartitaṃ //
english: The sacrificial post of a rectangular, octagonal or circular shape should be placed in the middle of the tank.

sanskrit: ārādhya devatāliṅgaṃ daśahastaṃ tu kūpake / yūpaṃ yajñīyavṛkṣotthaṃ mūle haimaṃ phalaṃ nyaset //
english: Having worshipped the symbol of the lord, post made of the tree used for the purpose of sacrifice should be driven ten cubits into the ground in the case of consecration of a well . At the bottom of the post gold and fruit should be placed.

sanskrit: vāpyāṃ pañcadaśakaraṃ puṣkariṇyāṃ tu viṃśatikaṃ / taḍāge pañcaviṃśākhyaṃ jalamadhye niveśayet //
english: It should be driven into the ground in the middle of water fifteen cubits in the case of a well, twenty cubits in the case of a tank puṣkariṇī and twentyfive cubits in the case of a pond.

sanskrit: yāgamaṇḍapāṅgeṇa vā yūpabrasketi mantrataḥ / sthāpya tadveṣṭayedvastrair yūpopari patākikāṃ //
english: In the alternative, the post should be driven in the centre of the sacrificial bed and with the mantra yūpavraskā cloth should be put around. The banner should be put at the top of the post.

sanskrit: tadabhyarcya ca gandhādyair jagacchāntiṃ samācaret / dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyādbhūgohemāmbupātrakaṃ //
english: Having worshipped it with perfumes etc., the rite foruniversal peace should be performed. The spiritual preceptor should be given the fees in the form of land, cows, gold and water vessel.

sanskrit: dvijebhyo dakṣiṇā deyā āgatān bhojayettathā /
english: Fees should be paid to twiceborns. Those who arepresent should be fed.

sanskrit: ābrahmastambaparyantā ye kecitsalilārthinaḥ // te tṛptimupagacchantu taḍāgasthena vāriṇā /
english: “From Brahman down to inanimate objects like the pillar all those who seek water may get satisfied with the waters of the tank!” With the utterance of these words the water should be given as charity.

sanskrit: toyamutsarjayedevaṃ pañcagavyaṃ vinikṣipet //
english: The five things got from a cow should then be thrown into the water.

sanskrit: āpo hi ṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ śāntitoyaṃ dvijaiḥ kṛtaṃ / tīrthatoyaṃ kṣipet puṇyaṃ gokulañcārpayedvijān //
english: With the utterance of the mantra āpo hi ṣṭhā thrice, the sanctified water got ready by the brahmins and the holy waters of the sacred spots should be sprinkled into the tank and herd of kine should be given to brahmins.

sanskrit: anivāritamannādyaṃ sarvajanyañca kārayet /
english: Food and other things should be given to all the people without any restraint.

sanskrit: aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ yaḥ samācaret // ekāhaṃ sthāpayettoyaṃ tatpuṇyamayutāyutaṃ /
english: One who consecrates a reservoir of water acquires in a single day a merit ten crores times more than one who performs thousands of aśvamedha the horsesacrifice.

sanskrit: vimāne modate svarge narakaṃ na sa gacchati //
english: Such a person goes to heaven in the celestial vehicle and rejoices there. He never goes to hell.

sanskrit: gavādi pivate yasmāttasmāt kartur na pātakaṃ / toyadānātsarvadānaphalaṃ prāpya divaṃ yajet //
english: The consecrator can never get any sin as the cattle and other animals drink water from it. One attains all merits by the endowment of water tank and goes to heaven. Kāt.

sanskrit: sabhādisthānaṃ vakṣye tathaiva teṣāṃ pravartanaṃ / bhūmau parīkṣitāyāñca vāstuyāgaṃ samācaret //
english: shall describe the mode of building pavilions in front of temples and their maintenance. The vāstuyāga rite performed to please the spirits dwelling in a site should be performed after having tested the ground intended for building pavilion.

sanskrit: svecchayā tu sabhāṃ kṛtvā svecchayā sthāpayet surān /
english: Having constructed pavilion as per one’s liking, one should install the images of gods according to his wish.

sanskrit: catuṣpathe grāmādau ca na śūnye kārayet sabhāṃ //
english: Such buildings should not be constructed at the junction of four roads or at a deserted place in the village.

sanskrit: nirmalaḥ kulamuddhṛtya kartā svarge vimodate /
english: Such a builder being free from sins and raising his ancestors to heaven, enjoys in heaven.

sanskrit: anena vidhinā kuryāt saptabhaumaṃ harergṛhaṃ //
english: One should build a sevenstoreyed building for Lord Hari Viṣṇu in the following way.

sanskrit: yathā rājñāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ pūrvādyāś ca dhvajādayaḥ /
english: The same rule holds good in the building of other temples of gods, as in the case of erecting the mansions of kings.

sanskrit: koṇabhujān varjayitvā catuḥśālaṃ tu vartayet //
english: The edifice should be built as a quadrilateral without having any walls on the diagonal lines.

sanskrit: triśālaṃ vā dviśālaṃ vā ekaśālamathāpi vā /
english: The building should have three or two chambers or one chamber.

sanskrit: vyayādhikaṃ na kurvīta vyayadoṣakaraṃ hi tat //
english: The vyaya should not be much. Excessive vyaya is deemed to be harmful.

sanskrit: āyādhike bhavet pīḍā tasmāt kuryāt samaṃ dvayaṃ /
english: Excessive āya is also harmful. Hence the two should be made equal.

sanskrit: kararāśiṃ samastantu kuryādvasuguṇaṃ guruḥ // saptārciṣā hṛte bhāge gargavidyāvicakṣaṇaḥ /
english: The priest wellversed in the science of Garga vāstuśāstra, should sum up the hand measures of building and multiply it by eight.

sanskrit: aṣṭadhā bhājite tasmin yaccheṣaṃ sa vyayo gataḥ //
english: It should be multiplied by three and the resultant product should be divided by eight and the remainder is known as vyaya.

sanskrit: athavā kararāśiṃ tu hanyāt saptārciṣā budhaḥ / vasubhiḥ saṃhṛte bhāge pṛthvyādi parikalpayet //
english: Alternatively, having divided the sum of the hand measures of the building by three and multiplying it by eight the resultant is known as the dhvaja banner etc.

sanskrit: dhvajo dhūmras tathā siṃhaḥ śvā vṛṣastu kharo gajaḥ /
english: Banner, camel, lion, dog, bull, donkey, elephant and crow are said to be eight āyas.

sanskrit: triśālakatrayaṃ śastaṃ udakpūrvavivarjitaṃ /
english: It is commended if we have three after leaving the north and east in houses having three storeys.

sanskrit: yāmyāṃ paragṛhopetaṃ dviśālaṃ labhyate sadā //
english: Together with the building on the opposite side there will always be two buildings in the south.

sanskrit: yāmye śālaikaśālaṃ tu pratyakśālamathāpi vā / ekaśāladvayaṃ śastaṃ śeṣāstvanye bhayāvahāḥ //
english: Onestoreyed building may be had in the south or there may be two onestoreyed buildings in the west. The other kinds of buildings cause fear.

sanskrit: catuḥśālaṃ sadā śastaṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitaṃ /
english: A fourstoreyed building devoid of all defects is always commended.

sanskrit: ekabhaumādi kurvīta bhavanaṃ saptabhaumakaṃ // dvāravedyādirahitaṃ pūraṇena vivarjitaṃ /
english: One may build a mansion having onestorey or sevenstoreys without the door, platform and moulding.

sanskrit: devagṛhaṃ devatāyāḥ pratiṣṭhāvidhinā sadā //
english: The mansions of the images of gods should be consecrated in the prescribed way for the gods.

sanskrit: saṃsthāpya manujānāñca samudāyoktakarmaṇā /
english: The hall should be consecrated with the ceremonies as described for the installation of an image.

sanskrit: prātaḥ sarvauṣadhīsnānaṃ kṛtvā śuciratandritaḥ // madhuraistu dvijān bhojya pūrṇakumbhādiśobhitaṃ / satoraṇaṃ svasti vācya dvijān goṣṭhahastakaḥ //
english: The consecrator should bathe in the herbal waters and becoming pure and alert should feed brahmins with sweets. He should then enter the hall decked with pitchers and arches, with his hand placed on the back of a cow, and after having wished prosperity to the brahmins.

sanskrit: gṛhī gṛhaṃ praviśecca daivajñān prārcya saṃviśet /
english: The householder should then enter the house after having honoured the astrologers.

sanskrit: gṛhe puṣṭikaraṃ mantraṃ paṭheccemaṃ samāhitaḥ //
english: The following mantra of prosperity should be repeated.

sanskrit: oṃ nande nandaya vāśiṣṭhe vasubhiḥ prajayā saha /
english: “Oṃ, O Mother Earth! related to Vasiṣṭha! you rejoice with the Vasus semidivine beings and people.

sanskrit: jaye bhārgavadāyade prajānāṃ vijayāvahe //
english: Glory be to the daughter of Bhārgava Śukra the preceptor of demons, the giver of success to her offsprings.

sanskrit: pūrṇe 'ṅgirasadāyāde pūrṇakāmaṃ kurudhva māṃ /
english: The accomplished goddess! relative of Aṅgiras! You grant me my heart’s desire.

sanskrit: bhadre kāśyapadāyāde kuru bhadrāṃ matiṃ mama //
english: O auspicious one! related to sage Kaśyapa! make my intellect good.

sanskrit: prajāpatisute devi caturasre mahīyasi / subhage suvrate devi gṛhe kāśyapi ramyatāṃ // pūjite paramācāryair gandhamālyair alaṅkṛte / bhavabhūtikare devi gṛhe bhārgavi ramyatāṃ // avyakte vyākṛte pūrṇe muneraṅgirasaḥ sute /
english: Endowed with all herbs! Surrounded by all gems and herbs! Shining one Joyous one! related to Vasiṣṭha! May you amuse here! Daughter of Prajāpati Brahman! O Goddess! Handsome in all parts! Nobleminded! Beautiful one! The strict observer of disciplines! One who is related to Kaśyapa! May you enjoy in this house! O Adored by the great preceptors! Adorned with perfumes and garlands! Bestower of prosperity! O Goddess! Daughter of Bhārgava! May you amuse in this house! The primordial element! The inexplicable one! Accomplished! O daughter of sage Aṅgiras! O Goddess of bricks! establish you.

sanskrit: deśasvāmipurasvāmigṛhasvāmiparigrahe / manuṣyadhanahastyaśvapaśuvṛddhikarī bhava //
english: You confer on me my desires! One surrounded by the lords of regions, place and the house! You be furtherer of men, wealth, elephant, horse and cow.

sanskrit: samudāyapratiṣṭhāñca vakṣye sā vāsudevavat /
english: One of the formulae for ascertaining the right proportion of measurement.

sanskrit: ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā viśve 'śvinau tathā // ṛṣayaś ca tathā sarve vakṣye teṣāṃ viśeṣakaṃ /
english: shall describe the mode of consecration of images of all godsthe Ādityas the suns, twelve in number, Vasus eight, Rudrāḥ eleven, Sādhyāḥ , Viśvedevāḥ , Aśvins and the sages etc.

sanskrit: yasya devasya yannāma tasyādyaṃ gṛhya cākṣaraṃ //
english: The first letter of the name of particular deity should be taken.

sanskrit: mātrābhirbhedayitvā tu dīrghāṇyaṅgāni bhedayet /
english: It should be split into syllables. The longer vowels should be split.

sanskrit: prathamaṃ kalpayedvījaṃ savinduṃ praṇavaṃ natiṃ //
english: The mystical letter of the deity is first formed by adding a nasal and the praṇava.

sanskrit: sarveṣāṃ mūlamantreṇa pūjanaṃ sthāpanaṃ tathā / niyamavratakṛcchrāṇāṃ maṭhasaṅkramaveśmanāṃ //
english: The images of all gods as well as those who had led a disciplined life and had observed austerities and atonements and those who had lived in the monasteries should be worshipped and installed with their respective principal mantra.

sanskrit: māsopavāsaṃ dvādaśyāṃ ity ādisthāpanaṃ vade /
english: shall describe the mode of fasting for a month and that which concludes on the twelfth day of a fortnight.

sanskrit: śilāṃ pūrṇaghaṭaṃ kāṃsyaṃ sambhāraṃ sthāpayettataḥ //
english: One should place a stone slab and pitchers made of bell metal filled with the articles described earlier.

sanskrit: brahmakūrcaṃ samāhṛtya śraped yavamayaṃ caruṃ / kṣīreṇa kapilāyāstu tadviṣṇoriti sādhakaḥ //
english: After having collected the brahmakūrca grass, the worshipper should prepare the gruel made of barley and milk of tawny coloured cow with the mantra tadviṣṇoḥ.

sanskrit: praṇavenābhighāryaiva darvyā saṅghaṭṭayettataḥ /
english: It should be stirred with the ladle holding it with the recitation of praṇava oṃ.

sanskrit: sādhayitvāvatāryātha viṣṇumabhyarcya homayet //
english: Having got it ready and bringing it down lord Viṣṇu should be worshipped and the offering made.

sanskrit: vyāhṛtā caiva gāyatryā tadviprāseti homayet / viśvataś cakṣurvedyair bhūragnaye tathaiva ca //
english: The oblation should be done with the vyāhṛti bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ, the vedic mantras such as gāyatrī mantra, tadviprāsa, viśvataścakṣuḥ and bhūragnaye.

sanskrit: sūryāya prajāpataye antarikṣāya homayet /
english: Oblations should be given to Sūrya, Prajāpati the creator, the lord of the ethereal region.

sanskrit: dyauḥ svāhā brahmaṇe svāhā pṛthivī mahārājakaḥ //
english: Oblation to sky! Oblations to Brahman! Oblations should be given upto the earth and the great king.

sanskrit: tasmai somañca rājānaṃ indrādyair homamācaret /
english: Oblations should be done with the mantras tasmai, somaṃ ca, rājānamidam.

sanskrit: evaṃ hutvā carorbhāgān dadyāddigbalimādarāt //
english: Having offered the remaining part of the gruel as oblation, digbali offerings to the quarters should be done with due respect.

sanskrit: samidho 'ṣṭaśataṃ hutvā pālāśāṃścājyahomakaṃ / kuryāt puruṣasūktena irāvatī tilāṣṭakaṃ //
english: Having made oblation of one hundred and eight twigs of the palāśa tree along with clarified butter, oblations should be done eight times with sesamum and water along with the puruṣasūkta.

sanskrit: hutvā tu brahmaviṣṇvīśadevānāmanuyāyināṃ / grahāṇāmāhutīrhutvā lokeśānāmatho punaḥ // parvatānāṃ nadīnāñca samudrāṇāṃ tathā.ahutīḥ /
english: Having offered oblations for Brahman, Viṣṇu, Īśa Śiva, the attendant gods, the planets and the presiding deities of different worlds, oblations should be offered for the mountains, rivers, and oceans.

sanskrit: hutvā ca vyāhṛtīrdaddyāt sruvapūrṇāhutitrayaṃ //
english: Sacrificial spoon full of clarified butter should be offered thrice as the final oblation with the recitation of vyāhṛtīs bhuḥ, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ.

sanskrit: vauṣaḍantena mantreṇa vaiṣṇavena pitāmaha / pañcagavyaṃ caruṃ prāśya datvācāryāya dakṣiṇāṃ // tilapātraṃ hemayuktaṃ savastraṃ gāmalaṅkṛtāṃ /
english: O Brannan after having sipped the gruel along with the pañcagavya five things got from a cow with the vaiṣṇava mantra and the syllable vauṣaṭ, the priest should be paid fees, vessel containing sesamum along with gold, cloth and a cow welladorned.

sanskrit: prīyatāṃ bhagavān viṣṇurityutsṛjedvrataṃ budhaḥ //
english: The wise man should complete the austerity with the utterance of “May lord Viṣṇu be pleased!”

sanskrit: māsopavāsāderanyāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vacmi pūrṇataḥ /
english: shall describe in full about another mode of consecration other than that of fasting for a month.

sanskrit: yajñenātoṣya deveśaṃ śrapayedvaiṣṇavaṃ caruṃ // tilataṇḍulanīvāraiḥ śyāmākair athavā yavaiḥ /
english: The lord of the celestials Viṣṇu should be worshipped and the gruel pertaining to Viṣṇu should be prepared out of sesamum, rice, nīvāra grains rice growing unsown, śyāmāka or barley.

sanskrit: ājyenādhārya cottārya homayenmūrtimantrakaiḥ //
english: After adding clarified butter and lifting it up, oblation should be made with that with the mantras relating to that form of the lord.

sanskrit: viṣṇvādīnāṃ māsapānāṃ tadante homayet punaḥ /
english: Oblation should be made to Viṣṇu and other gods who are the lords of different months then.

sanskrit: dvādaśāśvatthasamidho homayedghṛtasamplutāḥ //
english: Oṃ! oblations to Puruṣottama the foremost an epithet of Viṣṇu! Twelve twigs of the holy fig tree dipped in the clarified butter should be given as oblation.

sanskrit: viṣṇo rarāṭamantreṇa tato dvādaśa cāhutīḥ / idaṃ viṣṇurirāvatī carordvādaśa āhutīḥ //
english: Twelve oblations should be made with the mantra viṣṇo rarāṭa. Twelve oblations with the gruel should be made with the mantras idam viṣṇu, irāvatī.

sanskrit: hutvā cājyāhutīstadvattadviprāseti homayet / śeṣahomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dadyāt pūrṇāhutitrayaṃ //
english: Similarly, oblations should be made with clarified butter with the mantra tadviprāsa. Having done the remaining oblation, three concluding oblations should be made.

sanskrit: yuñjatetyanuvākantu japtvā prāśīta vai caruṃ /
english: Having repeated the hymn yuñjate the gruel should be partaken.

sanskrit: praṇavena svaśabdānte kṛtvā pātre tu paippale //
english: With the praṇava syllable oṃ repeated at the end of the respective name the gruel should be placed in a vessel made of holy fig tree.

sanskrit: tato māsādhipānāntu viprān dvādaśa bhojayet /
english: Then twelve brahmins representing the twelve presiding deities of the months should be fed.

sanskrit: trayodaśa gurustatra tebhyo dadyāttrayodaśa //
english: The priest would be the thirteenth. The thirteenth place should be offered to him.

sanskrit: gāvaḥ prītiṃ samāyāntu pracarantu praharṣitāḥ / iti gopathamutsṛjya yūpaṃ tatra niveśayet //
english: A pathway should be laid out for the cattle saying, “May the cows get pleased! May they move happily!” Then the sacrificial post should be planted there.

sanskrit: daśahastaṃ prapā.arāmamaṭhasaṅkramaṇādiṣu /
english: A watershed in the pleasure grove, monastery and pathway should be of ten cubits.

sanskrit: gṛhe ca homamevantu kṛtvā sarvaṃ yathāvidhi // pūrvoktena vidhānena praviśecca gṛhaṃ gṛhī /
english: Having done the oblation etc. in the house duly in the prescribed way, the householder should enter the house according to the earlier injunctions. Offering of food etc.

sanskrit: anivāritamannādyaṃ sarveṣveteṣu kārayet //
english: without any restrictions should be made on all these occasions.

sanskrit: dvijebhyo dakṣiṇā deyā yathāśaktyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ /
english: Fees should be paid by wise men to the brahmins according to one’s capacity.

sanskrit: ārāmaṃ kārayedyastu nandane sa ciraṃ vaset // maṭhapradānāt svarloke śakraloke vasettataḥ /
english: Whoever causes to set up a pleasure grove stays eternally in the garden of Indra. One who builds a monastery goes to heaven and remains in the world of Indra.

sanskrit: prapādānādvāruṇena saṅkrameṇa vaseddivi //
english: One who sets up a watershed lives with Lord Varuṇa.

sanskrit: iṣṭakāsetukārī ca goloke mārgakṛdgavāṃ / niyamavratakṛdviṣṇuḥ kṛcchrakṛtsarvapāpahā //
english: By the construction of a pathway one remains in the heaven. One who builds a bridge of bricks and who constructs a pathway for cows in the cattle stall and one who observes the austerities in the prescribed way dwells in the region of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: gṛhaṃ datvā vasetsvarge yāvadābhūtasamplavaṃ /
english: Having constructed a house for the god one dwells in heaven so long as the universe exists.

sanskrit: samudāyapratiṣṭheṣṭā śivādīnāṃ gṛhātmanāṃ //
english: The installation and consecration of Lord Śiva etc., the lords of their edifices have been described. ṚV. ..0a.

sanskrit: jīrṇāddhāravidhiṃ vakṣye bhūṣitāṃ snapayedguruḥ /
english: ṚV. ..a. ṚV. ..a. shall describe the process of replacing the old images.

sanskrit: acalāṃ vinyasedgehe atijīrṇāṃ parityajet //
english: The fixed class of images should be put in a room and the extremely timeworn ones should be rejected.

sanskrit: vyaṅgāṃ bhagnāṃ ca śailāḍhyāṃ nyasedanyāṃ ca pūrvavat / saṃhāravidhinā tatra tattvān saṃhṛtya deśikaḥ //
english: A broken or mutilated stone image should be cast aside and a new one the same as the previous one should be installed in its place by the priest after merging the principles according to the process of merging described earlier.

sanskrit: sahasraṃ nārasiṃhena hutvā tāmuddhared guruḥ /
english: Having made one thousand oblations with the Narasiṃha mantra, the priest should lift that image.

sanskrit: dāravīṃ dārayedvahnau śailajāṃ prakṣipejjale // dhātujāṃ ratnajāṃ vāpi agādhe vā jale 'mbudhau / yānamāropya jīrṇāṅgaṃ chādya vastrādinā nayet //
english: The old image made of wood should be put into fire and the one made of stone should be thrown into water. The old image made of a mineral or gem should be carried on a vehicle after covering it with cloth etc. and be discarded in the deep waters of the ocean.

sanskrit: vāditraiḥ prakṣipettoye gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadet /
english: It should be thrown into waters accompanied by the notes of music instruments. Fees should be paid to the priest.

sanskrit: yatpramāṇā ca yaddravyā tanmānāṃ sthāpayeddine /
english: New images of the same size and made of the same material should be installed on the same day.

sanskrit: kūpavāpītaḍāgāderjīrṇoddhāre mahāphalaṃ //
english: One accrues great merit by the renovation of wells, tanks and ponds.

sanskrit: vakṣye vidhiṃ cotsavasya sthāpite tu sure caret /
english: shall describe the celebration of festival after the image has been installed.

sanskrit: tasminnabde caikarātraṃ trirātrañcāṣṭarātrakaṃ //
english: It shall be for a night, or three or five nights.

sanskrit: utsavena vinā yasmāt sthāpanaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet /
english: Without the festival the installation would become fruitless.

sanskrit: ayane viṣuve cāpi śayanopavane gṛhe // kārakasyānukūle vā yātrāndevasya kārayet / maṅgalāṅkuraropaistu gītanṛtyādivādyakaiḥ //
english: The festival for the deity should be celebrated when the sun enters the solstitial or the equinoctial points in the bedchamber or garden or it may be done in favour of the person at whose instance the ceremony is performed with the sowing of auspicious seeds and the notes of sacred music.

sanskrit: śarāvaghaṭikāpālīstvaṅkurārohaṇe hitāḥ / yavāñchālīṃstilān mudgān godhūmān sitasarṣapān // kulatthamāṣaniṣpāvān kṣālayitvā tu vāpayet /
english: An earthen vessel, a small water pot or an embankment are suitable for the sowing of seeds. Grains of barley, uncultivated rice, sesamum, green gram, wheat, white mustard, horsegram, and black gram should be winnowed, washed and sown.

sanskrit: pūrvādau ca baliṃ dadyāt bhraman dīpaiḥ puraṃ niśi //
english: Offerings should be made in the east and other directions. Lighted lamps should be carried round the edifice in the night.

sanskrit: indrādeḥ kumudādeś ca sarvabhūtebhya eva ca /
english: Offering should be made to Indra, Kumuda and other deities and spirits.

sanskrit: anugacchanti te tatra pratirūpadharāḥ punaḥ //
english: They visit the place assuming shapes of men.

sanskrit: pade pade 'śvamedhasya phalaṃ teṣāṃ na saṃśayaḥ /
english: One who carries such lamps certainly gets the merit of doing aśvamedha horse sacrifice for every step he places.

sanskrit: āgatya devatāgāraṃ devaṃ vijñāpayed guruḥ // tīrthayātrā tu yā deva śvaḥ kartavyā surottama /
english: The priest should submit to the lord as follows after his return. “O Lord! best among the Gods! you have to be taken in a procession tomorrow .

sanskrit: tasyārambhamanujñātumarhase deva sarvathā // devamevantu vijñāpya tataḥ karma samārabhet /
english: By all means you deserve to permit us O Lord! to commence the same. Having informed the lord in this way the festivities should be undertaken.

sanskrit: prarohaghaṭikābhyāntu vedikāṃ bhūṣitāṃ vrajet //
english: The platform should be decorated with young shoots of plants and small waterjar.

sanskrit: catuḥstambhāntu tanmadhye svastike pratimāṃ nyaset /
english: Four pillars should be erected. The image should be placed in a svastika figure drawn in their midst.

sanskrit: kāmyārthāṃ lekhyacitreṣu sthāpya tatrādhivāsayet // vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha kurvīta ghṛtābhyaṅgantu mūlataḥ /
english: Or desired objects should be painted and placed there and the act of making the deity present in the image should be done with the vaiṣṇava mantra. The image should be anointed with ghee with the recitation of the principal mantra.

sanskrit: ghṛtadhārābhiṣekaṃ vā sakalāṃ śarvarīṃ budhaḥ //
english: Or the wise man should arrange an incessant flow of ghee over the image the whole night.

sanskrit: darpaṇaṃ darśya nīrājaṃ gītavādyaiś ca maṅgalaṃ / vyajanaṃ pūjanaṃ dīpaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet // haridrāmudgakāśmīraśuklacūrṇādi mūrdhni /
english: Having shown the mirror, there should be the waving of light, auspicious singing and instrumental music, fanning, worship, and present of light. The deity should be worshipped with incense and flowers. Turmeric, greengram, saffron and white powders should be put on the head of image.

sanskrit: pratimāyāś ca bhaktānāṃ sarvatīrthaphalaṃ dhṛte //
english: But when ghee is placed over the head it gets the merit of all sacred places for the devotees.

sanskrit: snāpayitvā samabhyarcya yātrāvimbaṃ rathe sthitaṃ / nayedgurur nadīrnādaiśchatrādyai rāṣṭrapālikāḥ //
english: Having bathed and worshipped the image that is placed in the car for being taken around, the officers of the king should take it to the riverside accompanied by music, umbrella and.

sanskrit: nimnagāyojanādarvāk tatra vedīntu kārayet / vāhanādavatāryainaṃ tasyāṃ vedyānniveśayet //
english: A platform should be got ready at a distance of a yojana eight or nine miles before the river. The image should be brought down from the car and placed on the platform.

sanskrit: caruṃ vai śrapayet tatra pāyasaṃ homayettataḥ /
english: Gruel should be prepared and sweet gruel should be offered as oblation.

sanskrit: abliṅgaiḥ vaidikair mantraistīrthānāvāhayettataḥ // āpo hiṣṭhopaniṣadaiḥ pūjayedarghyamukhyakaiḥ /
english: The sacred waters of the sacred spots should be invoked for their presence with the recitation of vedic mantras symbolising the waters. The image should again be worshipped with the principal oblations uttering the mantra āpo hi ṣṭhā.

sanskrit: punardevaṃ samādāya toye kṛtvāghamarṣaṇaṃ // snāyānmahājanair viprair vedyāmuttārya taṃ nyaset /
english: The image should again be carried to the waters and the aghamarṣaṇa hymn repeated. The priest should bathe with the assembly of brahmins and then the image should be lifted and placed on the platform.

sanskrit: pūjayitvā tadahnā ca prāsādaṃ tu nayettataḥ /
english: Having worshipped it there that day it should then be taken to the temple.

sanskrit: pūjayet pāvakasthantu guruḥ syādbhuktimuktikṛt //
english: The priest should worship it as in the fire which gets him enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit: brahman śṛṇu pravakṣāmi snapanotsavavistaraṃ /
english: O Brahman! Listen! shall describe in detail the mode of conducting the bathing festival.

sanskrit: prāsādasyāgrataḥ kumbhānmaṇḍape maṇḍale nyaset //
english: The pitchers should be placed in a drawn figure in the shed in front of the temple.

sanskrit: kuryād dhyānārcanaṃ homaṃ harerādau ca karmasu /
english: First of all, God Hari Viṣṇu should be contemplated, propitiated and offered oblations before doing anything.

sanskrit: sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vāpi homayet pūrṇayā saha //
english: One should offer oblations hundred or thousand times along with the final one.

sanskrit: snānadravyāṇyathāhṛtya kalaśāṃścāpi vinyaset / adhivāsya sūtrakaṇṭhān dhārayenmaṇḍale ghaṭān //
english: The materials for bathing should then be brought and the pitchers also should be placed. The pitchers to the necks of which threads have been tied should be made fragrant and they should be held in a circle.

sanskrit: caturasraṃ puraṃ kṛtvā rudraistaṃ pravibhājyet /
english: A square should be drawn and divided into eleven compartments.

sanskrit: madhyena tu caruṃ sthāpya pārśve paṅktiṃ pramārjayet //
english: The gruel should be placed at the centre, the adjacent parts having been cleaned.

sanskrit: śālicūrṇādināpūrya pūrvādinavakeṣu ca / kumbhamudrāṃ tato badhvā ghaṭaṃ tatrānayed budhaḥ //
english: The nine angular points commencing with east should be filled with powdered rice etc., and the pitcher should be brought by the wise man after having formulated the kumbha mudrā.

sanskrit: puṇḍarīkākṣamantreṇa darbhāṃstāṃstu visarjayet /
english: Darbha grass should be put on them with the puṇḍarīkākṣa an epithet of Viṣṇu lotuseyed mantra.

sanskrit: adbhiḥ pūrṇaṃ sarvaratnayutaṃ madhye nyased ghaṭaṃ //
english: A pitcher filled with water and containing all gems should be placed in the middle.

sanskrit: yavavrīhitilāṃś caiva nīvarān śyāmakān kramāt / kulatthamudgasiddhārthāṃstacchuktānaṣṭadikṣu ca //
english: The barley, paddy, sesamum, uncultivated rice, śyāmāka grains, horse gram, green gram and white mustard seeds. should be put in the eight directions in order.

sanskrit: aindre tu navake madhye ghṛtapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyaset /
english: A pitcher filled with ghee should be placed in the middle of the eastern side in the midst of nine pitchers.

sanskrit: palāśāśvatthanyagrodhavilvodumbaraśīrṣāṃ // jambūśamīkapitthānāṃ tvakkaṣāyair ghaṭāṣṭakaṃ /
english: The remaining pitchers should be filled with the decoctions of the barks of palāśa, aśvattha, nyagrodha, bilva, udumbara, śirīṣa, jambū, śamī and kapittha.

sanskrit: āgneyanavake madhye madhupūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyaset //
english: The central pitcher in the nine pitchers in the southeast should be filled with honey.

sanskrit: gośṛṅganaśvagaṅgāgajendradaśaneṣu ca / tīrthakṣetrakhaleṣvaṣṭau mṛttikāḥ syurghaṭāṣṭake //
english: The remaining eight pitchers should be filled with the earth taken from loosening by cow’s horn, elephant’s tusk, horse hoofs, mountains, Ganges bed, sacred spots, rivers and fields.

sanskrit: yāmye tu navake madhye tilatailaghaṭaṃ nyaset /
english: In the nine pitchers on the south, the central one should be filled with sesamum.

sanskrit: nāraṅgamatha jambīraṃ kharjūraṃ mṛdvikāṃ kramāt // nārikelaṃ nyaset pūgaṃ dāḍimaṃ panasaṃ phalaṃ /
english: The other eight pitchers should be filled with nāraṅga, jambīra, kharjūra, nārikela coconut, pūga arecanut, pomegranate, panasa fruits.

sanskrit: nairṛte navake madhye kṣīrapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyaset //
english: In the nine pitchers on the southwest, the central pitcher should be filled with milk.

sanskrit: kuṅkumaṃ nāgapuṣpañca campakaṃ mālatīṃ kramāt / mallikāmatha punnāgaṃ karavīraṃ mahotpalaṃ //
english: The remaining eight pitchers should be duly filled with saffron kuṅkuma, nāga, campaka, mālatī, jasmine, punnāga, karavīra, and mahotpala flowers.

sanskrit: puṣpāṇi cāpye navake madhye vai nārikelakam /
english: In the nine pitchers on the west, the central pitcher should contain the coconut water.

sanskrit: nādayematha sāmudraṃ sārasaṃ kaupameva ca // varṣajaṃ himatoyañca nairjharaṅgāṅgameva ca /
english: The other pitchers should contain waters of the river, ocean, tank, well, rain water, water from the melted ice, waters of the falls, and of the Ganges.

sanskrit: udakānyatha vāyavye navake kadalīphalaṃ //
english: In the nine pitchers on the northwest the central one should have banana fruits.

sanskrit: sahadevīṃ kumārīṃ ca siṃhīṃ vyāghrīṃ tathāmṛtāṃ / viṣṇuparṇīṃ śataśivāṃ vacāṃ divyauṣadhīrnyaset //
english: The divine herbs sahadevī, kumārī, siṃhī, vyāghrī, amṛtā, viṣṇuparṇā, śataśivā and vacā should be placed in the other eight pitchers.

sanskrit: pūrvādau saumyanavake madhye dadhighaṭaṃ nyaset /
english: In the east and the northern directions among the nine pitchers one should place the central one having curd.

sanskrit: patramelāṃ tvacaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ bālakaṃ candanadvayaṃ // latāṃ kastūrikāṃ caiva kṛṣṇāgurumanukramāt /
english: The other pitchers should duly be filled with the fragrant substancescardamom, tvacā, kuṣṭha, bālaka, the two varieties of sandal, the kastūrikā creeper and the black agallochum.

sanskrit: siddhadravyāṇi pūrvādau śāntitoyamathaikataḥ //
english: In the central pitcher among the nine pitchers on the north east one should fill waters for purification.

sanskrit: candratāraṃ kramācchuklaṃ girisāraṃ trapu nyaset / ghanasāraṃ tathā śīrṣaṃ pūrvādau ratnameva ca //
english: In the other pitchers we should have the materials candra, tāra, śukla, girisāra iron, trapu tin, camphor, śīrṣa and gems.

sanskrit: ghṛtenābhyarjya codvartya snapayenmūlamantrataḥ / gandhādyaiḥ pūjayedvahnau hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ caret //
english: They should be anointed with ghee and lifted up and bathed with the principal mantra with perfumes and worshipped. Having offered oblations into the fire, the final oblation should be offered.

sanskrit: baliñca sarvabhūtebhyo bhojayeddattadakṣiṇaḥ / devaiś ca munibhirbhūpair devaṃ saṃsthāpya ceśvarāḥ // babhūvuḥ sthāpitvetthaṃ snapanotsavakaṃ caret /
english: Offering should be made to all spirits. After paying fees to the priest, the priest and the brahmins should be fed after having installed the images of deities, sages and other divinities. Having installed the image of the god in this way one should conduct the bathing festival.

sanskrit: aṣṭottarasahasreṇa ghaṭānāṃ sarvabhāg bhavet //
english: One who bathes the image in one thousand eight pitchers gets all fortune.

sanskrit: yajñāvabhṛthasnānena pūrṇasaṃsnāpanaṃ kṛtam /
english: By bathing at the conclusion of the rite, the bathing festival concludes.

sanskrit: gaurīlakṣmīvivāhādi cotsavaṃ snānapūrvakam //
english: The marriage and other festivals of the goddesses Gaurī consort of Śiva, Lakṣmī consort of Viṣṇu should be celebrated after the bathing festival.

sanskrit: pratiṣṭhāṃ pādapānāñca vakṣye 'haṃ bhuktimuktidāṃ /
english: shall describe the mode of planting trees conferring enjoyment and emancipation.

sanskrit: sarvauṣadhyudakair liptān piṣṭātakavibhūṣitān // vṛkṣānmālyair alaṅkṛtya vāsobhirabhiveṣṭayet /
english: The trees having been smeared with all the herbs and adorned with fragrant powders should be decorated with flower garlands. Cloth should be put around them.

sanskrit: sūcyā sauvarṇayā kāryaṃ sarveṣāṃ karṇavedhanam //
english: The rite known as the perforation of the ear should be done for them with a golden needle.

sanskrit: hemaśalākayāñjanañca vedyāntu phalasaptakam / adhivāsayecca pratyekaṃ ghaṭān balinivedanaṃ //
english: Collyrium should be applied with a short stick. Seven kinds of fruits should be placed on the platform. The pitchers should be consecrated.

sanskrit: indrāderadhivāso 'tha homaḥ kāryo vanaspateḥ /
english: The offering should be made for the gods Indra and others and the consecration should be done.

sanskrit: vṛkṣamadhyādutsṛjedgāṃ tato 'bhiṣekamantrataḥ //
english: Remaining in the midst of trees a cow should be let off with the recitation of abhiṣekamantra.

sanskrit: ṛgyajuḥsāmamantraiś ca vāruṇair maṅgalai ravaiḥ / vṛkṣavedikakumbhakaiś ca snapanaṃ dvijapuṅgavāḥ //
english: Brahmins should bathe the trees as well as the yajamāna with the waters of pitchers placed in the platform with the recitation of the ṛk, yajus, sāma mantras and also that of varuṇa accompanied by auspicious music.

sanskrit: tarūṇāṃ yajamānasya kuryuś ca yajamānakaḥ /
english: The yajamāna should adorn himself and should present the fees as well as a cow, ornament and cloth.

sanskrit: kṣīreṇa bhojanaṃ dadyādyāvaddinacatuṣṭayaṃ /
english: Food should be given along with milk to brahmins for four days consecutively.

sanskrit: homastilādyaiḥ kāryastu palāśasamidhais tathā //
english: Oblation should be made with sesamum and twigs of palāśa tree.

sanskrit: ācārye dviguṇaṃ dadyāt pūrvavan maṇḍapādikam /
english: The sacrificial priest should be paid the fees double the value of what is given to other brahmins.

sanskrit: pāpanāśaḥ parā siddhirvṛkṣārāmapratiṣṭhayā //
english: The consecration of trees and a garden destroys one’s sins and gets the highest merit.

sanskrit: skandāyeśo yathā prāha pratiṣṭhādyaṃ tathā śṛṇu / sūryeśagaṇaśaktyādeḥ parivārasya vai hareḥ //
english: Listen to the mode of installation of the image of Sūrya sun, Gaṇeśa, the goddess Gaurī and the attendant deities of Lord Hari as described by Īśa Śiva to Skanda earlier.

sanskrit: gaṇapūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi nirvighnāmakhilārthadāṃ /
english: shall describe the mode of worship of Gaṇa . Gaṇeśa which removes obstacles and confers the desired. objects.

sanskrit: gaṇāya svāhā hṛdayamekadaṃṣṭrāya vai śiraḥ // gajakarṇine ca śikhā gajavaktrāya varma ca / mahodarāya svadantahastāyākṣi tathāstrakam //
english: The worship of six kinds should be done as follows The heart with “oblations to Gaṇeśa”, the head with “oblations to the onetusked”, the tuft with “oblations to the one who has the ear like that of an elephant”, the armour with “oblations to the elephantfaced”, the eye with “oblations to the bigbellied,” the weapons with “oblations to one who has his own tusk in his hands”.

sanskrit: gaṇo guruḥ pādukā ca śaktyanantau ca dharmakaḥ / mukhyāsthimaṇḍalaṃ cādhaścordhvacchadanamarcayet // padmakarṇikavījāṃś ca jvālinīṃ nandayārcayet /
english: One should worship the gaṇa, the preceptor, the sandals, the divine energy, Ananta, the dharma, and the collection of bones in the lower part of the pedestal, the cover, the petals of the lotus, the lotus and the principal letter, should be worshipped in the upper part.

sanskrit: sūryeśā kāmarūpā ca udayā kāmavartinī // satyāṃ ca vighnanāśā ca āsanaṃ gandhamṛttikā /
english: The energies are Jvālinī, Nandā, Sūryeśā, Kāmarūpā, Udayā, Kāmavarttinī, Satyā, and Vighnanāśā. The seat should be worshipped with perfumes and earth.

sanskrit: yaṃ śoṣā raṃ ca dahanaṃ plavo laṃ vaṃ tathāmṛtam //
english: With the following letters the appropriate acts should be performed the drying with Yaṃ, the burning with raṃ, the agitating with laṃ and making it to nectar with vaṃ.

sanskrit: lambodarāya vidmahe mahodarāya dhīmahi tanno dantī pracodayāt /
english: The gāyatrīmantra is lambodarāya vidmahe mahodarāya dhīmahi tanno dantī pracodayāt.

sanskrit: gaṇapatirgaṇādhipo gaṇeśo gaṇanāyakaḥ / gaṇakrīḍo vakratuṇḍa ekadaṃṣṭro mahodaraḥ // gajavaktro lambuka kṣirvikaṭo vighnanāśanaḥ / dhūmravarṇā mahendrādyāḥ pūjyā gaṇapateḥ smṛtāḥ //
english: The following are the names of Gaṇeśa to be worshipped “Gaṇapati Lord of gaṇas, Gaṇādhipa chieftain of the gaṇas, Gaṇeśa Lord of gaṇas, Gaṇanāyaka the lord of gaṇas, Gaṇakrīḍa one who sports with the gaṇas, Vakratuṇḍa having a bent trunk, Ekadaṃṣṭra having one tusk, Mahodara bigbellied, Gajavaktra elephantfaced, Lambakukṣi longbellied, Vikaṭa dreadful, Vighnanāśana destroyer of impediments, Dhūnravarṇa tawnycoloured and Mahendra.

sanskrit: vakṣyāmi skanda nityādyaṃ snānaṃ pūjāṃ pratiṣṭhayā /
english: O Skanda! shall describe the modes of bathing and worship after the installation everyday.

sanskrit: khātvāsinā samuddhṛtya mṛdamaṣṭāṅgulāṃ tataḥ //
english: Having bathed one should dig up eight fingers of earth with the sword.

sanskrit: sarvātmanā samuddhṛtya punastenaiva pūrayet / śirasā payasastīre nidhāyāstreṇa śodhayet //
english: The pit should be filled with the earth thus removed and it should be carried to the river bed and placed there. It should then be purified with the weapon.

sanskrit: tṛṇāni śikhayoddhṛtya varmaṇā vibhajettridhā /
english: The grass should be lifted up with the śikhā tuft mantra and divided into three with the armour mantra.

sanskrit: ekayā nābhipādāntaṃ prakṣālya punaranyayā // astrābhilabdhayālabhya dīptayā sarvavigrahaṃ / niruddhākṣāṇi pāṇibhyāṃ prāṇān saṃyamya vāriṇi //
english: Having washed upto the navel and foot with one part of them, the other part should be burnt with the astra mantra and sprinkled all over the body. Having pressed the eyes with the hands one should remain immersed in the water for some time after controlling the. breath.

sanskrit: nimajyāsīta hṛdyastraṃ smaran kālānalaprabhaṃ /
english: One should contemplate in the heart, the weapon, radiant like the deadly fire.

sanskrit: malasnānaṃ viśodhayetthaṃ samutthāya jalāntarāt // astrasandhyāmupāsyātha vidhisnānaṃ samācaret /
english: Having finished the mud bath in this way one should rise up from waters. Having worshipped the astrasandhyā the union of weapon, one should bathe according to the injunctions laid down .

sanskrit: sārasvatāditīrthānāṃ ekamaṅkuśamudrayā // hṛdākṛṣya tathā snāpya punaḥ saṃhāramudrayā /
english: The sacred waters of the rivers Sarasvatī and others should be drawn into the heart with the formation of aṅkuśamudrā a formation with the fingers resembling the goad.

sanskrit: śeṣaṃ mṛdbhāgamādāya praviśya nābhivāriṇi // vāmapāṇitale kuryādbhāgatrayamudaṅmukhaḥ /
english: Having established it there, one should collect the remaining mud formulating the saṃhāramudrā posture with the fingers indicating destruction and enter the naveldeep water.

sanskrit: aṅgair dakṣiṇamekādyaṃ pūrvamastreṇa saptadhā // śivena daśadhā saumyaṃ japedbhāgatrayaṃ kramāt /
english: One part of it on the south once with the aṅga mantras, the next part with the previous mantra seven times and the one on the north with the Śiva mantra ten times and duly thus the parts should be sanctified.

sanskrit: sarvadikṣu kṣipet pūrvaṃ hūṃ phaḍantaśarātmanā //
english: After having recited the mantra for the weapon ending with huṃ phaṭ, the first part of the earth should be scattered in all directions.

sanskrit: kuryācchivena saumyena śivatīrthaṃ bhujakramāt /
english: Having the part on the north and reciting the Śivamantra the waters of Śiva should be accomplished.

sanskrit: sarvāṅgamaṅgajaptena mūrdhādicaraṇāvadhi //
english: The part on the south sanctified with the aṅga mantra should be smeared all over the body from head to foot.

sanskrit: dakṣiṇena samālabhya paṭhannaṅgacatuṣṭayam / pidhāya khāni sarvāṇi sammukhīkaraṇena ca // śivaṃ smarannimajjeta hariṃ gaṅgeti vā smaran /
english: After having recited the four aṅgamantras and covered all the nine apertures in the body with the recitation of the sammukhīkaraṇa mantra mantra accomplishing the presence, one should contemplate Lord Śiva or Lord Hari or the Ganges and plunge into the waters.

sanskrit: vauṣaḍantaṣaḍaṅgena ke kuryādabhiṣecanaṃ //
english: Then the ṣaḍaṅga mantra mantra for assigning to the limbs of the body ending with vauṣat should be recited and water poured over the head.

sanskrit: kumbhamātreṇa rakṣārthaṃ pūrvādau nikṣipejjalaṃ /
english: One should place water in the pitchers in the east and other directions in order to prevent any harm during ablution.

sanskrit: snātvā rajopacāreṇa sugandhāmalakādibhiḥ //
english: Having bathed one should apply sweet perfumes such as emblic myrabolans which are considered as royal honour.

sanskrit: snātvā cottīrya tattīrthaṃ saṃhāriṇyopasaṃharet /
english: Having bathed and come out, that water should be made to cease to exist with the saṃhāriṇī mudrā.

sanskrit: nivṛtyādiviśuddhena bhasmanā snānamācaret / śirastaḥ pādaparyantaṃ hrūṃ phaḍantaśarātmanā //
english: One should then bathe from head to foot with the ashes duly purified by the saṃhitā vedic mantras or concluding rites with the recitation of the mantra huṃ phaṭ.

sanskrit: tena kṛtvā malasnānaṃ vidhisnānaṃ samācaret / īśatatpuruṣāghoraguhyakājātasañcaraiḥ // krameṇoddhūnayenmūrdhni vaktrahṛdguhyavigrahāt /
english: Having performed the malasnāna, bathing with mud, the vidhisnāna bathing with the recitation of mantras, one should besmear the head, face, heart, and the genital organ with the mantras of gods Īśa Īśāna, Tatpuruṣa, Aghora, Guhyaka and Jāta Sadyojāta in the three twilights, night, and.

sanskrit: sandhyātraye niśīthe ca varṣāpūrvāvasānayoḥ //
english: before and after the commencement of rainy season.

sanskrit: suptvā bhuktvā payaḥ pītvā kṛtvā cāvaśyakādikam / strīpunnapuṃsakaṃ śūdraṃ viḍālaśaśamūṣikam // snānamāgneyakaṃ spṛṣṭvā śucā vuddhūlakaṃ caret /
english: If a person happens to touch a woman, an eunuch, a man of lower caste, a cat, hare or mouse just after getting up from sleep, or eaten food or drunk water one should do the āgneyaka bathing, standing up with uplifted arms, the face having turned towards the east, being cleansed by the shower of sun’s rays.

sanskrit: māhendraṃ snānamaiśena kāryaṃ saptapadāvadhi / gosaṅghamadhyagaḥ kuryāt khurotkhātakareṇubhiḥ //
english: The māhendra bathing consists in the recitation of the Īśa mantra and walking seven steps in the midst of herds of cows being besmeared with the dust arising from the hoofs.

sanskrit: pāvanaṃ navamantreṇa snānantadvarmaṇāthavā / sadyojātādibhirmantrair ambhobhirabhiṣecanam //
english: The pāvana purifying bathing should be done with the nine mantras or the constituent mantra and the pouring of water should be done with the mantras sadyojāta, etc.

sanskrit: mantrasnānaṃ bhavedevaṃ vāruṇāgneyayorapi / manasā mūlamantreṇa prāṇāyāmapuraḥsaram //
english: The bathing with the mantra should be done in this manner in honour of the gods Varuṇa, Agni and others with the recitation of the principal mantra being preceded by the regulation of the breath.

sanskrit: kurvīta mānasaṃ snānaṃ sarvatra vihitaṃ ca yat / vaiṣṇavādau ca tanmantrair evaṃ snānādi kārayet // sandhyāvidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi mantrair bhinnaiḥ samaṃ guha /
english: The mental bathing which has been universally enjoined should be performed in honour of Lord Viṣṇu, by uttering the mantra sacred to him. O Guha son of Lord Śiva! shall describe the rules relating to the twilight worship to be performed with different mantras.

sanskrit: saṃvīkṣya triḥ pivedambu brahmatīrthena śaṅkaraiḥ //
english: After having had a look one should drink the water, the Brahma and Śaṅkara tīrthas from the root of different fingers.

sanskrit: svadhāntair ātmatattvādyaistataḥ khāni spṛśeddhṛdā /
english: One should pronounce the different principles constituting one’s self ending with the tern svadhā, touching firmly the nine apertures in the body.

sanskrit: śakalīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prāṇāyāmena saṃsthitaḥ //
english: After having done the sakalīkaraṇa accomplishing deed one should remain composed by the performance of regulation of breath.

sanskrit: triḥ samāvartayen mantrī manasā śivasaṃhitāṃ /
english: The performer should mentally repeat thrice the śivasaṃhitā.

sanskrit: ācamya nyasya sandhyāñca brāhmīṃ prātaḥ smarennaraḥ //
english: After having sipped water and performing nyāsa assigning gods or mantras in different parts of the body, one should meditate upon the goddess brāhmī and the sandhyā in the morning as follows

sanskrit: haṃsapadmāsanāṃ raktāṃ caturvaktrāṃ caturbhujāṃ / praskandamālinīṃ dakṣe vāme daṇḍakamaṇḍaluṃ //
english: The goddess having red complexion, has four faces, four arms with hanging garlands in the right arms and a stick and kamaṇḍalu small pitcher in the left arms and seated in the crossedleg posture on the swan.

sanskrit: tārkṣyapadmāsanāṃ dhyāyenmadhyāhne vaiṣṇavīṃ sitāṃ / śaṅkhacakradharāṃ vāme dakṣiṇe sagadābhayaṃ //
english: The midday twilight should be contemplated as Vaiṣṇavi, white in complexion, seated with crossedlegs on the Garuḍa, holding conch and disc in the left arm and the mace and abhaya mudrā hand showing protection in the right hand.

sanskrit: raudrīṃ dhyāyed vṛṣābjasthāṃ trinetrāṃ śaśibhūṣitāṃ / triśūlākṣadharāṃ dakṣe vāme sābhayaśaktikāṃ //
english: Raudrī should be meditated upon as seated on the lotus and as riding the bull, possessing three eyes, decorated by the moon and holding trident and rosary in the right arm and the protective posture abhaya and mace in the left arm.

sanskrit: sākṣiṇīṃ karmaṇāṃ sandhyāṃ ātmānaṃ tatprabhānugaṃ /
english: The twilight is the witness of deeds of men. The soul should be known as following its radiance.

sanskrit: caturthī jñāninaḥ sandhyā niśīthādau vibhāvyate //
english: The fourth twilight is that of the learned and it is meditated upon in the night.

sanskrit: hṛdbindubrahmarandhreṣu arūpā tu pare sthitā / śivabodhaparā yā tu sā sandhyā maramocyate //
english: The supreme sandhyā is declared as that which remains. invisible in the cavities situated at the heart, and the upper end of the nose and which secures the realization of Śiva.

sanskrit: paitryaṃ mūle pradeśinyāḥ kaniṣṭhāyāḥ prajāpateḥ /
english: The root of the forefinger is known to be the pitṛtīrtha and that of the little finger as that of Prajāpati.

sanskrit: brāhmyamaṅguṣṭhamūlasthaṃ tīrthaṃ daivaṃ karāgrataḥ //
english: The root of the thumb is known to be that of Brahmā, while the forepart of the hand is held sacred for all gods.

sanskrit: savyapāṇitale vahnestīrthaṃ somasya vāmataḥ /
english: It is the place of sacred fire on the palm of the left hand, and the soma on that of the right hand.

sanskrit: ṛṣīṇāṃ tu samagreṣu aṅgulīparvasandhiṣu //
english: All the tips and folds on the fingers are sacred for the sages.

sanskrit: tataḥ śivātmakair mantraiḥ kṛtvā tīrthaṃ śivātmakaṃ / mārjanaṃ saṃhitāmantraistattoyena samācaret // vāmapāṇipatattoyayojanaṃ savyapāṇinā /
english: After having got ready the sacred waters for Śiva with the mantras pertaining to Śiva, one should sprinkle that water with the saṃhitā mantras. The water sprinkled from the right hand should drip down through the left hand and the head should be sprinkled with water with the repetition of mantras.

sanskrit: uttamāṅge kramānmantrair mārjanaṃ samudāhṛtaṃ // nītvā tadupanāsāgraṃ dakṣapāṇipuṭasthitaṃ / bodharūpaṃ sitaṃ toyaṃ vāmamākṛṣya stambhayet //
english: The water should then be drawn through the right nostril and retained. That water should then be ejected into the right palm after having conceived it as black in colour because of the redemption of one’s sins. It should be thrown on a stone slab.

sanskrit: kṣipedvajraśilāyāntu tadbhavedaghamarṣaṇaṃ // svāhāntaśivamantreṇa kuśapuṣpākṣatānvitaṃ / śivāyārghyāñjalindatvā gāyatrīṃ śaktito japet //
english: Then one should repeat the gāyatrī mantra as many times as possible after having offered the respectful arghya consisting, of kuśa, flowers and unbroken rice to Śiva with the mantras of Śiva ending with the syllable svāhā oblation.

sanskrit: tarpaṇaṃ sampravakṣyāmi devatīrthena mantrakāt /
english: shall describe the offering of water oblations to the god.

sanskrit: tarpayeddhauṃ śivāyeti svāhānyān svāhayā yutān //
english: One should utter the mantra Śivāya svāhā oblations to Śiva and offer water.

sanskrit: hrāṃ hṛdyāya hrīṃ śirase hrūṃ śikhāyai hraiṃ kavacāya / astrāyāṣṭau devagaṇān hṛdādityebhya eva ca //
english: The nyāsa should be done as hrāṃ, to the heart hrīṃ, to the head hrūṃ, to the tuft of hair hraiṃ, to the armour and the weapons, or in the alternative, the eight gods can be located in the heart and other limbs.

sanskrit: bhṛgubhyo hāmaṅgirobhya ṛṣīn kaṇṭhopavītyatha // atreye 'tha vasiṣṭhāya namaścātha pulastaye / kṛtave bhāradvajāya viśvāmitrāya vai namaḥ // pracetase manuṣyāṃś ca sanakāya vaṣaṭ tathā / hāṃ sanandāya vaṣaṭ sanātanāya vai vaṣaṭ //
english: The water oblations should be performed for the following godshrāṃ, to the Vasus, Rudras, Viśve devas, to the sageshāṃ to Bhṛgus, Aṅgirās, Atri salutation to Vasiṣṭha, Pulastya, Kratu, Bhāradvāja salutations to Viśvāmitra, to Pracetas vaṣaṭ to Sanaka hāṃ vaṣaṭ to Sananda, vaṣaṭ to Sanātana, vaṣaṭ to Sanatkumāra vaṣaṭ to Kapila, to Pañcaśikha, the ceremony being done with the fingers of the right hand placed at the elbow joint of the left.

sanskrit: sarvebhyo bhūtebhyo vauṣaṭ bhūtān devapitṝnatha /
english: Vauṣaṭ to all spirits.

sanskrit: dakṣaskandhopavītī ca kuśamūlāgratastilaiḥ //
english: One should offer water of oblations to the spirits, gods, and manes with the sacred thread placed on the right shoulder and with the tips of the kuśa and sesamum.

sanskrit: kavyabālānalāyātha somāya ca yamāya ca / aryamṇe cāgnisomāya varhiṣadbhyaḥ svadhāyutān //
english: Oblation should be offered to the fire, the conveyor of offerings, to Soma, to Yama, to Aryamā, the manes, Agnimanes, Agniṣvātta and Barhiṣada with the addition of svadhā food.

sanskrit: ājyapāya ca somāya viśeṣasuravat pitṝn /
english: Oblations should be given to the manes Ājyapa, Soma and to all manes as it would be done for the gods.

sanskrit: oṃ hāṃ īśānāya pitre svadhā dadyāt pitāmahe //
english: Oṃ, hāṃ to Īśāna, the svadhā food should be offered to the manes departed father and grandfather.

sanskrit: pitṛbhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ svadhātha prapitāmahe // vṛddhaprapitāmahebhyo mātṛbhyaś ca svadhā tathā / hāṃ mātāmahebhyaḥ svadhā hāṃ pramātāmahebhyaś ca // vṛddhapramātāmahebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pitṛbhyas tathā /
english: Oblations should be offered to the greatgrandfather and the manes in the form of preta the form of the manes during the period of obsequies after one’s death, the fathers, grandfathers, and great grandfathers. Food oblations should be given to greatgreatgrandfathers, mother side relatives such as the maternal grandfathers, greatgrandfathers, greatgreatgrandfathers and all manes.

sanskrit: sarbhebhyaḥ svadhā jñātibhyaḥ sarvācāryebhya eva ca / diśāṃ dikpatisiddhānāṃ mātṝṇāṃ graharakṣasāṃ //
english: Food oblation should be offered to all departed paternal relatives, preceptors, to different quarters of heaven, to their lords, to the divine mothers and to demons.

sanskrit: vakṣye sūryārcanaṃ skanda karāṅganyāsapūrvakaṃ / ahaṃ tejomayaḥ sūrya iti dhyātvārghyamarcayet //
english: O Skanda! shall describe the mode of worship of Sun preceded by the assignment of letters on the body. After having contemplated as “ am the Sun ”, one should worship by offering waters arghya.

sanskrit: pūrayedraktavarṇena lalāṭākṛṣṭavindunā /
english: It should be conceived as filled with red colour with the drop of water drawn to the forehead.

sanskrit: taṃ saṃpūjya raveraṅgaiḥ kṛtvā rakṣāvaguṇṭhanaṃ // samprokṣya tajjalair dravyaṃ pūrvāsyo bhānumarcayet /
english: After having worshipped it and after making the protective covering with the limbs of the sungod, that water should be sprinkled on the materials of worship and the sungod should be worshipped remaining facing the east.

sanskrit: oṃ aṃ hṛdvījādi sarvatra pūjanaṃ daṇḍipiṅgalau //
english: One should recite the syllables oṃ aṃ hṛdayāya etc.

sanskrit: dvāri dakṣe vāmapārśve īśāne aṃ gaṇāya ca / agnau guruṃ pīṭhamadhye prabhūtaṃ cāsanaṃ yajet //
english: Salutations should be made to the gaṇa saying aṃ gaṇāya on the northeast. The preceptor should be worshipped in the southeast and the lofty seat of the deity should be worshipped in the middle of the altar.

sanskrit: agnyādau vimalaṃ sāramārādhyaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ / sitaraktapītanīlavarṇān siṃhanibhān yajet //
english: One should worship vimala, sāra, parama and sukha, the rays of the sun, which are to be worshipped in the directions southeast and should be conceived as strong as the lion and of the colours of white, red, yellow and blue.

sanskrit: padmamadhye rāṃ ca dīptāṃ rīṃ sūkṣmāṃ raṃ jayāṃ kramāt / rūṃ bhadrāṃ reṃ vibhūtīś ca vimalāṃ raimamoghayā // roṃ rauṃ vidyutā śaktiṃ pūrvādyāḥ sarvatomukhāḥ /
english: One should worship the essences of the energies of the lord rādiptā radiant, rajayā victorious, rubhadrā auspicious, revibhūti prosperity, raivimalā pure, raiamoghā profound, rauvidyut lightning, in the quarters east etc. inside the lotus shaped diagram.

sanskrit: raṃ madhye arkāsanaṃ syāt sūryamūrtiṃ ṣaḍakṣaraṃ // oṃ haṃ khaṃ kholkayeti yajedāvāhya bhāskaraṃ /
english: The seat of the sun would be at the centre established by the syllable raṃ. One should invoke the sun and worship his form with the sixsyllabled mantra oṃ haṃ khakholkāya.

sanskrit: lalāṭākṛṣṭamañjalyāṃ dhyātvā raktaṃ nyasedraviṃ //
english: One should assign the sungod after having meditated upon the altar with the folded hands lifted to the forehead.

sanskrit: hrāṃ hrīṃ saḥ sūryāya namo mudrayāvāhanādikaṃ / vidhāya prītaye vimbamudrāṃ gandhādikaṃ dadet //
english: One should invoke the god with the mantra hrāṃ hrīṃ sa and salutations to the sungod , showing the mudrā. One should offer him perfume etc.

sanskrit: padmamudrāṃ bilvamudrāṃ pradarśyāgnau hṛdīritaṃ /
english: One should show the padmamudrā and the bilvamudrā to the god in all directions commencing with the southeast.

sanskrit: oṃ āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ arkāya śirase tathā //
english: Oṃ aṃ salutations to the heart. Salutations to sun on the head.

sanskrit: bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ sureśāya śikhāyai nairṛte yajet / huṃ kavacāya vāyavye hāṃ netrāyeti madhyataḥ //
english: Bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ! Obeisance to the lord of celestials in the tuft of hair in the southwest, huṃ to the armour in the northwest, hāṃ to the eyes at the centre.

sanskrit: vaḥ astrāyeti pūrvādau tato mudrāḥ pradarśayet /
english: Va! salutations to the weapons in the east etc. Then one should show mudrās.

sanskrit: dhenumudrā hṛdādīnāṃ goviṣāṇā ca netrayoḥ //
english: Dhenumudrā fingers folded in the shape of a cow to the heart etc., The Goviṣāṇa mudrā should be shown to the eyes.

sanskrit: astrasya trāsanī yojyā grahaṇāṃ ca namaskriyā / soṃ somaṃ buṃ budhaṃ vṛñca jīvaṃ bhaṃ bhārgavaṃ yajet // dale pūrvādike 'gnyādau aṃ bhaumaṃ śaṃ śanaiś caraṃ /
english: The trasanī the dreadful should be added to the mantra of the weapon and obeisance should be made to the planets as followssoṃ salutations to the Moon, buṃ salutations to Mercury, bṛṃ to Jupiter, bhaṃ to Venus, aṃ to Mars, saṃ to Saturn, raṃ to Rāhu and keṃ to Ketu to be done in the petals of the lotus commencing with the east.

sanskrit: raṃ rāhuṃ keṃ ketave ca gandhādyaiś ca khakholkayā //
english: The perfumes etc. should be offered with the khakholka mantra.

sanskrit: mūlaṃ japtvārghyapātrāmbu datvā sūryāya saṃstutiḥ / natvā parāṅmukhañcārkaṃ kṣamasveti tato vadet // śarāṇunā phaḍantena samāhatyāṇusaṃhṛtiṃ /
english: Having recited the principal mantra, water of oblation from the watervessel should be offered to the sungod. Then the worshipper should sing the glory of the lord, pay obeisance to him with his face turned away and say “Pardon me, taking leave of thee”.

sanskrit: hṛtpadme śivasūryetisaṃhāriṇyopasaṃskṛtiṃ // yojayettejaś caṇḍāya ravinirmālyamarpayet /
english: The sungod should be conceived as identical with lord Śiva in the lotus of the heart. One should offer light to the lord as a garland made of the solar rays.

sanskrit: abhyarcyaiśe japāddhyānāddhomātsarvaṃ raverbhavet // śivapūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi ācamya praṇavārghyavān / dvāramastrāmbunā prokṣya homādidvārapānyajet //
english: shall describe the mode of worshipping Śiva . After having sipped water, and repeated the syllable Oṃ, one should wash the entrance of the temple with water consecrated by the mantra of the weapon and worship the guardian deities of the doorways and of the oblations etc.

sanskrit: gaṇaṃ sarasvatīṃ lakṣmīmūrdhvodumbarake yajet / nandigaṅge dakṣiṇe 'tha sthite vāmagate yajet // mahākālaṃ ca yamunāṃ divyadṛṣṭinipātitaḥ / utsārya divyān vighnāṃś ca puṣpākṣepāntarikṣagān //
english: One should worship goddess Sarasvatī consort.of Lord Brahmā, Lakṣmī consort of Lord Viṣṇu and Gaṇa at the threshold, Nandin attendant of Lord Śiva and the Ganges on the right and Mahākāla form of Śiva and the Yamunā river on the left imagining himself as having divine sight, and after having driven the spirits and impediments present in the sky by throwing a consecrated flower.

sanskrit: dakṣapārṣṇitribhirghātaibhūmiṣṭhānyāgamandiraṃ / dehalīṃ laṅghayedvāmaśākhāmāśritya vai viśet // praviśya dakṣapādena vinyasyāstramudumbare / oṃ hāṃ vāstvadhipataye brahmaṇe madhyato yajet //
english: One should kick the earth thrice with the right heels and enter the place of worship after leaping across the threshold holding the left door frame. Having entered the temple by placing the right foot first and placing the weapons at the threshold, one should worship at its centre repeating the following Oṃ, hāṃ, obeisance to Brahmā, the presiding deity of the dwelling place.

sanskrit: nirīkṣaṇādibhiḥ śastraiḥ śuddhānādāya gaḍḍukān / labdhānujñaḥ śivānmaunī gaṅgādikamanuvrajet //
english: Then he should go to the river Ganges silently carrying pure golden pitchers by means of searching instruments, after having obtained permission from Śiva.

sanskrit: pavitrāṅgaḥ prajaptena vastrapūtena vāriṇā / pūrayedambudhau tāṃstān gayatryā hṛdayena vā //
english: One should fill them with waters of the river filtered with the cloth after the repetition of gāyatrī or the hṛdayamantra, and purifying one’s body.

sanskrit: gandhakākṣata puṣpādisarvadravyasamuccayaṃ /
english: The materials for worship such as the perfumes, unbroken rice and flowers etc.

sanskrit: sannidhīkṛtya pūjārthaṃ bhūtaśuddhādi kārayet //
english: should be placed in front of the place and the purification of five material components of the earth should be done.

sanskrit: devadakṣe tato nyasya saumyāsyaś ca śarīrataḥ / saṃhāramudrayādāya mūrdhni mantreṇa dhārayet //
english: Having placed these materials on the right side of the deity with a pleasing face and having lifted these showing saṃhāra mudrā posture of the fingers representing destruction, one should place them on the head with the repetition of the mantra.

sanskrit: bhogyakarmopabhogārthaṃ pāṇikacchapikākhyayā / hṛdambuje nijātmānaṃ dvādaśāntapade 'thavā //
english: One who is desirous of enjoying the fruits of action should meditate upon his soul in the twelvepetalled lotus in the heart by means of showing pāṇikacchapikā a particular way of showing the fingers.

sanskrit: śodhayet pañcabhūtāni sañcintya śuṣirantanau /
english: As an alternative one should purify the five elements by meditating upon the apertures in the body from the toes of the feet upwards both inside and outside.

sanskrit: caraṇāṅguṣṭhayoryugmān śuṣirāntarvahiḥ smaret // śaktiṃ hṛdvyāpinīṃ paścāddhūṅkāre pāvakaprabhe / randhramadhyasthite kṛtvā prāṇarodhaṃ hi cintakaḥ // niveśayedrecakānte phaḍantenātha tena ca /
english: One who meditates should control his breath and meditate on the energy which pervades the region of the heart, in the letter hum which resembles the fire and which is situated at the centre of the aperture. The breath should then be let out and the fiery image should be led through the heart, neck, palate, the intervening space between the two eyebrows and the seat of the soul in the head brahmarandhra, with the ending syllable phaṭ.

sanskrit: hṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhyabrahmarandhre vibhidya ca // granthīnnirbhidya hūṅkāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya jīvanaṃ / sampuṭaṃ hṛdayenātha pūrakāhitacetanaṃ //
english: Having broken the knots, the life syllable huṃ should be located on the head and the consciousness should be reflected back in the heart by means of the pūraka filling with air drawn through the nostril. Having placed the syllable huṃ on the tuft, one should meditate upon the absolute soul of the form of a speck.

sanskrit: hūṃ śikhopari vinyasya śuddhaṃ vindvātmakaṃ smaret / kṛtvātha kumbhakaṃ śambhau ekodghātena yojayet // recakena vījavṛttyā śive līno 'tha śodhayet / pratilomaṃ svadehe tu vindvantaṃ tatra vindukaṃ //
english: Having withheld the breath at a single stretch, one should unite the consciousness with Śambhu Śiva. After having merged himself with Śiva, by means of drawing his consciousness with the aid of bījamantras and the recaka exhalation of the breath, the worshipper should purify by carrying in the reverse order the luminous point in the brain to the point in the nervecomplex.

sanskrit: layannītvā mahīvātau jalavahnī parasparaṃ / dvau dvau sādhyau tathākāśamavirodhena tacchṛṇu //
english: One should merge the earth, wind, water, fire and sky, one into the other without any deviation in the order. You hear about it now!

sanskrit: pārthivaṃ maṇḍalaṃ pītaṃ kaṭhinaṃ vajralāñchitaṃ /
english: The principle of earth is hard, of yellowish colour and bears the mark of thunderbolt.

sanskrit: haumityātmīyavījena tannivṛttikalāmayaṃ //
english: Then its destruction is wrought by the subtle mantra of the soul namely hauṃ.

sanskrit: padādārabhya mūrdhānaṃ vicintya caturasrakaṃ / udghātapañcakenaiva vāyubhūtaṃ vicintayet //
english: The entire body from foot to head should be contemplated as a foursided figure, and the principle of wind should be meditated therein by five stretches of retention of breath.

sanskrit: ardhacandraṃ dravaṃ saumyaṃ śubhrasambhojalāñchitaṃ / hrīmityanena vījena pratiṣṭhārūpatāṃ gataṃ //
english: This principle which has been established with the principal syllable hrīṃ should be contemplated as of halfcrescentshaped in a liquid state, white in colour, beautiful and impressed with the figure of the lotus.

sanskrit: saṃyuktaṃ rāmamantreṇa puruṣāntamakāraṇaṃ / arghyañcaturbhirudghātair vahnibhūtaṃ viśodhayet //
english: The reverential principle of fire which is causeless and which is the end of men, should be purified by four stretches of retention of breath along with the Rāma mantra.

sanskrit: āgneyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tryastraṃ raktaṃ svastikalāñchitaṃ / hūmityanena vījena vidyārūpaṃ vibhāvayet //
english: The orb of fire should be conceived as threesided, red in colour, marked with the sign of svastika and as the form of knowledge and endowed with the principal syllable hūṃ.

sanskrit: ghorāṇutribhirudghātair jalabhūtaṃ viśodhayet /
english: The principle of water should be purified by means of three stretches of awful minuteness.

sanskrit: ṣaḍasraṃ maṇḍalaṃ vāyorvindubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiraṅkitaṃ // kṛṣṇaṃ hremiti vījena jātaṃ śāntikalāmayaṃ /
