sanskrit: yat kiñcidvārṣikaṃ karma kṛtaṃ nyūnādhikaṃ mayā / tadastu paripūrṇaṃ me caṇḍa nātha tavājñayā //
english: “Whatever annual rite has been done by me defectively, may that become perfect by your mandate, O lord! Caṇḍa! my master!”

sanskrit: iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ natvā stutvā visarjayet /
english: Having thus submitted to the lord of celestials, he should be given farewell after obeisance and praise.

sanskrit: tyaktanirmālyakaḥ śuddhaḥ snāpayitvā śivaṃ yajet /
english: After having removed the materials of worship from the images and becoming pure, the votary should bathe the image and worship lord Śiva.

sanskrit: pañcayojanasaṃstho 'pi pavitraṃ gurusannidhau //
english: A man who remains even at a distance of five yojanas a yojana is equal to about eight miles from the preceptor is deemed to be pure.

sanskrit: vakṣye damanakārohavidhiṃ pūrvavadācaret /
english: shall describe the mode of investiture with damanaka fibres for the lord. It has to be performed as before.

sanskrit: harakopāt purā jāto bhairavo damitāḥ surāḥ //
english: Once, the celestials were harassed by Bhairava, a form born of the anger of lord Hara Śiva.

sanskrit: tenātha śapto viṭapo bhaveti tripurāriṇā /
english: Hence, he was cursed by the foe of Tripura Śiva saying, “Become a stum”.

sanskrit: prasanneneritaṃ cedaṃ pūjayiṣyanti ye narāḥ // paripūrṇaphalaṃ teṣāṃ nānyathā te bhaviṣyati / saptamyāṃ vā trayodaśyāṃ damanaṃ saṃhitātmabhiḥ //
english: Being pleased after propitiation the lord said, “Whoever propitiates you would get full benefits and not otherwise.” The votary should address the tree by the following words of Bhava Śiva after having worshipped it with the vedic hymns on the seventh or thirteenth day of a fortnight.

sanskrit: haraprasādasaṃbhūta tvamatra sannidhībhava //
english: “O tree born of the grace of lord Hara Śiva! You be present here.

sanskrit: śivakāryaṃ samuddiśya netavyo 'si śivājñayā / gṛhe 'pyāmantraṇaṃ kuryāt sāyāhne cādhivāsanaṃ // yathāvidhi samabhyarcya sūryaśaṅkarapāvakān / devasya paścime mūlaṃ dadyāttasya mṛdā yutaṃ //
english: For the sake of work of Śiva you have to be carried home as per the mandate of lord Śiva.” The tree should be invited home and the consecration should be done in the evening. Having worshipped the sungod, Śaṅkara Śiva and firegod as prescribed, the root of the tree should be placed on the west of the lord along with the clump of earth.

sanskrit: dakṣiṇe bhagnapatrañca prācyāṃ puṣpañca dhāraṇaṃ // puṭikāsthaṃ phalaṃ mūlamathaiśānyāṃ yajecchivaṃ /
english: The stump may be placed on the left or on the head of the image, the dhātrī myrabolan on the north, the broken leaves on the south and its flower on the east. The fruits and roots should be placed in a cup.

sanskrit: pañcāṅgamañjalau kṛtvā āmantrya śirasi nyaset //
english: The lord should be invoked after having placed the five articles of worshipin the folded palms and later placing them on one’s head.

sanskrit: āmantrito 'si deveśa prātaḥkāle mayā prabho / kartavyastapaso lābhaḥ pūrṇaṃ sarvaṃ tavājñayā //
english: “O lord of celestials! You have been invoked by me in the early morning! O lord! the merit of this penance has to become fully fruitful by your mandate.”

sanskrit: mūlena śeṣaṃ pātrasthaṃ pidhāyātha pavitrakaṃ / prātaḥ snātvā jagannāthaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet //
english: After having kept the sacred remnants in the vessel covered, the votary should worship the lord of the universe with flowers etc., after having bathed early in the morning.

sanskrit: nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kṛtvā damanaiḥ pūjayettataḥ /
english: After having performed the nitya and naimittika rites, he should then worship with the damana.

sanskrit: śeṣamañjalimādāya ātmavidyāśivātmabhiḥ // mūlādyair īśvarāntaiś ca caturthāñjalinā tataḥ /
english: After having kept the remnants in the folded palms, lord Śiva, firegod and the preceptor should be worshipped with the mantras of the lord of the principle of knowledge of soul, the principal mantras of the lord ending with the names of Īśvara, with four handfuls of offering.

sanskrit: oṃ hauṃ makheśvarāya makhaṃ pūraya śūlapāṇaye namaḥ //
english: “Oṃ hauṃ obeisance to the lord of sacrifice.

sanskrit: śivaṃ vahniṃ ca sampūjya guruṃ prārcyātha bodhayet //
english: Complete the sacrifice. Obeisance to the holder of the spear.”

sanskrit: bhagavannatiriktaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā yanmayā kṛtaṃ / sarvaṃ tadastu sampūrṇaṃ yacca dāmanakaṃ mama /
english: “O lord! Whatever has been in excess or in short in my acts let all that be complete by this investiture of the damanaka by me”.

sanskrit: sakalaṃ caitramāsotthaṃ phalaṃ prāpya divaṃ vrajet //
english: Whoever performs this would go to heaven after having obtained the benefits of all that is got in the month of Caitra AprilMay.

sanskrit: vākṣyāmi bhogamokṣārthaṃ dīkṣāṃ pāpakṣayaṅkarīṃ / malamāyādipāśānāṃ viśleṣaḥ kriyate yayā // jñānañca janyate śiṣye sā dīkṣā bhuktimuktidā /
english: shall describe the spiritual initiation for the sake of enjoyment and release from bondage, destroying one’s sins and shattering bondages of impurities and illusion by which, knowledge is gained by the disciple, that initiation is considered as yielding enjoyment and release.

sanskrit: vijñātakalanāmaiko dvitīyaḥ pralayākalaḥ //
english: The first one is vijñātakala cognisant of the beatitudes. The second one is pralayakala a psychic state from which one can be cognisant of those attributes.

sanskrit: tṛtīyaḥ sakalaḥ śāstre 'nugrāhyastrividho mataḥ /
english: The third one is sakala clouded by worldly impurity. These deserve initiation in scriptures.

sanskrit: tatrādyo malamātreṇa mukto 'nyo malakarmabhiḥ // kalādibhūmiparyantaṃ stavaistu sakalo yataḥ /
english: The first category among these is free from all mental impurities, while the second is free from sinful acts. The third variety can hold communion by prayer with the region from kalā. to the earth.

sanskrit: nirādhārātha sādhārā dīkṣāpi dvividhā matā //
english: The initiation is also considered to be of two kindsdevoid of any hold and possessing a hold.

sanskrit: nirādhārā dvayosteṣāṃ sādhārā sakalasya tu /
english: The initiation independent of any external aid is for the first two categories among the three and that which is dependent on any external aid is for the third category sakala endowed with a form.

sanskrit: ādhāranirapekṣeṇa kriyate śambhucaryayā //
english: The initiation in the first sort is done by the worship of Śambhu Śiva alone without any dependence.

sanskrit: tīvraśaktinipātena nirādhāreti sā smṛtā / ācāryamūrtimāsthāya māyātīvrādibhedayā //
english: That which is remembered as independent is achieved by an impact of strong piercing force by resorting to the image in the form of the preceptor and by rending asunder the veil of illusion.

sanskrit: śaktyā yāṃ kurute śambhuḥ sā sādhikaraṇocyate /
english: That initiation in which Lord Śambhu Śiva does it, is spoken as dependant.

sanskrit: iyaṃ caturvidhā proktā savījā vījavarjitā // sādhikārānadhikārā yathā tadabhidhīyate / samayācārasaṃyuktā savījā jāyate nṛṇāṃ //
english: The spiritual initiation is said to be of four kindssabījā together with imparting of some mantra, bījavarjitā without any mantra, sādhikarā with some governance, anadhikārā without any governance. They are described now.

sanskrit: nirvījā tvasamarthānāṃ samayācāravarjitā /
english: The nirbījā variety is intended for the incapable which is devoid of any code of conduct of the scriptures.

sanskrit: nitye naimittike kāmye yataḥ syādadhikāritā // sādhikārā bhaveddīkṣā sādhakācāryayorataḥ /
english: The sādhikārā type of initiation shall be in the case of rites of daily nature and those done with a motive for the disciple and the preceptor.

sanskrit: nirvījā dīkṣitānāntu yadāsa mama putrayoḥ //
english: The nirbījā type of initiation is in those cases where the disciples possess characteristics as my two sons.

sanskrit: nityamātrādhikāratvaddīkṣā niradhikārikā /
english: The niradhikārikā type of initiation allows one to undertake rites in which the disciple does not aspire for the fruits.

sanskrit: dvividheyaṃ dvirūpā hi pratyekamupajāyate //
english: This initiation may be of two kinds marked by the individual characteristics.

sanskrit: ekā kriyāvatī tatra kuṇḍamaṇḍalapūrvikā /
english: One consists of performance of acts preceded by preparations of sacrificial pits and mystical diagrams.

sanskrit: manovyāpāramātreṇa yā sā jñānavatī matā //
english: The other one is composed of knowledge which is achieved by the operation of the mind.

sanskrit: itthaṃ labdhādhikāreṇa dīkṣā.acāryeṇa sādhyate /
english: In this way an initiation may be made by a preceptor who has the right to administer.

sanskrit: skandadīkṣāṃ guruḥ kuryāt kṛtvā nityakriyāṃ tataḥ //
english: The skandadīkṣā may be done by the preceptor after doing daily rites.

sanskrit: praṇavārgyakarāmbhojakṛtadvārādhipārcaṇaḥ / vighnānutsārya dehalyāṃ nyasyāstraṃ svāsane sthitaḥ // kurvīta bhūtasaṃśuddhiṃ mantrayogaṃ yathoditaṃ /
english: The preceptor should purify the place from the spirits remaining in his own seat, having the arghya waters of respect in the lotus palm and worshipping the guardian deities of the threshold with praṇava mantra and after removing the obstacles and placing the weapons at the threshold.

sanskrit: tilataṇḍulasiddhārthakuśadūrvākṣatodakaṃ // sayavakṣīranīrañca viśeṣārghyamidantataḥ /
english: The special arghya offering should consist of sesamum, rice, white mustard, kuśa, dūrvā, unbroken rice, mixed with water, barley, milk and water.

sanskrit: tadambunā dravyaśuddhiṃ tilakaṃ svāsanātmanoḥ //
english: Then the materials for worship should be done pure with that water.

sanskrit: pūjanaṃ mantraśiddhiñca pañcagavyañca pūrvavat / lājacandanasiddhārthabhasmadūrvākṣataṃ kuśān //
english: After putting the mark and the worship of the self and of the seat, the materials of worship such as the five things got from a cow, fried paddy, sandal, white mustard,.

sanskrit: vikirān śuddhalājāṃstān sadhūpānastramantritān / śastrāmbuprokṣitānetān kavacenāvaguṇṭhitān // nānāgrahaṇākārān vighnaughavinivārakān /
english: sacred ashes, dūrvā, unbroken rice and kuśa should be purified asbefore with mantras. The pure fried paddy which has been scattered should be consecrated with mantras of weapons along with incense and consecrated with waters with the mantras of implements and covered by armour.

sanskrit: darbhāṇāntālamānena kṛtvā ṣaṭtriṃśatā dalaiḥ // saptajaptaṃ śivāstreṇa veṇīṃ bodhāsimuttamaṃ / śivamātmani vinyasya sṛṣṭyādhāramabhīpsitaṃ // niṣkalaṃ ca śivaṃ nyasya śivo 'hamiti bhāvayet /
english: Having made darbhas into different shapes of missiles so as to number thirtysix bunches, each measuring the length of a palm, which are capable of warding off multitudes of obstacles,and after having repeated the mantra of the weapon of Śiva seven times on the sword of knowledge continuously and having located in one’s self, lord Śiva, the basis of all creation, the most sought after, and devoid of any form, one should deem himself as “ am lord Śiva”.

sanskrit: uṣṇīṣaṃ śirasi nyasya alaṃ kuryātsvadehakaṃ // gandhamaṇḍanakaṃ svīye vidadhyāddakṣiṇe kare /
english: After having placed turban on the head one should adorn his body in the following way. He should besmear his right arm with the sandal paste. The lord should be worshipped in the prescribed way.

sanskrit: vinyasya śivamantreṇa bhāsvaraṃ nijamastake / śivādabhinnamātmānaṃ kartāraṃ bhāvayedyathā // maṇḍale karmaṇāṃ sākṣī kalaśe yajñarakṣakaḥ / homādhikaraṇaṃ vahnau śiṣye pāśavimocakaḥ //
english: This is how the head of Śiva is got ready. Having located the luminous lord on one’s own head with the mantras of Śiva, the doer should conceive himself as not different from lord Śiva as follows “He is the witness of all deeds in the mystic diagram, the protector of sacrifice in the pitcher, the recipient of oblations in the fire and the liberator of the disciple from the bonds and the benefactor in.

sanskrit: svātmanyanugṛhīteti ṣaḍādhāro ya īśvaraḥ /
english: one’s own self,” such that the lord is of six kinds of basis.

sanskrit: so 'hameveti kurvīta bhāvaṃ sthirataraṃ punaḥ //
english: One should consider himself as “ am he”. Lord Bhava Śiva should again be made firmly established in one.

sanskrit: jñānakhaḍgakaraḥ sthitvā nairṛtyābhimukho naraḥ / sārghyāmbupañcagavyābhyāṃ prokṣayedyāgamaṇḍapaṃ //
english: Then that person should remain facing the southwest holding the sword of knowledge and sprinkle the sacrificial shed with the waters of respectful offering and the five things got from the cow.

sanskrit: catuṣpathāntasaṃskāraiḥ saṃskuryādīkṣaṇādibhiḥ / vikṣipya vikarāṃstatra kuśakūrcopasaṃharet //
english: By purification at the crossroads and by divine look, darbhas should be purified. Having thrown the scattered darbhas there, darbhas should be gathered. A seat should be made ready with them in the northeast direction for the pitcher.

sanskrit: tānīśadiśi vardhanyāmāsanāyopakalpayet / nairṛte vāstugīrvāṇān dvāre lakṣmīṃ prapūjayet //
english: The presiding deity of the place and the celestials should be worshipped in the southwest and Goddess Lakṣmī at the entrance of the sacrificial shed.

sanskrit: āpye ratnaiḥ pūrayantīṃ hṛdā maṇḍaparūpiṇīṃ /
english: Goddess Pūrayantī of the form of sacrificial shed should be worshipped in the west with gems and with the hṛd mantra.

sanskrit: sāmbuvastre saratne ca dhānyasthe paścimānane // aiśe kumbhe yajecchambhuṃ śaktiṃ kumbhasya dakṣiṇe / paścimasyāntu siṃhasthāṃ vardhanīṃ khaḍgarūpiṇīṃ //
english: Lord Śambhu Śiva should be worshipped in a pitcher placed in the northeast over the grains and containing water, gems and a piece of cloth over the mouth with the face of the worshipper turned towards the west. Goddess Śakti should be worshipped in the south of the pitcher.

sanskrit: dikṣu śakrādidikpālānviṣṇvantān praṇavāsanān / vāhanāyudhasaṃyuktān hṛdābhyarcya svanāmabhiḥ // prathamantāṃ samādāya kumbhasyāgrābhigāminīṃ / avicchinnapayodharāṃ bhrāmayitvā pradakṣiṇaṃ //
english: Having worshipped with their respective names and the hṛd mantra the gods Indra and the guardian deities of the directions ending with Viṣṇu placed on the praṇava oṃ, riding their respective vehicles and holding their respective weapons, that the sacrificial jar should be carried round in front of pitchers and an uninterrupted flow of water should be made after making a circumambulation.

sanskrit: śivājñāṃ lokapālānāṃ śrāvayenmūlamuccaran /
english: After having recited the principal mantra, the mandate of Lord Śiva should be conveyed to the guardian deities.

sanskrit: saṃrakṣata yathāyogaṃ kumbhaṃ dhṛtvātha tāṃ dhāret //
english: The jar should be duly consecrated and it should be held.

sanskrit: tataḥ sthirāsane kumbhe sāṅgaṃ sampūjya śaṅkaraṃ / vinyasya śodhyamadhvānaṃ vardhanyāmastramarcayet //
english: After having worshipped lord Śaṅkara Śiva in the pitcher placed on a firm seat along with the retinue, the weapon should be worshipped in the vardhanī after being placed to purify the path.

sanskrit: caturvaktraṃ sadaṃṣṭrañca smaredastraṃ saśaktikaṃ / samudgaratriśūlāsiṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaṃ //
english: The weapon should be meditated upon as possessing four faces and having teeth in the company of the Goddess Śakti, effulgent like crores of suns and wielding a mace, spear and sword.

sanskrit: bhagaliṅgasamāyogaṃ vidadhyālliṅgamudrayā /
english: By showing liṅgamudrā a posture of fingers denoting liṅga, the union of the bhaga base and the liṅga is accomplished.

sanskrit: agguṣṭhena spṛśet kumbhaṃ hṛdā muṣṭyāstravardhanīṃ //
english: The pitcher should be touched with the little finger, the weapon with the heart and vardhanī with the clenched fist.

sanskrit: bhuktaye muktaye tvādau muṣṭinā vardhanīṃ spṛśet / kumbhasya mukharakṣārthaṃ jñānakhaḍgaṃ samarpayet //
english: The vardhanī should first be touched with the clenched fist for the sake of enjoyment and release from worldly existence. The sword of knowledge should be offered for protecting the mouth of the pitcher.

sanskrit: śastrañca mūlamantrasya śataṃ kumbhe niveśayet / taddaśāṃśena vardhanyāṃ rakṣāṃ vijñāpayettataḥ //
english: After the repetition of the principal mantra hundred times, the weapon should be placed in the pitcher. A tenth part of it should then be conveyed to the vardhanī for the sake of protection.

sanskrit: yathedaṃ kṛtayatnena bhagavanmakhamandiraṃ /
english: “O lord of the universe! This sacrificial shed has been raised with great effort.

sanskrit: rakṣaṇīyaṃ jagannātha sarvādhvaradhara tvayā //
english: O lord! the sustainer of all sacrifices! This has to be protected by you.”

sanskrit: praṇavasthaṃ caturbāhuṃ vāyavye gaṇamarcayet / sthaṇḍile śivamabhyarcya sārghyakuṇḍaṃ vrajennaraḥ //
english: The lord Gaṇa placed on the praṇava oṃ and having four arms should be worshipped in the northwest by offering water. Having worshipped lord Śiva on the ground, the worshipper should proceed near the pit.

sanskrit: niviṣṭo mantratṛptyarthamarghyagandhaghṛtādikaṃ /
english: Remaining in contemplation for the sake of pleasing the mantras, and having placed the water of respectful offering, perfumes, ghee etc.

sanskrit: vāme 'savye tu vinyasya samiddarbhatilādikaṃ //
english: on the left and the twigs, darbha, sesamum etc.

sanskrit: kuṇḍavahnisrugājyādi prāgvat saṃskṛtya bhāvayet / mukhyatāmūrdhvavaktrasya hṛdi vahnau śivaṃ yajet //
english: on the right, and having purified the pit, fire, ladle etc. as before, the worshipper should think of the greatness of the elevatedfaced god in the heart and worship lord Śiva in the sacrificial fire.

sanskrit: svamūrtau śivakumbhe ca sthaṇḍile tvagniśiṣyayoḥ / sṛṣṭinyāsena vinyasya śodhyādhvānaṃ yathāvidhi //
english: After having performed sṛṣṭinyāsa assignment representing creation in one’s body, in the pitcher of lord Śiva, on the sacrificial ground, in the hṛd and the body of the disciple, purification and meditation should be done in the prescribed way.

sanskrit: kuṇḍamānaṃ mukhaṃ dhyātvā hṛdāhutibhirīpsitaṃ / vījāni saptajihvānāmagnerhomāya bhaṇyate // virephāvantimauvarṇau rephaṣaṣṭhasvarānvitau / induvinduśikhāyuktau jihvāvījānupakramāt //
english: Having contemplated the face of the same measure of the pit,the hṛd bīja mantras are repeated and oblations made for the seven tongues of the fire. The principal mantras for the tongue should have the last letters without the letter ‘ra’, and should have the sound of six ‘ra’s and the moon, a point and the tuft.

sanskrit: hiraṇyā vanakā raktā kṛṣṇā tadanu suprabhā / atiriktā bahurūpā rudrendrāgnyāpyadiṅmukhā //
english: Hiraṇyā, Kanakā, Raktā, Kṛṣṇā, Suprabhā, Atiriktā and Bahurūpā should in order be placed in the directions northeast, east, southeast and west.

sanskrit: kṣīrādimadhurair homaṃ kuryācchāntikapauṣṭike / abhicāre tu piṇyākasaktukañcukakāñcikaiḥ // lavaṇair ājikātakrakaṭutailaiś ca kaṇṭakaiḥ /
english: in the rites to appease god or seeking welfare and with oilcakes, flour, one’s dress and sourgruel in the rites performed for harming some one. An angry man should offer oblations of salt, goat’s curd, pungent oil, thorns and crooked twigs along with vedic syllables.

sanskrit: kadambakalikāhomādyakṣiṇī siddhyati dhruvaṃ /
english: Yakṣiṇī a goddess becomes certainly favourable by doing oblations with the buds of kadamba.

sanskrit: bandhūkakiṃśukādīni vaśyākarṣāya homayet //
english: One should offer oblations with bandhūka, kiṃśuka and other flowers for attracting and subjugating another person.

sanskrit: bilvaṃ rājyāya lakṣmārthaṃ pāṭalāṃś campakānapi / padmāni cakravartitve bhakṣyabhojyāni sampade //
english: The bilva leaves sacred in the worship of Śiva are offered for getting kingdOṃ, the pāṭala and campaka flowers for the sake of wealth, lotus flowers for the sake of becoming a sovereign and eatables for wealth.

sanskrit: dūrvā vyādhivināśāya sarvasattvavaśīkṛte / priyaṅgupāṭalīpuṣpaṃ cūtapatraṃ jvarāntakaṃ //
english: Dūrvā is offered for the cure of diseases, flowers priyaṅgu and pāṭalī for exercising sway over all beings, and the Āmra flower for arresting fever.

sanskrit: mṛtyuñjayo mṛtyujit syād vṛddhiḥ syāttilahomataḥ /
english: An oblation made with the mṛtyuñjaya mantra would conquer death. By the oblation of sesamum there would be prosperity.

sanskrit: rudraśāntiḥ sarvaśāntyai atha prastutamucyate //
english: Propitiation of Rudra Śiva should be made for all sorts of appeasement.

sanskrit: āhutyaṣṭaśatair mūlamaṅgāni tu daśāṃśataḥ /
english: Eight hundred oblations with the principal mantra and a tenth of it with the subordinate ones should be made.

sanskrit: santarpayeta mūlena dadyāt pūrṇāṃ yathā purā //
english: Appeasement should be made with the principal mantra. The final oblation should be offered as before.

sanskrit: tathā śiṣyapraveśāya pratiśiṣyaṃ śataṃ japet / dur nimittāpasārāya sunimittakṛte tathā //
english: Then the repetition of mantra should be made hundred times for each disciple for the entry of the disciple and for the sake of good omens after the removal of bad omens.

sanskrit: śatadvayañca hotavyaṃ mūlamantreṇa pūrvavat /
english: As before oblation should be made two hundred times with the principal mantra.

sanskrit: mūlādyaṣṭāstramantrāṇāṃ svāhāntaistarpaṇaṃ sakṛt // śikhāsampuṭitair vījair hrūṃ phaḍantaiś ca dīpanaṃ /
english: One oblation should be made with the principal mantra and the mantras of eight weapons concluding with the syllable svāhā oblation. The illumination rite should be done with the repetition of mantras of the tuft ending with the syllable phaṭ.

sanskrit: oṃ hauṃ śivāya svāhetyādimantraiś ca tarpaṇaṃ // oṃ hrūṃ hrauṃ hrīṃ śivāya hrūṃ phaḍityādidīpanaṃ /
english: Oblation should be done with the mantras like Oṃ, hrīṃ, oblations to Śiva. Then the illumination should be done with the mantras like Oṃ, hrūṃ, hrauṃ, hrīṃ, to Śiva, hrūṃ, phaṭ.

sanskrit: tataḥ śivāmbhasā sthālīṃ kṣālitāṃ varmaguṇṭhitāṃ // candanādisamālabdhāṃ badhnīyāt kaṭakaṃ gale / varmāstrajaptasaddarbhapatrābhyāṃ carusiddhaye //
english: Then the vessel for preparing the gruel should be washed with waters made sacred by the mantras of Śiva and covered by an armour. It should be besmeared with sandal paste and a girdle of darbha consecrated with the mantra of armour and weapon.

sanskrit: varmādyair āsane datte sārdhendukṛtamaṇḍale / nyastāyāṃ mūrtibhūtāyāṃ bhāvapuṣpaiḥ śivaṃ yajet //
english: After having placed the seat with the mantra of the armour, in a semicircular mystic diagram, Śiva, whose presence is accomplished in the form of an image, should be worshipped with flowers of sentiment.

sanskrit: vastrabaddhamukhāyāṃ vā sthālyāṃ puṣpair vahirbhavaiḥ /
english: Worship should be made alternatively in the vessel whose mouth has been covered with a cloth with flowers got from outside.

sanskrit: cullyāṃ paścimavaktrāyāṃ nyastāyāṃ mānuṣātmanā // nyastāhaṅkāravījāyāṃ śuddhāyāṃ vīkṣaṇādibhiḥ / dharmādharmaśarīrāyāṃ japtāyāṃ mānuṣātmanā // sthālīmāropayedastrajaptāṃ gavyāmbumārjitāṃ /
english: Over the oven placed to the right of the pit and having its mouth facing the west and previously consecrated with the syllables of ahaṅkāra egoism and the two sides of the oven having been contemplated as made up of righteousness and unrighteousness over which the mantra of the soul of man has been repeated, the vessel should be placed after having repeated the mantra of the weapon and sprinkled with the urine of cow.

sanskrit: gavyaṃ payo 'strasaṃśuddhaṃ prāsādaśatamantritaṃ //
english: The vessel should have been cleaned with the milk of cow and the mantra of the weapon and repetition of the prāsāda mantra hundred times.

sanskrit: tuṇḍalān śyāmakādīnāṃ nikṣipettatra tadyathā /
english: Rice and grains such as the śyāmāka etc. should be cast into it.

sanskrit: ekaśiṣyavidhānāya teṣāṃ prasṛtipañcakaṃ //
english: If the initiation is to be given for a single disciple five handfuls of grains should be thrown.

sanskrit: prasṛtiṃ prasṛtiṃ paścādvardhayed dvyādiṣu kramāt / kuryāccānalamantreṇa pidhānaṃ kavacāṇunā // śivāgnau mūlamantreṇa pūrvāsyaś carukaṃ pacet /
english: A handful of grains should be added. The above grains should be protected with the mantras of the fire or that of the armour. The gruel should be cooked in the flame of Śiva on the eastern face with the recitation of the principal mantra.

sanskrit: sukhinne tatra taccullyāṃ śruvamāpūrya sarpiṣā // svāhāntaiḥ saṃhitāmantrair datvā taptābhighāraṇaṃ /
english: Then having filled the ladle with the clarified butter and heated in the oven, it should be offered to the fire with the saṃhitā mantras ending with the expression “oblations for the sake of satisfaction”.

sanskrit: saṃsthāpya maṇḍale sthālīṃ saddarbhe 'strāṇunā kṛte // praṇavena pidhāyāsyāṃ taddehalepanaṃ hṛdā /
english: The vessel should be placed in the mystic circles after having consecrated with the darbha. Having covered it by the uttering of praṇava syllable oṃ, it should be besmeared with the hṛd mantra.

sanskrit: suśītalo bhavatyevam prāpya śītābhighāraṇaṃ //
english: Thus it would become cool after having received a cool plastering.

sanskrit: vidadhyātsaṃhitāmantraiḥ śiṣyaṃ prati sakṛt sakṛt / dharmādyāsanake hutvā kuṇḍamaṇḍalapaścime // sampātañca srucā hutvā śuddhiṃ saṃhitayā caret /
english: Oblations should be offered with the recitation of saṃhitā mantra once towards the disciple. After having made oblation for the sake of seats etc. on the west of the sacrificial pit and the mystic diagram, the residual offering should be made with the ladle and purification should be performed by the recitation of saṃhitii mantras.

sanskrit: carukaṃ sakṛdālabhya tayaiva vaṣaḍantayā //
english: The gruel should be taken out from the vessel with the recitation of the syllable vauṣaṭ.

sanskrit: dhenumudrāmṛtībhūtaṃ sthaṇḍileśāntikaṃ nayet / sājyabhāgaṃ svaśiṣyāṇāṃ bhāgo devāya vahnaye //
english: A part of the gruel consisting of clarified butter should be set apart for the disciples and a part for the lord Fire. A part containing honey and clarified butter should be made over to the guardian deities of the worlds.

sanskrit: kuryāttu stokapālādeḥ samadhvājyamitidaṃ trayaṃ / namo 'ntena hṛdā dadyāttenaivācamanīyakaṃ //
english: These are three parts. These should be offered to them with the hṛd mantra ending with obeisance. The water for rinsing the mouth should also be given with the same mantra.

sanskrit: sājyaṃ mantraśataṃ hutvā dadyāt pūrṇāṃ yathāvidhi /
english: The final oblation should be offered as laid down after having made hundred offerings with clarified butter along with the recitation of mantra.

sanskrit: maṇḍalaṃ kuṇḍataḥ pūrve madhye vā śambhukumbhayoḥ // rudramātṛgaṇādīnāṃ nirvartyāntarbaliṃ hṛdā / śivamadhye 'pyalabdhājño vidhāyaikatvabhāvanaṃ //
english: Having drawn a mystic diagram on the east of the sacrificial pit or in the midst of pitchers of Lord Śambhu Śiva, Rudra, the divine mothers and the gaṇas attendant gods of Śiva and after having made offerings with the hṛd mantra, the worshipper should identify himself with God Śiva in the pitcher sacred to Śiva even though he has not received a command.

sanskrit: sarvajñatādiyukto 'haṃ samantāccopari sthitaḥ /
english: He should think himself as the omniscient who stands above all things around.

sanskrit: mamāṃśo yojanāsthānamadhiṣṭhāhamadhvare //
english: He should also think “The place of union is a part of mine and am the presiding deity at the sacrifice.

sanskrit: śivo 'hamityahaṅkārī niṣkramed yāgamaṇḍapāt /
english: am lord Śiva”. Thus the performer should come out of the sacrificial shed with the sense of Iness.

sanskrit: nyastapūrvāgrasandharbhe śastrāṇukṛtamaṇḍale // praṇavāsanake śiṣyaṃ śuklavastrottarīyakaṃ / snātañcodaṅmukhaṃ muktyai pūrvavaktrantu bhuktaye //
english: Having made the disciple to be seated on the seat of darbha already placed on a mystic diagram with the mantra of the weapon and duly consecrated with the praṇava syllable oṃ, and providing him with white upper garment after the bath, the disciple should be made to face north for emancipation and the east for enjoyment.

sanskrit: ūrdhvaṃ kāyaṃ samāropya pūrvāsyaṃ pravilokayet / caraṇādiśikhāṃ yāvanmuktau bhuktau vilomataḥ //
english: Having made the disciple to sit erect and face the east, the preceptor should look at him from foot to tuft if the initiation is for emancipation and in the reverse direction if it is for enjoyment.

sanskrit: cakṣuṣā saprasādena śaivaṃ dhāma vivṛṇvatā /
english: The preceptor should look at the disciple graciously extending the splendour of Śiva.

sanskrit: astrodakena sammokṣya mantrāmbusnānasiddaye // bhasmasnānāya vighnānāṃ śāntaye pāpabhittaye / sṛṣṭisaṃhārayogena tāḍayedastrabhasmanā //
english: Having sprinkled water with the mantra of the weapon in order to accomplish purification by means of consecrated water, the disciple should be struck with the ashes accompanied by the mantra of the weapon for the purpose of bathing with the ashes and for the destruction of obstacles and sins by the union of creation and destruction.

sanskrit: punarastrāmbunā prokṣya sakalīkaraṇāya taṃ / nābherūrdhvaṃ kuśāgreṇa mārjanīyāstramuccaran // tridhā.alabheta tanmūlair aghamarṣāya nābhyadhaḥ / dvaividhyāya ca pāśānāṃ ālabheta śarāṇunā //
english: Having sprinkled him again with the water of the weapon for the sake of consummation and having repeated the bathing mantra of the weapon above the navel with the tip of kuśa, one should.touch thrice under the navel with the recitation of the principal mantra for the destroyal of sin and with the mantra of the arrow for the breaking of bonds.

sanskrit: taccharīre śivaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāsanaṃ vinyasettataḥ / puṣpādipūjitasyāsya netre netreṇa vā hṛdā //
english: Then the preceptor should locate lord Śiva in the body of the disciple along with his seat and attendants by offering worship with flowers and by looking into his eyes or by the heart.

sanskrit: pradakṣiṇakramādenaṃ praveśya śivadakṣiṇaṃ // savastramāsanaṃ dadyāt yathāvarṇaṃ nivedayet /
english: Having tied the seat with a white cloth with the recitation of mantra, and having made him enter by means of circumambulation of Śiva, the seat along with the cloth should be given.

sanskrit: saṃhāramudrayātmānaṃ mūrtyā tasya hṛdambuje //
english: The preceptor should exhibit the saṃhāra mudrā posture with fingers indicating gathering and communicate his own self with that form in the lotus of the heart of the disciple.

sanskrit: nirudhya śodhite kāye nyāsaṃ kṛtvā tamarcayet / pūrvānanasya śiṣyasya mūlamantreṇa mastake //
english: Having retained that form of Śiva in the purified body and having located it there, it should be worshipped in the east facing the forehead of the disciple with the principal mantra.

sanskrit: śivahastaṃ pradātavyaṃ rudreśapadadāyakaṃ / śivasevāgrahopāyaṃ dattahastaṃ śivāṇunā //
english: The hand of the disciple should be converted into a hand sacred to lord Śiva and permeated with the essence of lordŚiva by telling the Śiva mantra, such a hand being known to convey the worshipper to the region of lord Śiva, and to supply him with the only means of worshipping lord Śiva.

sanskrit: śive prakṣepayet puṣpamapanīyārcakantāraṃ / tatpātrasthānamantrāḍhyaṃ śivadevagaṇānugaṃ //
english: Then after having removed all other materials of worship, one should cast flowers on lord Śiva in the company of attendant gods of lord Śiva invoking his presence with mantras.

sanskrit: viprādīnāṃ kramānnāma kuryādvā svecchayā guruḥ / praṇatiṃ kumbhavardhanyoḥ kārayitvānalāntikaṃ // sadakṣiṇāsane tadvat saumyāsyamupaveśayet /
english: The preceptor should name brahmins in the usual order or as desired. After having made the disciple to bow to the pitcher and the vardhanī a kind of vessel, the preceptor should make the disciple seated on the right near the sacred fire facing the north.

sanskrit: śiṣyadehaviniṣkrāntāṃ suṣumṇāmiva cintayet //
english: He should then meditate on the suṣumnā an artery in the body as emerging out of the body of disciple.

sanskrit: nijagrahalīnāñca darbhamūlena mantritaṃ / darbhāgraṃ dakṣiṇe tasya vidhāya karapallave // tammūlamātmajaṅghāyāmagrañceti śikhidhvaje /
english: Having placed the tip of darbha on the right hand duly consecrated by the base of darbha and resting on the symbol of one’s own self, that base of kuśa should rest on one’s own knee while the tip should rest on the cockbanner.

sanskrit: śiṣyasya hṛdayaṃ gatvā recakena śivāṇunā // purakeṇa samāgatya svakīyaṃ hṛdyāntaraṃ / śivāgninā punaḥ kṛtvā nāḍīsandhānamīdṛśaṃ // hṛdā tatsannidhānārthañjuhuyādāhutitrayaṃ /
english: Having entered the heart of the disciple by breathing out the wind while repeating the mantra of the tuft and reentered his own heart by breathing in and having thus established communion again with the fire of lord Śiva, the preceptor should offer three oblations with the hṛd mantra for the accomplishment of that communion.

sanskrit: śivahastasthiratvārthaṃ śataṃ mūlena homayet /
english: One should make hundred oblations with the principal mantra for the sake of making the hand of the disciple permeated with the essence of Śiva.

sanskrit: itthaṃ samayadīkṣāyāṃ bhavedyogyo bhavārcane //
english: Being thus initiated in religious practices one would become eligible to perform the worship of lord Śiva.

sanskrit: vakṣye saṃskāradīkṣāyāṃ vidhānaṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha /
english: “O Ṣaṇmukha sixfaced one! Listen to me! shall describe the mode of performing the purificatory initiation .

sanskrit: āvāhayenmaheśasya vahnisthasya śiro hṛdi //
english: The great god Śiva situated in the heart and in the fire should be invoked.

sanskrit: saṃśliṣṭau tau samabhyarcya santarpya hṛdayātmanā / tayoḥ sannidhaye dadyāttenaivāhutipañcakaṃ //
english: Having worshipped those two God Śiva situated in the heart and the sacrificial fire and having appeased them with the hṛd mantra, one should offer five oblations in their presence with the same mantra.

sanskrit: kusumenāstraliptena tāḍayettaṃ hṛdā śiśuṃ / prasphurattārakākāraṃ caitanyaṃ tatra bhāvayet // praviśya tatra huṅkāramuktaṃ recakayogataḥ /
english: Having placed the syllable hum in it by exhalation of breath and having drawn it by means of saṃhāriṇī mudrā formation with fingers representing gathering, it should be placed in the heart by the inhalation of breath.

sanskrit: saṃhāriṇyā tadākṛṣya pūrakeṇa hṛdi nyaset // tato vāgīśvarīyaunau mudrayodbhavasañjñayā /
english: Then the abovementioned essence of fire should be cast in the generative organ of goddess Viigīśvarī goddess of speech with the mudrā known as udbhava and the repetition of hṛd mantra.

sanskrit: hṛtsampuṭitamantreṇa recakena vinikṣipet // jājvalyamāne nirdhūme juhuyādiṣṭasiddhaye /
english: Oṃ hāṃ, hīṃ, hāṃ obeisance to the soul. Oblation should be offered in the smokeless sacrificial fire fully ablaze with the above mantra for the fulfilment of desires.

sanskrit: apravṛddhe sadhūme tu homo vahnau na siddhyati //
english: Oblation made in undeveloped and smoky fire does not get the desire fulfilled.

sanskrit: snigdhaḥ pradakṣiṇāvartaḥ sugandhiḥ śasyate 'nalaḥ / viparītasphuliṅgī ca bhūmisparśaḥ praśasyate //
english: A fire which is pleasing, circling upwards and sweetsmelling is commended. So also is the fire which touches the ground and which emits sparks in the contrary direction.

sanskrit: ityevamādibhiścihnair hutvā śiṣyasya kalmaṣaṃ / pāpabhakṣaṇahomena dahedvā taṃ bhavātmanā //
english: Having offered oblations in this way, the impurities of the disciple should be destroyed by doing the sinconsuming oblation or it may be burnt with the syllables of Śiva.

sanskrit: dvijatvāpādanārthāya tathā rudrāṃśabhāvane / āhāravījasaṃśuddhau garbhādhānāya saṃsthitau //
english: in onetenth of proportion for the sake of getting the characteristics of a twiceborn for the disciple and to permeate him with the essence of Lord Rudra Śiva as well as for the purification of the food etc.

sanskrit: sīmante janmato nāmakaraṇāya ca homayet /
english: and for the rites of garbhādhāna, sīmanta, and nāmakaraṇa.

sanskrit: śithilībhūtabandhasya śaktāvutkarṣaṇaṃ ca yat / ātmano rudraputtratve garbhādhānaṃ taducyate //
english: The garbhādhāna is spoken as that which elevates the soul of the disciple by breaking the bonds and making him gain the sonship of Lord Rudra Śiva.

sanskrit: svāntatryātmaguṇavyaktiriha puṃsavanaṃ mataṃ /
english: The puṃsavana is considered as the manifestation of independant attributes of the soul in the initiated.

sanskrit: māyātmanorvivekena jñānaṃ sīmantavardhanaṃ //
english: The dawn of knowledge by means of discrimination in the disciple clouded by illusion is the sīmantavardhana growth of sīmanta.

sanskrit: śivāditattvaśuddhestu svīkāro jananaṃ mataṃ /
english: One’s birth is considered to be the evolution out of the principle of absolute bliss etc.

sanskrit: bodhanaṃ yacchivatvena śivatvārhasya no mataṃ // saṃhāramudrayātmānaṃ sphuradvahnikaṇopamaṃ /
english: The wakening of consciousness is by means of the principle of supreme bliss in the initiated which has become equal to the Supreme Being in the spiritual perfection.

sanskrit: vidadhīta samādāya nije hṛdayapaṅkaje // tataḥ kumbhayogena mūlamantramudīrayet /
english: Then the preceptor should carry into the lotus of his heart his own soul resembling a spark of fire by exhibiting the saṃhāra mudrā formation with the fingers denoting gathering.

sanskrit: kuryāt samavaśībhāvaṃ tadā ca śivayorhṛdi //
english: Then the principal mantra should be uttered along with the retention of breath and the union of God Śiva and his own soul should be brought about in his heart.

sanskrit: brahmādikāraṇātyāgakramādrecakayogataḥ / nītvā śivāntamātmānamādāyodbhavamudrayā // hṛtsampuṭitamantreṇa recakena vidhānavit / śiṣyasya hṛdayāmbhojakarṇikāyāṃ vinikṣipet //
english: Then the preceptor wellversed in the procedure relating to the performance of sacrifices should carry his pure consciousness to the region of Śiva from the sacrificial performances which are the cause of Brahmā and others by means of exhalation of breath and collect it by showing the udbhava mudrā formation with fingers denoting generation and repeating the mantra of the heart and exhaling the breath he should locate it in the petals of lotus of the heart of the disciple.

sanskrit: pūjāṃ śivasya vahneś ca guruḥ kuryāttadocitāṃ / praṇatiñcātmane śiṣyaṃ samayān śrāvayettathā //
english: The preceptor should duly propitiate Lord Śiva and the firegod. The disciple should be made to bow down to the self preceptor. He should then make the disciple hear conventions.

sanskrit: devaṃ na nindecchāstrāṇi nirmālyādi na laṅghayet /
english: One should not blaspheme scriptures or God. One should not leap across the materials of worship.

sanskrit: śivāgnigurupūjā ca kartavyā jīvitāvadhi //
english: One must propitiate Lord Śiva, the firegod and the preceptor as long as one is alive.

sanskrit: bālabāliśavṛddhastrībhogabhugvyādhitātmanāṃ / yathāśakti dadītārthaṃ samarthasya samagrakān //
english: One has to impart these instructions to children, old people, women, people addicted to pleasures, and sick people according to their capacity to preserve them and in entirety to those who can practise them.

sanskrit: bhūtāṅgāni jaṭābhasmadaṇḍakaupīnasaṃyamān / īśānādyair hṛdādyair vā parijapya yathākramāt // svāhāntasaṃhitamantraiḥ pātreṣvāropya pūrvavat / sampāditadrutaṃ hutvā sthaṇḍileśāya darśayet //
english: After having consecrated in a vessel the symbols of disciplinetuft, ashes, staff and loin cloth in order with the īśāna, hṛd and saṃhitā mantras ending with the syllable svāhā oblation as before, the preceptor should show them to the presiding deity of sacrificial site after having quickly cast in the fire the residual offering.

sanskrit: rakṣaṇāya ghaṭādhastādāropya kṣaṇamātrakaṃ / śivādājñāṃ samādāya dadīta yatine guruḥ //
english: Having kept them for a while under the pitcher for the sake of protection, the preceptor should give them to the person who takes the vow after having obtained permission of Lord Śiva.

sanskrit: evaṃ samayadīkṣāyāṃ viśiṣṭāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ / vahnihomāgamajñānayogyaḥ sañjāyate śiśruḥ //
english: Thus in this special spiritual initiation a child especially becomes fit to have a scriptural knowledge about the fire and oblation unto the fire.

sanskrit: atha nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ kuryānmūlādidīpanaṃ / pāśabandhanaśaktyarthaṃ tāḍanādikṛtena vā //
english: The principal mantra should be stimulated in the spiritual initiation . In order to gain strength to break the bonds of worldly existence one may do it by the rites of tāḍana striking gently.

sanskrit: ekaikayā tadāhutyā pratyekaṃ tattrayeṇa vā /
english: Oblations should be offered with each one of the principal mantras or thrice with them.

sanskrit: vījagarbhaśikhārdhantu hūṃ phaḍantadhruvādinā // oṃ hrūṃ hrauṃ hauṃ hrūṃ phaḍiti mūlamantrasya dīpanaṃ /
english: The principal mantra together with half the tuft mantra should be repeated along with the syllables hūṃ, phaṭ, etc. The principal mantra should be stimulated by the syllables Oṃ, hrūṃ, hrauṃ, hauṃ, hrūṃ.

sanskrit: oṃ hrūṃ hauṃ hauṃ hrūṃ phaḍiti hṛdaya evaṃ śiromukhe //
english: assigning to the heart as well as the tuft and face with the syllables Oṃ, hrūṃ, hrauṃ, hrūṃ, phaṭ.

sanskrit: pratyekaṃ dīpanaṃ kuryāt sarvasmin krūrakarmaṇi / śāntike pauṣṭike cāsya vaṣaḍantādināṇunā //
english: One should do the rite of stimulation for each part of the principal mantra in all ceremonies performed to cause injury to one’s enemy while the syllable vaṣaṭ is appended to the principal mantra in ceremonies intended to bring peace and prosperity.

sanskrit: vaṣaḍvauṣaṭsamopetaiḥ sarvakāmyopari sthitaiḥ / havanaṃ saṃvaraiḥ kuryāt sarvatrāpyāyanādiṣu //
english: In all instances of annual rites, oblations should be done with religious acts for all desired results along with the syllables vaṣaṭ and vauṣaṭ.

sanskrit: tataḥ svasavyabhāgasthaṃ maṇḍale śuddhavigrahaṃ / śiṣyaṃ sampūjya tat sūtraṃ suṣumṇeti vibhāvitaṃ //
english: Then after having worshipped the disciple having a pure body and seated on a circle on the right side of one’s self, the preceptor should contemplate upon a thread as the suṣumnā an artery of human body.

sanskrit: mūlena tacchikhābandhaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhāntamānayet / saṃhāreṇa mumukṣostu badhnīyācchiṣyakāyake //
english: The tuft of hair of the disciple should be tied with the principal mantra and one end of the string should be led to touch the toe. In the case of the disciple yearning for salvation the string should be tied on the body of the disciple showing the saṃhāra mudra posture of fingers denoting gathering.

sanskrit: puṃsastu dakṣiṇe bhāge vāme nāryā niyojayet / śaktiṃ ca śaktimantreṇa pūjitāntasya mastake //
english: The String should be attached on the right side in the case of males and on the left side in the case of females. The female deity should be worshipped with the mantra of the deity on the head.

sanskrit: saṃhāramudrayā.adāya sūtraṃ tenaiva yojayet /
english: The thread should be collected with the saṃhāra mudrā and placed with the same mudrā.

sanskrit: nāḍīntvādāya mūlena sūtre nyasya hṛdārcayet //
english: The nāḍī artery should be mentally collected with the principal mantra and placed on the string and worshipped with the mantra of the heart.

sanskrit: avaguṇṭhya tu rudreṇa hṛdayenāhutitrayaṃ / pradadyātsannidhānārthaṃ śaktāvapyevameva hi //
english: Having covered it with the Rudra mantra, oblations should be offered thrice with the mantra of the heart for accomplishing the presence. It is the same way in the case of female deity also.

sanskrit: oṃ hāṃ varṇādhvane namo hāṃ bhavanādhvane namaḥ /
english: Oṃ, hāṃ obeisance to the path of letters, hāṃ obeisance to the path of residence bhavana, Oṃ, hāṃ obeisance to the path of phases.

sanskrit: nyasyāstravāriṇā śiṣyaṃ prokṣyāstramantritena ca / puṣpeṇa hṛdi santāḍya śiṣyadehe praviśya ca // guruś ca tatra hūṅkārayuktaṃ recakayogataḥ /
english: Having located the path of purification on the thread and sprinkled water on the disciple with the weapon and beaten gently the heart of the disciple with flower consecrated by the mantra of the weapon, the preceptor should mentally enter the body of the disciple by pronouncing the syllable hum and exhaling the breath.

sanskrit: caitanyaṃ haṃsavījasthaṃ viśliṣyedāyudhātmanā //
english: The spirit situated in the haṃsabīja should be separated by the mantra of the weapon Oṃ, hauṃ, hūṃ, phaṭ.

sanskrit: āchidya śaktisūtreṇa hāṃ haṃ svāheti cāṇunā / saṃhāramudrayā sūtre nāḍībhūte niyojayet // vyāpakaṃ bhāvayedenaṃ tanutrāṇāvaguṇṭhayet /
english: Having covered the same with the śaktisūtra the thread of energy by uttering the mantra hāṃ haṃ oblations, it should be joined with the thread which has become artery, by showing the saṃhāramudrā posture made with the fingers indicating gathering Oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ salutations to the soul.

sanskrit: āhutitritayaṃ dadyāt hṛdā sannidhihetave //
english: Oblations should be made thrice with the mantra of the heart for the sake of invoking the presence.

sanskrit: vidyādehañca vinyasya śāntyatītāvalokanaṃ /
english: Having located the principle of knowledge in the thread, one should look at it as beyond the state of bliss.

sanskrit: tasyāmitaratattvādyaṃ mantrabhūtaṃ vicintayet //
english: Other principles which have become mantras as they were should be located in that.

sanskrit: he tattve mantramapyekaṃ padaṃ varṇāś ca ṣoḍaśa / tathāṣṭau bhuvanānyasyāṃ vījanāḍīkathadvayaṃ // viṣayañca guṇañcaikaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca sadā śivaṃ /
english: Two principles out of the twentyfive, mantra of single word, sixteen letters, eight worlds, two principal arteries iḍā and piṅgalā, letters ka and tha, the one object of senseperception, the one fundamental attribute, the one fundamental cause and the eternal blissful one śadāśiva should be contemplated as having been located in the phase of white colour beyond the absolute bliss.

sanskrit: sitāyāṃ śāntyatītāyāmantarbhāvya prapīḍayet // saṃhāramudrayā.adāya vidadhyāt sūtramastake / pūjayedāhutīṃstisro dadyāt sannidhihetave //
english: Having collected the latter by showing the saṃhāramudrā posture of fingers denoting gathering, it should. be placed over the thread. It should then be worshipped and three oblations of clarified butter should be made for its presence in the thread.

sanskrit: tattve dve akṣare dve ca vījanāḍīkathadvayaṃ / guṇau mantrau tathābjasthamekaṃ kāraṇamīśvaraṃ // padāni bhānusaṅkhyāni bhuvanāni daśa sapta ca /
english: Two principles out of twentyfive, two letters ka and tha, two principal arteries iḍā and piṅgalā, two qualities, two mantras and one supreme lord situated in the lotus of the heart, twelve terms denoting god, seventeen worlds, one of the objects of senseperception should be conceived as merged in the dark phase which is beyond the region of bliss.

sanskrit: ekañca viṣayaṃ śāntau kṛṣṇāyāmacyutaṃ smaret //
english: Lord Acyuta should be meditated upon therein.

sanskrit: tāḍayitvā samādāya mukhasūtre niyojayet / juhuyānnijavījena sānnidhyāyāhutitrayaṃ //
english: Having gathered it after a gentle stroking, it should be placed at the mouths of the nerve. Oblations should be made thrice with the respective mantras for the sake of its presence.

sanskrit: vidyāyāṃ sapta tattvāni pādānāmekaviṃśatiṃ / ṣaḍ varṇān sañcaraṃ caikaṃ lokānāṃ pañcaviṃśatiṃ // guṇānāntrayamekañca viṣayaṃ rudrakāraṇaṃ /
english: The seven fundamental principles, twentyone words, six letters, one pathway, twentyfive worlds, three qualities and an object for which Rudra is the cause should be located in the principle of knowledge and the mantras, artery, the latters ka and tha higher above.

sanskrit: lokānāñca kalānāñca ṣaṣṭiṃ guṇacatuṣṭayaṃ // mantrāṇāṃ trayamekañca viṣayaṃ kāraṇaṃ hariṃ /
english: Having taken the weapon, twentytwo words, six worlds, six kalās phases, four qualities, three mantras and an object for which Lord Viṣṇu is the cause should be meditated at the base.

sanskrit: antarbhāvya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ śuklayāntāḍanādikaṃ // vidhāya nābhisūtrasthāṃ sannidhāyāhutīryajet /
english: The rites of beating should be done in the white phase. Then having placed the samein the nerve in the navel region, one should offer oblations for the sake of its presence.

sanskrit: hrīṃ bhuvanānāṃ śataṃ sāgraṃ padānāmaṣṭaviṃśatiṃ / vījanāḍīsamīrāṇāṃ dvayorindriyayorapi / varṇantattvañca viṣayamekaikaṃ guṇapañcakaṃ // hetuṃ brahmāṇḍamantrasthaṃ śambarāṇāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ /
english: The preceptor should then locate the syllable hrīṃ, hundred worlds, twentyeight words, twice each of the mantras, artery, the winds as well as senses, the principle of the letter, the five objects of senseperception and the first cause governed by the brahmāṇḍamantra, four times the śambaras a religious observance in the principle of nonaction of yellow colour.

sanskrit: nivṛttau pītavarṇāyāmantarbhāvya pratāḍayet // ādau yattattvabhāgānte sūtre vinyasyapūjayet /
english: It should then be beaten. The principles which were left out at the outset should be located on the thread and worshipped.

sanskrit: juhuyādāhutīstisraḥ sannidhāya pāvake //
english: Three oblations should be offered unto the fire for the sake of its presence.

sanskrit: ityādāya kalāsūtre yojayecchiṣyavigrahāt /
english: Thus having gathered the principles from the body of the disciple, they should be located in the thread.

sanskrit: savījāyāntu dīkṣāyāṃ samayācārayāgataḥ // dehārambhakarakṣārthaṃ mantrasiddhiphalādapi / iṣṭāpūrtādidharmārthaṃ vyatiriktaṃ prabandhakaṃ //
english: In the initiation with the mantras, it should be done accompanied by religioussacrificial performances. Other rites should be undertaken for the sake of initial protection of the body of the disciple until the mantra accomplishes the desired fruits.

sanskrit: caitanyabodhakaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kalānāmantare smaret /
english: The subtle soul awakening mantra should be meditated in the principles of beatific knowledge.

sanskrit: amunaiva krameṇātha kuryāttarpaṇadīpane // āhutibhiḥ svamantreṇa tisṛbhistisṛbhis tathā /
english: The rites of arpaṇa pleasing and dīpana stimulation should be performed in the same way with three oblations with their respective mantras such as “Oṃ, hauṃ oblations to the phase of beatitude beyond that of absolute bliss which is the mantra for the rite of pleasing “Oṃ, hāṃ, haṃ, hāṃ, huṃ, phaṭ to the phase of beatitude beyond that of absolute bliss which is the mantra for stimulation.

sanskrit: tat sūtraṃ vyāptibodhāya kalāsthāneṣu pañcasu //
english: Then that thread should be considered as pervading the five nerve centres.

sanskrit: saṅgṛhya kuṅkumājyena tatra sāṅgaṃ śivaṃ yajet / hūmphaḍantaiḥ kalāmantrair bhittvā pāśānanukramāt // namo 'ntaiś ca praviśyāntaḥ kuryād grahaṇabandhane / pāśādīnāñca svīkāro grahaṇaṃ bandhanaṃ punaḥ //
english: The thread should be smeared with saffron and clarified butter and Lord Śiva should be worshipped therein along with his attendants with the kalāmantras ending with huṃ phat after having pierced the bondage through the occult nerve. Having mentally entered inside with syllables ending with obeisance, the preceptor should take hold of the thread and tie it.

sanskrit: puruṣaṃ prati niḥśeṣavyāpārapratipattaye / upaveśyātha tat sūtraṃ śiṣyaskandhe niveśayet // vistṛtāghapramoṣāya śataṃ mūlena homayet /
english: The preceptor should place that thread on the shoulder of the disciple after having made him seated for the sake of successful completion. One hundred oblations should be made with the principal mantra for the expiation of all the sins of the disciple.

sanskrit: śarāvasampuṭe puṃsaḥ striyāś ca praṇitodare //
english: The oblation should be made in a covered shallow saucer if the disciple is a male and in a saucer of enlarged belly in the case of a female disciple.

sanskrit: hṛdastrasampuṭaṃ sūtraṃ vidhāyābhyarcayeddhṛdā /
english: The thread which has been covered with the mantra of the heart should be placed and worshipped with the mantra of the heart.

sanskrit: sūtraṃ śivena sāṅgena kṛtvā sampātaśodhitaṃ // nidadhyāt kalaśasyādho rakṣāṃ vijñāpayediti /
english: After having been made pure by the worship of Śiva and his attendants the thread should be placed under the pitcher saying, “let protection be announced”.

sanskrit: śiṣyaṃ puṣpaṃ kare datvā sampūjya kalaśādikaṃ // praṇamayya vahiryāyād yāgamandiramadhyataḥ /
english: After having placed a flower in the hands of the disciple and having worshipped the pitcher and other things, the disciple should be made to bow down and led outside the sacrificial shed.

sanskrit: bhuktaye pūrvavaktrāṃś ca śiṣyāṃstatra niveśayet /
english: After having drawn three circles, the disciple should be made to sit facing the north in the case of aspiration for emancipation and made to sit facing the east in the case of aspiration for enjoyment.

sanskrit: prathame pañcagavyasya prāśayeccullakatrayaṃ //
english: Three handfuls of pañcagavya the five things got from a cow should be sipped at the outset.

sanskrit: caruntatastṛtīye tu grāsatritayasammitaṃ // aṣṭagrāsapramāṇaṃ vā daśanasparśavarjitaṃ / pālāśapuṭake muktau bhuktau pippalapatrake //
english: After that, three or eight morsels of gruel unpolluted by the touch of the teeth should be offered with the hand holding a kuśa with the leaf of palāśa, if desirous of emancipation and with the leaf of pippala, if desirous of enjoyment.

sanskrit: hṛdā sambhojanaṃ datvā pūtair ācāmayejjalaiḥ /
english: Having offered profuse feeding with the mantra of the heart, the pure water should be given for rinsing the mouth.

sanskrit: dantakāṣṭhaṃ hṛdā kṛtvā prakṣipecchobhane śubhaṃ // nyūnādidoṣamoṣāya mūlenāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ /
english: After having given the teeth stick for cleansing the teeth with the repetition of the mantra of the heart, one hundred and eight oblations should be offered with the principal mantra for the removal of defects such as deficiency etc.

sanskrit: vidhāya sthiṇḍileśāya sarvakarmasamarpaṇaṃ // pūjāvisarjanañcāsya caṇḍeśasya ca pūjanaṃ /
english: After having dedicated all acts to the lord of the ground, the deity should be given adieu after worship and Lord Caṇḍeśa should be worshipped.

sanskrit: nirmālyamapanīyātha śeṣamagnau yajeccaroḥ //
english: Then the materials of worship should be removed and the remnants of the gruel should be offered to the fire.

sanskrit: kalaśaṃ lokapalāṃś ca pūjayitvā visṛjya ca / visṛjedgaṇamagniñca rakṣitaṃ yadi vāhyataḥ //
english: After having worshipped the pitcher and the protectors of the world and bidding them adieu, one should bid adieu to the attendant God and fire if they have been retained on the periphery of the mystic circle.

sanskrit: vāhyato lokapālānāṃ datvā saṅkṣepato baliṃ / bhasmanā śuddhatoyair vā snātvā yā gālayaṃ viśet //
english: Then having offered oblations in a condensed way to the protector of the world at the periphery, one should enter the sacrificial shed after bathing with ashes or pure oil.

sanskrit: gṛhasthān darbhaśayyāyāṃ pūrvaśīrṣān surakṣitān / hṛdā sadbhasmaśayyāyāṃ yatīn dakṣiṇamastakān //
english: If the disciples are householders, they should be seated on a bed of darbhas with their heads facing the east and protected well and if the disciples are monks, they should be seated on a bed of ashes with their heads facing the south with the repetition of the mantra of the heart.

sanskrit: śikhābaddhasikhānastrasaptamāṇavakānvitān / vijñāya snāpayecchiṣyāṃstato yāyāt punarvahiḥ //
english: Then the preceptor should bathe the disciples who had tiedup their tufts into knots along with the mantras of the weapon and sapta māṇavaka and walk out of the place again.

sanskrit: pañcagavyañcaruṃ prāśya gṛhītvā dantadhāvanaṃ / samācamya śivaṃ dhyātvā śayyāmāsthāya pāvanīṃ // dīkṣāgataṅkriyākāṇḍaṃ saṃsmaran saṃviśedguruḥ /
english: After having sipped five things got from a cow and the gruel and having collected sticks for cleansing the teeth, and having rinsed the mouth with water, and contemplated on Lord Śiva and having reached the pure bed, the preceptor should enter again remembering the rites performed in connection with initiation.

sanskrit: iti saṅkṣepataḥ prokto vidhirdīkṣādhivāsane //
english: Thus, the mode of preliminary consecration relating to initiation has been described briefly.

sanskrit: atha prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtasnanādiko guruḥ /
english: Then the preceptor having gotup early in the morning should bathe and finish worship.

sanskrit: dadhyārdramāṃsamadyādeḥ praśastābhyavahāritā //
english: Seeing in the dream curd, ginger, meat and wine as being consumed is commended.

sanskrit: gajāśvarohaṇaṃ svapne śubhaṃ śuklāṃśukādikaṃ /
english: So also riding on an elephant or horse as well as seeing a white cloth in the dream is auspicious.

sanskrit: tailābhyaṅgādikaṃ hīnaṃ homo ghoreṇa śāntaye //
english: Oblation should be done with the aghora mantra for the sake of appeasement.

sanskrit: nityakarmadvayaṃ kṛtvā praviśya makhamaṇḍapaṃ / svācānto nityavat karma kuryānnaimittike vidhau //
english: After having performed two daily rites the two twilight worships and entering the sacrificial shed, the preceptor should rinse his mouth and perform duties as in the daily routines as laid down for the incidental rites.

sanskrit: tataḥ saṃśodhya cātmānaṃ śivahastaṃ tathātmani / vinyasya kumbhagaṃ prārcya indrādīnāmanukramāt // maṇḍale sthaṇḍile vāpi prakurvīta śivarcanaṃ /
english: After having purified his self and the part of the forearm known as the śivahasta and having located in his inner being the Gods Indra and others in order and worshipped the pitcher, Śiva worship should be done at the shed or on the ground.

sanskrit: tarpaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ vahneḥ pūrṇāntaṃ mantratarpaṇaṃ //
english: Worship of fire and the rite of mantratarpaṇa offering oblations along with the recitation of mantras should be done until the final oblation is done.

sanskrit: duḥkhapradoṣamoṣāya śastreṇāṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ / hutvā hūṃ sampuṭenaiva vidadhyāt mantradīpanaṃ //
english: After having offered one hundred and eight oblations with the mantra of the weapon, for the removal of defects due to bad dreams, one should activate the mantra with the subtle syllable huṃ.

sanskrit: antarbalividhānañca madhye sthaṇḍilakumbhayoḥ / kṛtvā śiṣyapraveśāya labdhānujño vahirvrajet //
english: Having made the antarbali the rite of middle offering in between the sacrificial pitcher and the ground for the entry of the disciple, and having obtained permission, the preceptor should walk out of the shed.

sanskrit: kuryātsamayavattatra maṇḍalāropaṇādikaṃ / sampātahomaṃ tannāḍīrūpadarbhakarānugaṃ //
english: One should do the acts of placing on a mystical diagram and other acts in the religious initiation. The preparatory oblation should be done with the end of darbha which, should be looked upon as the umbilical chord of the latter.

sanskrit: tatsannidhānāya tistro hutvā mūlāṇunā.ahutīḥ / kumbhasthaṃ śivamabhyarcya pāśasūtramupāharet //
english: Having offered three oblations with the principal mantra for accomplishing its presence, the preceptor should worshiplord Śiva in the pitcher and take hold of the thread.

sanskrit: svadakṣiṇordhvakāyasya śiṣyasyābhyarcitasya ca / tacchikhāyāṃ nibadhnīyāt pādāṅguṣṭhāvalambitaṃ //
english: It should be tied on the tuft of the disciple who would remain standing on the righthandside of the preceptor in the manner that the thread hangs down upto the toe of the foot.

sanskrit: taṃ niveśya nivṛttestu vyāptimālokya cetasā / jñeyāni bhuvanānyasyāṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ tataḥ //
english: Having placed it and looked at it mentally as pervading the nonaction, one should know that more than one hundred and eight worlds are in it.

sanskrit: kapālo 'jaś ca buddhaś ca vajradehaḥ pramardanaḥ / vibhūtiravyayaḥ śāstā pinākī tridaśādhipaḥ // agnī rudro hutāśo ca piṅgalaḥ khādako haraḥ / jvalano dahano babhrurbhasmāntakakṣapāntakau // yāmyamṛtyuharo dhātā vidhātā kāryarañjakaḥ /
english: Kapāla, Aja, Buddha, Vajradeha, Pramardana, Vibhūti, Avyaya, Śāstā, Pinākī, Tridaśādhipa, Agni, Rudra, Hutāśī, Piṅgala, Khādaka, Hara, Jvalana, Dahana, Babhru, Bhasmāntaka, Kṣapāntaka, Yāmya, Mṛtyuhara, Dhātā, Vidhātā, Kāryarañjaka, Kāla, Dharma, Adharma, Saṃyoktā, Viyogaka, Nairṛta, Māraṇa, Hantā, Krūradṛṣṭi, Bhayānaka, Ūrdhvāṃśaka, Virūpākṣa, Dhūmralohita, Daṃṣṭravān, Atibala, Pāśahasta, Mahābala, Śveta, Jayabhadra, Dīrghabāhu, Jalāntaka, Vaḍavāsya and Bhīma are known as the manifestations of Varuṇa.

sanskrit: nidhīśo rūpavān dhanyo saumyadehaḥ prasādakṛt / prakāśo 'pyatha lakṣmīvān kāmarūpo daśottare // vidyādharo jñānadharaḥ sarvajño vedapāragaḥ / mātṛvṛttaś ca piṅgākṣo bhūtapālo balipriyaḥ // sarvavidyāvidhatā ca sukhaduḥkhaharā daśa /
english: Śīghra, Laghu, Vāyuvega, Sūkṣma, Tīkṣṇa, Kṣapāntaka, Pañcāntaka, Pañcaśikha, Kapardī, Meghavāhana, Jaṭāmukuṭadhārī, Nānāratnadhara, Nidhīśa, Rūpavān, Dhanya, Saumyadeha, Prasādakṛt, Prakāśa, Lakṣmīvān and Kāmarūpa, the latter ten Vidyādhara, Jñānadhara, Sarvajña, Vedapāraga, Mātṛvṛtta, Piṅgākṣa, Bhūtapāla, Balipriya, Sarvavidyāvidhātā, Sukhaduḥkhahara are the ten.

sanskrit: śambhurvibhurgaṇādhyakṣastryakṣastridaśavanditaḥ / saṃhāraś ca vihāraś ca lābho lipsurvicakṣaṇaḥ // attā kuhakakālāgnirudro hāṭaka eva ca / kuṣmāṇḍaś caiva satyaś ca brahmā viṣṇuś ca saptamaḥ // rudraścāṣṭāvime rudrāḥ kaṭāhābhyantare sthitāḥ /
english: Ananta, Pālaka, Dhīra, Pātālādhipati, Vṛṣa, Vṛṣadhara, Vīrya, Grasana, Sarvatomukha and Lohita known as the ten manifestations of Rudra seated on the hoods of snakes Śambhu, Vibhu, Gaṇādhyakṣa, Tryakṣa, Tridaśavandita, Saṃhāra, Vihāra, Lābha, Lipsu and Vicakṣaṇa and Attā, Kuhakakālāgnirudra, Hāṭaka, Kūṣmāṇḍa, Satya, Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Rudra are the eight Rudras who all remain in the interior of hemisphere of the universe.

sanskrit: eteṣāmeva nāmāni bhuvanānāmapi smaret //
english: The names of these Gods as well as the names of worlds should be remembered.

sanskrit: bhavodbhavaḥ sarvabhūtaḥ sarvabhūtasukhapradaḥ /
english: Bhavodbhava, Sarvabhūta, Sarvabhūtasukhaprada Granter of felicity to all, Sarvasānnidhyakṛt, all pervasive.

sanskrit: sarvasānnidhyakṛd brahmaviṣṇurudraśarārcitaḥ //
english: are worshipped by Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Rudra.

sanskrit: aṣṭāviṃśati pādāni vyomavyāpi mano guha / sadyohṛdastranetrāṇi mantravarṇāṣṭako mataḥ //
english: O Guha son of Lord Śiva and Pārvatī! in the thread described above the principle of nonaction should be contemplated as impregnated with the twentyeight beatific states, together with the eight letters of which the sadya, hṛd, astra, and netra mantras are composed.

sanskrit: vījākāro makāraś ca nāḍyāviḍāpiṅgalāhvaye / prāṇāpānāvubhau vāyū ghrāṇopasthau tathendriye //
english: The letter ma is the emblem of the mystic seed, the two occult nerves known as iḍā and piṅgalā, the two vital winds prāṇa and apāna and the organs of smell and generation.

sanskrit: gandhastu viṣayaḥ prokto gandhādiguṇapañcake /
english: Among the five qualities smell etc., the quality of smell is spoken as the matter.

sanskrit: pārthivaṃ maṇḍalaṃ pītaṃ vajrāṅgaṃ caturasrakaṃ //
english: The principle of matter is yellow in colour symbolises thunderbolt and is squareshaped.

sanskrit: vistāro yojanānāntu koṭirasya śatāhatā /
english: Its extension is one hundred crores of yojanas a yojana is equivalent to eight miles.

sanskrit: atraivāntargatā jñeyā yonayo 'pi caturdaśa //
english: It should be known that the fourteen creative principles are lying concealed in this zone.

sanskrit: prathamā sarvadevānāṃ manvādyā devayonayaḥ /
english: It is the first being and the source of the fourfold existence of all celestial beings, Manu, etc.

sanskrit: mṛgapakṣī ca paśavaś caturdhā tu sarīsṛpāḥ //
english: animals and birds and crawling insects.

sanskrit: sthāvaraṃ pañcamaṃ sarvaṃ yoniḥ ṣaṣṭhī amānuṣī / paiśācaṃ rākṣasaṃ yākṣaṃ gāndharvaṃ caindrameva ca // saumyaṃ prāṇeśvaraṃ brāhmamaṣṭamaṃ parikīrtitaṃ /
english: It is also spoken as the source of things born of the fifth, the immovable things, the sixth, the beings other than human such as goblins, demons, yakṣas, gandharvas and Indra, the seventh, the God of life Yama and the eighth, Brahmā.

sanskrit: aṣṭānāṃ pārthivantattvamadhikārāspadaṃ mataṃ //
english: The earthly principle is considered as controlling the eighth.

sanskrit: layastu prakṛtau buddhau bhogo brahmā ca kāraṇaṃ / tato jāgradavasthānaiḥ samastair bhuvanādibhiḥ // nivṛttiṃ garbhitāṃ dhyātvā svamantreṇa niyojya ca /
english: Having contemplated the absolute dissolution of the universe in the prakṛti the original source of the material world and the intellect and Brahmā, the enjoyer, as the cause, as well as the nonaction located along with all the worlds continuing through his wakingstate, one should unite the appropriate mantras.

sanskrit: brahman tavādhikāre 'smin mumukṣuṃ dokṣyayāmyahaṃ //
english: Lord Brahmā should be invoked with the mantra Oṃ, hāṃ, obeisance to Brahmā and worshipped.

sanskrit: bhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlena vidhiṃ vijñāpayediti /
english: He should be appeased with oblations with the word “Oblations”.

sanskrit: āvāhayettato devīṃ rakṣāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ hṛdā // icchājñānakriyārūpāṃ ṣaḍvidhāṃ hy ekakāraṇaṃ /
english: Goddess Vāgīśvarī, the deity of protection, who is of the form of desire, knowledge and action and is of six kinds and is the sole cause of the universe should be invoked with the mantra of the heart.

sanskrit: pūjayettarpayeddevīṃ prakāreṇāmunā tataḥ //
english: One should worship and satisfy the Goddess as follows

sanskrit: vāgīśvarīṃ viniḥśeṣayonivikṣobhakāraṇaṃ / hṛtsampuṭārthavījādihūṃ phaḍantaśarāṇunā //
english: Goddess Vāgīśvarī, the cause of agitating the receptacles should gently be struck against the chest of the disciple with the repetition of the hṛt mantra and the principal mantra concluding with hūṃ phaṭ and the mantra of the arrow.

sanskrit: tāḍayeddhṛdaye tasya praviśetsa vidhānavit /
english: Having drawn it with its appropriate mantra and seized it, it should be united with his soul.

sanskrit: oṃ hāṃ svāhetyanenātha pūrakeṇāṅkuśamudrayā //
english: Oṃ, hāṃ, hrūṃ, hāṃ obeisance to the soul.

sanskrit: tadākṛṣya svamantreṇa gṛhītvā.atmani yojayet / pitrorvibhāvya saṃyogaṃ caitanyaṃ recakena tat // brahmādikāraṇatyāgakramānnītvā śivāspadaṃ /
english: Having imagined the union of his own soul with discharge of the breath, it should be led to the abode of Śiva after having gradually discarded with discrimination the cause such as Brahmā, etc.

sanskrit: garbhādhānārthamādāya yugapat sarvayoniṣu // kṣipedvāgīśvarīyonau vāmayodbhavamudrayā /
english: One should cast it in the womb of Goddess Vīgīśvarī with the exhibition of udbhavamudrā posture with fingers denoting generation after having carried it for impregnation in all the principles simultaneously.

sanskrit: pūjayedapyanenaiva tarpayedapi pañcadhā //
english: One should worship with this mantra and after oblations five times.

sanskrit: anyayoniṣu sarvāsu dehaśuddhiṃ hṛdā caret /
english: One should do the purification of the body with the mantra of the heart in the case of all other principles.

sanskrit: nātra puṃsavanaṃ stryādiśarīrasyāpi sambhavāt //
english: The puṃsavana the rite of determining the sex is not done, as there can be a feminine form also.

sanskrit: sīmantonnayanaṃ vāpi daivānyaṅgāni dehavat /
english: The sīmantonnayana parting of the hair and the divine limbs should be treated as the body.

sanskrit: śirasā janma kurvīta jugupsan sarvadehināṃ //
english: The purificatory rite at the birth for all human beings should be done with the mantra of the head with aversion.

sanskrit: tathaiva bhāvayedeṣāmadhikāraṃ śivāṇunā /
english: The preceptor should similarly contemplate upon the regions over which they have control, with the mantra of Śiva.

sanskrit: bhogaṃ kavacamantreṇa śastreṇa viṣayātmanā //
english: The objects of sense pleasure should be contemplated with the mantra of the armour and the worldly objects with the mantra of the weapons.

sanskrit: moharūpamabhedaś ca layasajñaṃ vibhāvayet /
english: One should contemplate on that one which is known as dissolution, as the form of delusion and unbreakable.

sanskrit: śivena śrotasāṃ śuddhiṃ hṛdā tattvaviśodhanaṃ //
english: Streams should be purified by contemplating the mantra of Śiva and the purification of the principles should be done with the mantra of the heart.

sanskrit: pañca pañcāhutīḥ kuryāt garbhādhānādiṣu kramāt / māyayā malakarmādipāśabandhanivṛttaye //
english: Five times five oblations should be made in respect of the rites of garbhādhāna and others in order for the sake of cessation of the bonds due to sinful acts.

sanskrit: niṣkṛtyaiva hṛdā paścād yajeta śatamāhutīḥ /
english: One hundred oblations should be made with the mantra of the heart after having accomplished expiation.

sanskrit: malaśaktinirodhena pāśānāñca viyojanaṃ //
english: By obstructing the force of sins one can severe the bonds.

sanskrit: svāhāntāyudhamantreṇa pañcapañcāhutīryajet /
english: Five times five oblations should be offered with the mantra of the weapon ending with oblations.

sanskrit: māyādyantasya pāśasya saptavārāstrajaptayā //
english: By the repetition of the mantra of theweapon seven times one gets free from bonds ending with illusion.

sanskrit: kartaryā chedanaṃ kuryāt kalpaśastreṇa tadyathā /
english: The accomplishment by the mantra kalpa of the weapon is like cutting with a scissor.

sanskrit: bandhakatvañca nirvartya hastābhyāñca śarāṇunā // visṛjya vartulīkṛtya ghṛtapūrṇe sruve dharet /
english: Āṃ, hūṃ, to the thread of the beatitude of nonaction, hūṃ, phaṭ, Having accomplished the cessation of bondage with the hands and with the mantra of the arrow, the thread should be untied and laid in a circular form on the sacrificial ladle filled with clarified butter.

sanskrit: dahedanukalāstreṇa kevalāstreṇa bhasmasāt // kuryāt pañcāhutīrdatvā pāśāṅkuśanivṛttaye /
english: One should then burn it with the mantra of the weapon and reduce it into ashes with the weapon after having offered five oblations for the removal of the goad of bondage.

sanskrit: prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kuryādastrāhutibhiraṣṭabhiḥ // athāvāhya vidhātāraṃ pūjayettarpayettathā /
english: Expiation should then be made with eight oblations made with the mantra of the weapon. After having invoked Lord Brahmā, he should be worshipped and appeased.

sanskrit: dagdhaniḥśeṣapāpasya brahmannasya paśostvayā //
english: “O Brahman! you should not again bind this being whose sins have all been burnt.

sanskrit: bandhāya na punaḥ stheyaṃ śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti / tato visṛjya dhātāraṃ nāḍyā dakṣiṇayā śanaiḥ // saṃhāramudrayātmānaṃ kumbhakena nijātmanā /
english: You listen to the mandate of Lord Śiva.” After having bid farewell to Lord Brahmā, the preceptor should slowly fill in the soul of the disciple by his own soul with retention of breath and exhibiting saṃhāramudrā posture with fingers representing collection.

sanskrit: rāhuyuktaikadeśena candravimbena sannibhaṃ //
english: That soul would then look like the disc of the moon at the beginning of the eclipses at a particular spot.

sanskrit: ādāya yojayet sūtre recakenodbhavākhyayā / pūjayitvārghyapātrasthatoyavindusudhopamaṃ // visṛjya pitarau dadyādvauṣaḍantaśivāṇunā / pūraṇāya vidhiḥ pūrṇā nivṛttiriti śodhitā //
english: After having taken it out, it should be located in the thread with the discharge of breath and with udbhavamudrā posture with fingers denoting generation. After having worshipped it, the preceptor should place the drop of water in the offering vessel resembling the nectar, on the head of the disciple for the purpose of completion.

sanskrit: tattvayoratha sandhānaṃ kuryācchuddhaviśuddhayoḥ / hrasvadīrghaprayogeṇa nādanādāntasaṅginā //
english: The nonaction principle is thus purified. The union of the two principles good and bad should be brought about by the application of short and long vowels associated with sound.

sanskrit: aptejo vāyurākāśaṃ tanmātrendriyabuddhayaḥ / guṇatrayamahaṅkāraś caturviṃśaḥ pumāniti //
english: Oṃ, hāṃ, hrūṃ, hāṃ, water, effulgence, wind, sky, the subtle principles, organs, intellect, the three qualities and ego are the twentyfour principles and the puruṣa the soul is the twentyfifth.

sanskrit: pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyāni khādiyāntākṣarāṇi ca // pañcāśadadhikā ṣaṣṭirbhuvanaistulyasañjñitāḥ / tāvanta eva rudrāś ca vijñeyāstatra tadyathā //
english: The preceptor should imagine the letters beginning with kha and ending with jya as merged in the above twentyfive principles. The number of Rudras is equivalent to the bhuvanas Worlds, which are known to be fiftysix. They are as follows

sanskrit: nakulīśo hariś candraḥ śrīśailo daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ / anvīśo 'srātikeśaś ca mahākālo 'tha madhyamaḥ // kedāro bhairavaś caiva dvitīyāṣṭakamīritaṃ /
english: Amareśa, Prabhāva, Naimiṣa, Puṣkara, Pādi, Daṇḍi, Bhavabhūti, Nakulīśa the eighth, Hariścandra, Śrīśaila the tenth, Anvīśa, Abhrātikeśa, Mahākāla, Madhyama, Kedāra, Bhairava, spoken as the second group of eight.

sanskrit: tato gayākurukṣetrakhalānādikanādike // vimalaścāṭṭahāsaś ca mahendro bhāma eva ca / vasvāpadaṃ rudrakoṭiraviyukto mahāvantaḥ // gokarṇo bhadrakarṇaś ca svarṇākṣaḥ sthāṇureva ca / ajeśaś caiva sarvajño bhāsvaraḥ sūdanāntaraḥ //
english: Then Gayākurukṣetrakhalānādikanādika, Vimala, Aṭṭahāsa, Mahendra, Bhīma, Vasvāpada, Rudrakoṭi, Aviyukta, Mahābala, Gokarṇa, Bhadrakarṇa, Svarṇākṣa, Sthāṇu Ajeya, Sarvajña, Bhāsvara, Sūdanāntara, Subāhu, Mattarūpī, Viśāla, Jaṭila, Raudra, Piṅgalākṣa, Kāladaṃṣṭrī, Vidura, Ghora, Prājāpatya, Hutāśana, Kāmarūpī, Kāla, Karṇa, Bhayānaka, Mataṅga, Piṅgala, Hara, Dātṛ saṃjñaka, Śaṅkukarṇa, Vidhāna, Śrīkaṇṭha and Candraśekhara.

sanskrit: sahaitena ca paryantāḥ kathyante 'tha padānyapi /
english: Their attributes to be used along with their names are also described then.

sanskrit: vījabhāve trayo mantrā vāmadevaḥ śivaḥ śikhā //
english: Vāmadeva, Śiva, and Śikhā are the three mantras in the subtle form.

sanskrit: gāndhārī ca suṣumṇā ca nāḍyau dvau mārutau tathā / samānodānanāmānau rasanāpāyurindriye //
english: The two occult sychic nerves gāndhārī and suṣumnā, then the winds samāna and udāna, the organs of taste and reproduction are also worshipped.

sanskrit: rasastu viṣayo rūpaśabdasparśarasā guṇāḥ /
english: The sentiments are the material objects. The qualities are perception, hearing, touch and taste.

sanskrit: maṇḍalaṃ vartulaṃ tacca puṇḍarīkāṅkitaṃ sitaṃ //
english: The mystic diagram should be circular and bear the mark of a white lotus.

sanskrit: svapnāvasthāpratiṣṭhāyāṃ kāraṇaṃ garuḍadhvajaṃ / pratiṣṭhāntakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sañcintya bhuvanādikaṃ // sūtraṃ dehe svamantreṇa praviśyaināṃ viyojayet /
english: After having contemplated on the worlds as well as those established along with the eaglebannered god who is the cause for the establishment in the dreamy state, the thread should be placed on the body with the recitation of the appropriate mantra and retained by the preceptor.

sanskrit: viṣṇo tavādhikāre 'smin mumukṣuṃ dīkṣayāmyahaṃ //
english: Oṃ, hāṃ, hraṃ, hrām, hāṃ, obeisance to the thread of the beatitude of consecration.

sanskrit: bhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlena viṣṇuṃ vijñāpayediti /
english: You should be propitious. Thus Lord Viṣṇu should be informed.

sanskrit: tato vāgīśvarīṃ devīṃ vāgīśamapi pūrvavat // āvāhyābhyarcya santarpya śiṣyaṃ vakṣasi tāḍayet /
english: Then the Goddess Vāgīśvarī and Lord Vāgīśa should be invoked as before, worshipped and offered oblations and the disciple should be gently struck on the chest.

sanskrit: praviśedapyanenaiva caitanyaṃ vibhajettataḥ // śastreṇa pāśasaṃyuktaṃ jyeṣṭayāṅkuśamudrayā /
english: The preceptor should enter with the same mantra and severe the consciousness in the abovesaid thread with the mantra of weapon and showing the aṅkuśamudrā formation with fingers denoting a goad and jyeṣṭhā mantra Oṃ, hāṃ, haṃ, hoṃ, hrūṃ, phaṭ.

sanskrit: svāhāntena hṛdākṛṣya tenaiva puṭitātmanā // gṛhītvā taṃ namontena nijātmani niyojayet /
english: Having drawn it with the mantra of the heart ending with “oblations”, it should be lodged in one’s own soul repeating the same mantra and ending with obeisance”.

sanskrit: pūrvavat pitṛsaṃyogaṃ bhāvayitvodbhavākhyayā // vāmayā tadanenaiva devīgarbhe vinikṣipet /
english: The union of divine parentsshould be imagined as before with the udbhavamudrā posture with fingers denoting generation and the seed of the soul should be cast into the womb of the goddess by exhibiting the same mudrā from the left.

sanskrit: dehotpattau hṛdā hy evaṃ śirasā janmanā tathā //
english: the birth of the body should be accomplished by the mantra of the heart, the postnatal ceremony by the mantra of the head.

sanskrit: śikhayā vādhikārāya bhogāya kavacāṇunā /
english: For the sake of enjoyment of pleasures it should be done by the mantra of the armour.

sanskrit: tattvaśuddhau hṛdā hy evaṃ garbhādhānāya pūrvavat //
english: In regard to the purity of principles it should be done with the mantra of the heart and in the case of impregnation it is in the same way as before.

sanskrit: śirasā pāśaśaithilye niṣkṛtyaivaṃ śataṃ japet / evaṃ pāśaviyoge 'pi tataḥ śāstrajaptayā //
english: Having cut the bonds thus, the preceptor should repeat the mantra hundred times. Even after having cut the bonds thus, the preceptor should cut it with the repetition of the mantra of the weapon and with a scissor over which the mantra of the beatific principles has been repeated.

sanskrit: chindyādastreṇa kartaryā kalāvījavatā yathā / visṛjya vartulīkṛtya pāśamantreṇa pūrvavat // ghṛtapūrṇe śrave datvā kalāstreṇaiva homayet /
english: The thread should be removed and kept in a circular shape as before described in the previous chapter with the repetition of the mantra of the weapon. Having placed it over the sacrificial ladle filled with clarified butter, oblations should be done with the mantra of the beatific principles and weapons.

sanskrit: astreṇa juhuyāt pañca pāśāṅkuranivṛttaye //
english: Five oblations should be made with the mantra of the weapon for the cessation of shoots of bondage.

sanskrit: prāyaścittaniṣedhārthaṃ dadyādaṣṭāhutīstataḥ /
english: Eight oblations should be made for the sake of expiation.

sanskrit: hṛdāvāhya hṛṣīkeśaṃ kṛtvā pūjatarpaṇe //
english: Lord Hṛṣīkeśa should be invoked and worshipped and offered oblations.

sanskrit: pūrvoktavidhinā kuryādadhikārasamarpaṇaṃ /
english: As laid down earlier investiture of authority should be made “Oṃ, hāṃ accept this fees of sentiment, oblations” is the mantra which should be repeated.

sanskrit: niḥśeṣadagdhapāśasya paśorasya hare tvayā // na stheyaṃ bandhakatvena śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti /
english: O Hara! you should not remain as a bond of this being the disciple whose bondage has completely been burnt away. Listen to this mandate of Lord Śiva.

sanskrit: tato visṛjya govindaṃ vidyātmānaṃ niyojya ca // bāhumuktārdhadṛśyena candravimbena sannibhaṃ / saṃhāramudrayā svasthaṃ vidhāyodbhavamudrayā // sūtre saṃyojya vinyasya toyavinduṃ yathā purā /
english: farewell to Lord Govinda Viṣṇu and united the soul of knowledge which resembles the moon’s disc half uncovered by the band by exhibiting the saṃhāramudrā posture with fingers denoting gathering and having bid farewell by showing the udbhavamudrā formation with fingers denoting generation, the drop of water should be placed on the thread as before.

sanskrit: visṛjya pitarau vahneḥ pūjitau kusumādibhiḥ /
english: Having bid farewell to the divine parents and having worshipped the fire with flowers, etc.

sanskrit: dadyāt pūrṇāṃ vidhānena pratiṣṭhāpi viśodhitā //
english: Thus the consecration also gets purified. But, actually only twentynine have been given.

sanskrit: sandhānamatha vidyāyāḥ prācīnakalayā saha / kurvīta pūrvavat kṛtvā tattvaṃ varṇaya tadyathā //
english: . The union of the beatific principle of knowledge and that of ancient one should be done as before, after having located the principles.
