english: If one who is held on suspicion for theft cannot expiate himself, he should restore the stolen property. He should be punished as a thief.

sanskrit: cauraṃ pradāpyāpahṛtaṃ ghātayedvividhair budhaiḥ / sacihnaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kṛtvā svarāṣṭrādvipravāsayet //
english: Stolen articles should be recovered from the thief and he should be put to death by different methods. A brahmin convicted of theft should be branded and banished from his country.

sanskrit: ghātite 'pahṛte doṣo grāmabharturanirgate / svasīmni dadyādgrāmastu padaṃ vā yatra gacchati //
english: The headman of a village should be held responsible for murder and theft, if the criminal has not left his jurisdiction. He should be brought to account in the village where he sets his foot.

sanskrit: pañcagrāmī vahiḥ krośāddaśagrāmya.atha vā punaḥ /
english: Similarly five or ten villages within a radius of two miles of the place are held responsible.

sanskrit: vandigrāhāṃs tathā vājikuñjarāṇāñca hāriṇaḥ // prasahya ghātinaś caiva śūlamāropayennarān / utkṣepakagranthibhedau karasandaṃśahīnakau //
english: Those men who abduct the captives, horses and elephants and those who murder violently should be put on the iron stake. A stealer of clothes and a pickpocket should be deprived of both the hands ie., hands should be cut off.

sanskrit: kāryau dvitīyāparādhe karapādaikahīnakau /
english: Or for the latter offence, one hand and leg should be cut off.

sanskrit: bhaktāvakāśāgnyudakamantrāpakaraṇavyayān // dattvā caurasya hanturvā jānato dama uttamaḥ /
english: Putting a thief or a murderer to death by means of giving food or stimulant, or by means of fire, water, mantra or weapon is known as excellent punishment.

sanskrit: śastrāvapāte garbhasya pātane cottamo damaḥ //
english: The highest sāhasa should be the punishment for causing abortion/miscarriage by means of a weapon.

sanskrit: uttamo vādhamo vāpi puruṣastrīpramāpaṇe /
english: The highest or the lowest fine should be imposed on those who kill a man or a woman.

sanskrit: śilāṃ baddhvā kṣipedapsu naraghnīṃ viṣadāṃ striyaṃ // viṣāgnidāṃ nijagurunijāpatyapramāpaṇīṃ / vikarṇakaranāsauṣṭhīṃ kṛtvā gobhiḥ pramāpayet //
english: A woman who kills a man by giving poison should be fastened to a stone and thrown into water. A woman who kills by giving poison or setting fire to her preceptor or offspring should be deprived of her ears, hands, nose and lips and killed by employing cows.

sanskrit: kṣetraveśmavanagrāmavivītakhaladāhakāḥ / rājapatny abhigāmī ca dagdhavyāstu kaṭāgninā // pumān saṃgrahaṇe grāhyaḥ keśākeśiparastriyāḥ /
english: Incendiaries of fields, dwelling houses, forests, villages, pasture lands and threshing floors and a person who has had intercourse with the king’s wife should be burnt by fire fed on straw placed around. A man should be caught by the hair when he is having adultery with other women.

sanskrit: svajātāvuttamo daṇḍa ānulomye tu madhyamaḥ //
english: The highest sāhasa is the fine if the woman belonged to his own caste and middle fine is prescribed if the woman belonged to the lower caste.

sanskrit: prātilomye badhaḥ puṃsāṃ nāryāḥ karṇāvakartanam /
english: But if the woman belonged to the higher caste than the adulterer, the man should be killed and the ears of the woman should be cut off.

sanskrit: nīvīstanaprāvaraṇanābhikeśāvamardanam // adeśakālasambhāṣaṃ sahāvasthānameva ca /
english: One who forcibly removes the garments covering the waist, breast, navel and braids of a woman, and one who engages in conversation with a woman at an inappropriate place and time and who stays with her similarly is liable to be fined.

sanskrit: strī niṣedhe śataṃ dadyād dviśatantu damaṃ pumān //
english: If it is prohibited for a woman, she has to pay a fine of one hundred paṇas and if for a man, he has to pay two hundred paṇas.

sanskrit: pratiṣedhe tayordaṇḍo yathā saṃgrahaṇe tathā /
english: In spite of the prohibition if they indulge in the above crimes, they have to be fined as in the case of adultery.

sanskrit: paśūn gacchaṃśchataṃ dāpyo hīnāṃ strīṃ gāś ca madhyamam // avaruddhāsu dāsīṣu bhujiṣyāsu tathaiva ca / gamyāsvapi pumāndāpyaḥ pañcāśat paṇikandamam //
english: A person mating with an animal shall be fined one hundred paṇas, and one mating with a woman of low caste or with a cow shall be fined the middle sāhasa. A person who mates with a slave girl or a maidservant held in captivity, though otherwise fit for cohabitation, should be fined fifty paṇas.

sanskrit: prasahya dāsyabhigame daṇḍo daśapaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ /
english: The fine is said to be ten paṇas if one forcibly copulates with a slave girl.

sanskrit: kubandhenāṅkya gamayedantyāpravrajitāgame // nyūnaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ vāpi likhedyo rājaśāsanam / pāradārikacauraṃ vā muñcato daṇḍa uttamaḥ //
english: One who mates with a woman of the last caste and a woman mendicant should be fettered and banished from the country. A person who adds or omits in copying the royal edict or one who releases a seducer should be fined the highest sāhas.

sanskrit: abhakṣair dūṣayan vipraṃ daṇḍa uttamasāhasam /
english: One who pollutes a brahmin by mixing forbidden food, should be fined the highest sāhasa.

sanskrit: kūṭasvarṇavyavahārī vimāṃsasya ca vikrayī // aṅgahīnaś ca kartavyo dāpyaścottamasāhasaṃ / śakto hy amokṣayan svāmī daṃṣṭriṇaḥ śṛṅgiṇas tathā //
english: One who deals in counterfeit gold and one who sells unclean meat should be maimed and fined the highest sāhasa. An owner who releases the wild boars and horned cattle, though he is capable of keeping them penned, should pay the first sāhasa as fine.

sanskrit: prathamaṃ sāhasaṃ dadyādvikruṣṭe dviguṇaṃ tathā /
english: If it is accompanied by shouting, the owner should pay double the fine.

sanskrit: acaurañcaure 'bhivadan dāpyaḥ pañcaśataṃ damaṃ //
english: A man who calls an innocent man a thief should be made to pay a fine of five hundred paṇas.

sanskrit: rājño 'niṣṭapravaktāraṃ tasyaivākrośakaṃ tathā / mṛtāṅgalagnavikreturgurostāḍayitus tathā // tanmantrasya ca bhettāraṃ chittvā jihvāṃ pravāsayet /
english: One who utters undesirable words against the king, one who abuses the same, one who sells things connected with a dead body, one who beats his preceptor, one who divulges his preceptor’s mantra, should be banished from the country with his tongue cut off.

sanskrit: rājayānāsanāroḍhurdaṇḍo madhyamasāhasaḥ //
english: The fine for a person who rides the carriage or sits on the seat of the king, is the middle sāhasa.

sanskrit: dvinetrabhedino rājadviṣṭādeśakṛtas tathā /
english: The two eyes should be plucked out in the case of a person who acts hostile to the king or the nation.

sanskrit: vipratvena ca śūdrasya jīvato 'ṣṭaśato damaḥ //
english: A śūdra living like a brahmin should be fined eight hundred paṇas.

sanskrit: yo manyetājito 'smīti nyāyenābhiparājitaḥ / tamāyāntaṃ punarjitvā daṇḍayeddviguṇaṃ damaṃ //
english: If one has been defeated in the proper way, thinks that he is unconquered, he should be defeated again when he comes and should be punished to pay double the amount of fine.

sanskrit: rājñānyāyena yo daṇḍo gṛhīto varuṇāyataṃ / vivedya dadyādviprebhyaḥ svayaṃ triṃśadguṇīkṛtaṃ //
english: A king who has fined a person unjustly should offer the amount to lord VaruṇaGL_NOTE0} and pay thirty times the amount to the brahmins.

sanskrit: dharmaścārthaś ca kīrtiñca lokapaṅktirupagrahaḥ / prajābhyo bahumānañca svargasthānañca śāśvatam // paśyato vyavahārāṃś ca guṇāḥ syuḥ sapta bhūpateḥ //84//
english: Piety, wealth, fame, esteem of mankind, favour, love of the subjects and permanent residence in heaven, dispensing justice even as people watch are the seven qualities of a king. Lord of ocean and righteousness.

sanskrit: ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvavidhānaṃ puṣkaroditam / bhuktimuktikaraṃ japyāddhomādrāmāya tadvade //
english: shall now describe to you the application of the mantras of the Ṛg veda, Yajur veda, Sāma veda and Atharva veda that yield enjoyment and emancipation when repeated and are used for making oblations as described by Puṣkara to Rāma.

sanskrit: prativedantu karmāṇi kāryāṇi pravadāmi te /
english: shall now describe the religious rites relating to each one of the Vedas.

sanskrit: prathamaṃ ṛgvidhānaṃ vai śṛṇu tvaṃ bhuktimuktidam //
english: You listen first to the application of the Ṛg veda that would yield enjoyment and emancipation.

sanskrit: antarjale tathā home japatī manasepsitam / kāmaṃ karoti gāyatrī prāṇāyāmādviśeṣataḥ //
english: The repetition of the Gāyatrī mantra especially with the practice of prāṇāyāma regulated breathing, while remaining in the water as well as at the time of making oblations confers the fulfilment of heart’s desires.

sanskrit: gāyatryā daśasāhasro japo naktāśano dvija / bahusnātasya tatraiva sarvakalmaṣanāśanaḥ //
english: O Brahmin! The repetition of the Gāyatrī ten thousand times by a man eating only in the night and bathing many times during the day, destroys all the sins then and there.

sanskrit: daśāyutāni japtvātha haviṣyāśī sa muktibhāk /
english: One who repeats the mantra a lakh times while eating the oblations, becomes fit for emancipation.

sanskrit: praṇavo hi paraṃ brahma tajjapaḥ sarvapāpahā //
english: The praṇava the syllable Oṃ is identical with the Supreme Braman and its repetition destroys all the sins.

sanskrit: oṃkāraśatajaptantu nābhimātrodake sthitaḥ / jalaṃ pivet sa sarvaistu pāpair vai vipramucyate //
english: One who repeats the syllable Oṃ while remaining in waistdeep water and drinks the water becomes free from all sins.

sanskrit: mātrātrayaṃ trayo vedāstrayo devāstrayo 'gnayaḥ / mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ sapta lokā homo 'khilāghahā //
english: The praṇava consists of three mātrās syllabic instants, three Vedas, three gods Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Śiva and three fires. The mahāvyāhṛtis are the seven worlds.

sanskrit: gāyatrī paramā jāpyā mahāvyāhṛtayas tathā /
english: Gāyatrī is the most excellent among the mantras fit for repetition. The mahāvyāhṛtis are also of similar nature.

sanskrit: antarjale tathā rāma proktaś caivāghamarṣaṇaḥ //
english: O Rāma! The aghamarṣaṇa sūkta destroyer of sins should be repeated while remaining in the water.

sanskrit: agnimīle purohitaṃ sūtko 'yaṃ vahnidaivataḥ /
english: a. The hymn agnimīle purohitaṃ is sacred for the Firegod.

sanskrit: śirasā dhārayan vahniṃ yo japetparivatsaram // homaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ bhaikṣyamanagnijvalanañcaret /
english: One should repeat this hymn over a year holding the fire on the head, performing oblation three times a day with soma juice, living on alms and without lighting the fire for cooking.

sanskrit: ataḥ paramṛcaḥ sapta vāyvādyā yāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
english: Then the seven ṛks hymns known as Vāyu etc.

sanskrit: tā japan prayato nityamiṣṭān kāmān samaśnute / medhākāmo japennityaṃ sadasanyamiti tyacam //
english: should be daily repeated devoutly. Thus one will realise all his desires. One who desires to improve his memory should repeat the hymn known as sadasaspatim.

sanskrit: anvayo yannimāḥ proktāḥ navarco mṛtyunāśanāḥ /
english: These nine hymns beginning with anvayo yan are said to be destroyers of death.

sanskrit: śunaḥśephamṛṣiṃ baddhaḥ sanniruddho 'tha vā japet //
english: One who is a captive or being obstructed should repeat the hymn śunaḥśepaṃ ṛṣiṃ.

sanskrit: mucyate sarvapāpebhyo gadī vāpyagado bhavet /
english: One becomes free from all sins by this. One who is sick becomes free from sickness.

sanskrit: ya icchecchāśvataṃ kāmaṃ mitraṃ prājñaṃ purandaraṃ // ṛgbhiḥ ṣoḍśabhiḥ kuryādindriyasyeti dine dine / hiraṇyastūpamityetajjapan śatrūn prabādhate //
english: One who is desirous of gaining permanent pleasures and the friendship of the wise Purandara Indra should repeat daily the sixteen hymns beginning with indrasya. One who repeats the hymn hiraṇyastūpaṃ will cause affliction to the enemies.

sanskrit: kṣemī bhavati cādhvāno ye te panthā japan naraḥ /
english: One who repeats the hymn ye te panthāḥ will be safe on his journey.

sanskrit: raudrībhiḥṣaḍbhirīśānaṃ stūyādyo vai dine dine // caruṃ vā kalpayedraudraṃ tasya śāntiḥ parā bhavet /
english: One who praises lord Īśāna with six Rudra hymns everyday or one who offers oblation to Rudra will have greatest peace.

sanskrit: udityudantamādityamupatiṣṭhan dine dine // kṣipejjalāñjalīn sapta manoduḥkhavināśanaṃ /
english: One who extolls the rising Sun with the hymn ‘ud’ and offers water with folded palms seven times will be able to dispel his mental grief.

sanskrit: dviṣantamityathārdharcaṃ yadviprāntaṃ japan smaret // āgaskṛt saptarātreṇa vidveṣamadhigacchati /
english: One who repeats the half hymn dviṣantaṃ ending with yadvi pra will get his sin destroyed within seven nights.

sanskrit: ārogyakāmī rogī vā praskannasyottamaṃ japet //
english: One who desires health or one who is sick should repeat the hymn praskannasyottamaṃ.

sanskrit: uttamastasya cārdharco japedvai vividhāsane / udayatyāyurakṣyayyaṃ tejo madhyandine japet // astaṃ pratigate sūrye dviṣantaṃ pratibādhate /
english: One who repeats the half hymn uttamastasya in various postures will get long life if it is repeated at midday one will get radiance if repeated at sunset one will afflict his enemies.

sanskrit: na vayaśceti sūktāni japan śatrūnniyacchati //
english: One who repeats the hymns na vadhaḥ will destroy his enemies.

sanskrit: ekādaśa suparṇasya sarvakāmānvinirdiśet /
english: One who repeats the eleven suparṇa hymns will accomplish all the wishes.

sanskrit: ādhyātmikīḥ ka ity etā japanmokṣamavāpnuyāt //
english: One who repeats the hymn ādhyātmikīḥ ka will get emancipation.

sanskrit: ā no bhadrā ity anena dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt /
english: One who repeats the hymn ā no bhadrā will get long life.

sanskrit: tvaṃ someti ca sūktena navaṃ paśyenniśākaraṃ // upatiṣṭhet samitpāṇirvāsāṃsyāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ /
english: One should look at the rising moon with the repetition of the hymn tvam soma and worship with the twig in the hand.

sanskrit: āyurīpsannimamiti kautsa sūktaṃ sadā japet //
english: One who desires long life should always repeat the hymn of Kautsa beginning with imaṃ.

sanskrit: āpanaḥ śośucaditi stutvā madhye divākaraṃ / yathā muñcati ceṣokāṃ tathā pāpaṃ pramuñcati //
english: By glorifying the Sun at midday with the hymn apanaḥ śośucad, one gets freed from sin like a bow when the arrow is discharged.

sanskrit: jātavedasa ity etajjapet svastyayanaṃ pathi /
english: One’s pathway becomes safe by the repetition of the hymn jātavedasa.

sanskrit: bhayair vimucyate sarvaiḥ svastimānāpnuyāt gṛhān //
english: One gets free from all fears. That person enjoying auspicious things will get houses.

sanskrit: vyuṣṭāyāñca tathā rātryāmetadduḥsvapnanāśanaṃ / pramandineti sūyantyā japedgarbhavimocanaṃ //
english: This hymn destroys the bad dream of the previous night. One should repeat the hymn pramandina and a woman who is delivering a child will do so with ease.

sanskrit: japannindramiti snāto vaiśyadevantu saptakaṃ / muñcatyājyaṃ tathā juhvat sakalaṃ kilviṣaṃ naraḥ //
english: A man will get free from all sins after bathing with the repetition of the hymn upannindraṃ and offering clarified butter as oblation while repeating the seven Vaiśvadeva hymns.

sanskrit: imāmiti japan śaśvat kāmānāpnotyabhīpsitān /
english: One who repeats the hymn imām always will get all his desires fulfilled.

sanskrit: mānastoka iti dvābhyāṃ trirātropoṣitaḥ śuciḥ // auḍumbarīś ca juhuyātsamidhaścājyasaṃskṛtāḥ /
english: One who fasts for three nights and offers the twigs of udumbara tree dipped in clarified butter with the repetition of the two hymns mā nastoka etc.

sanskrit: chittvā sarvānmṛtyupāśān jīvedrogavivarjitaḥ //
english: after becoming pure will cut all the fetters of death and live free from disease. la.

sanskrit: mānastoketi ca ṛcā śikhābandhe kṛte naraḥ // aghṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jāyate saṃśayaṃ vinā /
english: One who having glorified Lord Śambhu with the repetition of this hymn with arms raised, binds the tuft into a knot while repeating the hymn mānastoka, no doubt, becomes invincible by all beings.

sanskrit: citramityupatiṣṭheta trisandhyaṃ bhāskaraṃ tathā //
english: One should worship the Sun daily at the three twilights with the repetition of the hymn citraṃ holding the twig.

sanskrit: samitpāṇirnaro nityamīpsitaṃ dhanamāpnuyāt /
english: Thus he will get the desired wealth.

sanskrit: atha svapneti ca japan prātarmadhyandine dine // duḥsvapnañcārhate kṛtsnaṃ bhojanañcāpnuyācchubham /
english: One will destroy the entire bad dream and get good food by the repetition of the hymn atha svapna in the morning and noon everyday.

sanskrit: ubhe pumāniti tathā rakṣoghnaḥ parikīrtitaḥ //
english: The hymn ubhe pumān is said to destroy the demons.

sanskrit: ubhe vāsā iti ṛco japan kāmānavāpnuyāt /
english: One who repeats the hymn ubhe vāsā will get all the pleasures.

sanskrit: na sāganniti ca japan mucyate cātatāyinaḥ //
english: A person repeating the hymn na sāgan will escape from the murderer.

sanskrit: kayā śubheti ca japan jātiśraiṣṭhamavāpnuyāt / imannṛsomamityetat sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt //
english: One who repeats the hymn kayā śubha will attain casteexcellence, and the hymn imaṃ nṛsomaṃ will give all the pleasures.

sanskrit: pitarityupatiṣṭheta nityamarthamupasthitaṃ /
english: Conveying obeisance with the hymn pitaḥ one will always acquire riches.

sanskrit: agne nayeti sūktena ghṛtahomaś ca mārgagaḥ //
english: Oblation made with ghee with the repetition of the hymn agne naya also shows the path.

sanskrit: vīrānnayamavāpnoti suślokaṃ yo japet sadā /
english: One who repeats suśloka will always get a progeny of heroes.

sanskrit: kaṅkato neti sūktena viṣān sarvān vyapohati //
english: One is able to destroy all poisons by the repetition of the hymn kaṅkato na.

sanskrit: yo jāta iti sūktena sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt /
english: One will get all the pleasures by the repetition of the hymn yo jāta.

sanskrit: gaṇānāmiti sūktena śnigdhamāpnotyanuttamaṃ //
english: One will get an excellent friend by the repetition of the hymn gaṇānām. la.

sanskrit: yo me rājannitīmāntu duḥsvapnaśamanīmṛcaṃ /
english: One should repeat the hymn yo me rājan that destroys bad dream.

sanskrit: apraśastaṃ praśastaṃ vā kuvidaṅga imaṃ japet /
english: One who commences a journey and faces an unpraiseworthy or praiseworthy enemy should repeat the hymn kuvidaṅga.

sanskrit: dvāviṃśakaṃ japan sūktamādhyātmikamanuttamaṃ // parvasu prayato nityamiṣṭān kāmān samaśnute /
english: One will enjoy all the desired pleasures by repeating the excellent hymn ādhyātmika consisting of twentytwo verses on the full and new moon days.

sanskrit: kṛṇuṣveti japan sūktaṃ juhvadājyaṃ samāhitaḥ //
english: One should offer an oblation of clarified butter with concentrated mind repeating the hymn kṛṇuṣva.

sanskrit: ārātīnāṃ haret prāṇān rakṣāṃsyapi vināśayet /
english: One will take away the lives of enemies and destroy even the demons by this.

sanskrit: upatiṣṭhet svayaṃ vahniṃ parityṛcā dine dine //
english: One should worship daily the Fire god with the hymn pari.

sanskrit: taṃ rakṣati svayaṃ vahnirviśvato viśvatomukhaḥ /
english: The Fire god having a face on every side Himself protects that person on all sides.

sanskrit: haṃsaḥ śuciḥ sadityetacchucirīkṣeddivākaraṃ //
english: One should look at the Sun, remaining pure and repeating the hymn haṃsaḥ śuciṣad.

sanskrit: kṛṣiṃ prapadyamānastu sthālīpākaṃ yathāvidhi / juhuyāt kṣetramadhye tu svanīsvāhāstu pañcabhiḥ //
english: A man about to cultivate a field should offer oblations of potboiled porridge at the centre of the field as laid down with the five hymns svanī svāhā.

sanskrit: indrāya ca marudbhyastu parjanyāya bhagāya ca /
english: A farmer should derive his plough in the approriate manner and offer oblations to the gods Indra, Maruts, Parjanya and Bhaga.

sanskrit: yukto dhānyāya sītāyai sunāsīramathottaraṃ / gandhamālyair namaskārair yajedetāś ca devatāḥ //
english: One should then worship Indra and these deities with perfumes, garlands and prostrations after having worshipped the ploughshare saying the yoke has been fastened for the sake of grains.

sanskrit: pravāpane pralavane khalasītāpahārayoḥ / amoghaṅkarma bhavati vardhate sarvadā kṛṣiḥ //
english: Agriculture will thus always thrive and the work relating to sowing the seeds, cutting, threshing and ploughing will yield profuse results.

sanskrit: samudrāditi sūktena kāmānāpnoti pāvakāt / viśvānara iti dvābhyāṃ ya ṛgbhyāṃ vahnimarhati // sa taratyāpadaḥ sarvā yaśaḥ prāpnoti cākṣayaṃ / vipulāṃ śriyamāpnoti jayaṃ prāpnotyanuttamaṃ //
english: One will get the desired things from the Fire god by the recitation of the hymn samudrāt One who worships the Fire god with the two hymns called viśvānara, surmounts all difficulties, gets undiminishing fame, abundant wealth and unsurpassed victory.

sanskrit: agne tvamiti ca stutvā dhanamāpnoti vāñchitaṃ /
english: One gets the desired riches by propitiating the Fire god with the hymn agne tvam.

sanskrit: prajākāmo japennityaṃ varuṇadaivatatrayaṃ //
english: A person desirous of having progeny should repeat the three hymns of Varuṇa daily.

sanskrit: svastyā trayaṃ japet prātaḥ sadā svastyayanaṃ mahat /
english: Each morning, one should recite the three svasti hymns, whereby one will always secure great prosperity.

sanskrit: svasti panthā iti procya svastimān vrajate 'dhvani // vijigīṣurvanaspate śatrūṇāṃ vyādhitaṃ bhavet /
english: By the recitation of the hymn svasti panthām one will have safe journey. One who desires to conquer should repeat the hymn vanaspate, by which enemies will be laid down with disease.

sanskrit: striyā garbhapramūḍhāyā garbhamokṣaṇamuttamaṃ // acchāvadeti sūktañca vṛṣṭikāmaḥ prayiojayet /
english: By the recitation of the same hymn a woman having a dead foetus will have a good delivery. One who is desirous to get rain should employ the hymn acchāvada after fasting and wearing wet clothes.

sanskrit: nirāhāraḥ klinnavāsā na cireṇa pravarṣati //
english: It will rain in no time.

sanskrit: manasaḥ kāma ity etāṃ paśukāmo naro japet / kardamena iti snāyātprajākāmaḥ śucivrataḥ //
english: A person who desires to have a cow should repeat the hymn manasaḥ kāma. One who desires to have progeny should bathe reciting the hymn kardamena, after becoming pure and practising vow.

sanskrit: aśvapūrvā iti snāyādrājyakāmastu mānavaḥ /
english: A man who wants to acquire kingdom should bathe with the repetition of the hymn aśvapūrvāṃ.

sanskrit: rāhite carmaṇi snāyāt brāhmaṇastu yathāvidhi //
english: A brahmin should bathe standing on a deerskin as laid down.

sanskrit: rājā carmaṇi vaiyāghre chāge vaiśyastathaiva ca /
english: A king should bathe standing on a tigerskin and a man of the merchant class on a goat skin in the same way.

sanskrit: daśasāhasriko homaḥ pratyekaṃ parikīrtitaḥ //
english: It has been declared that ten thousand oblations should be done in each case.

sanskrit: āgāra iti sūktena goṣṭhe gāṃ lokamātaraṃ / upatiṣṭhedvrajeccaiva yadicchettāḥ sadākṣayāḥ //
english: If a person desires to have the herds of cattle always undiminshing in his cowpen, he should worship the cow, the mother of the worlds, in the cowpen with the recitation of the hymn āgāvo.

sanskrit: upetitisṛbhīrājño dundubhimabhimantrayet /
english: A king should consecrate the royal drum with the three hymns beginning with upa.

sanskrit: tejo bakañca prāpnoti śatruñcaiva niyacchati //
english: By this he will get radiance and strength and rout the enemy.

sanskrit: tṛṇapāṇirjapetsūktuṃ rakṣoghnaṃ dasyunbhirvṛtaḥ /
english: One who is surrounded by the demons should repeat the hymn rakṣoghnam holding grass in the hand.

sanskrit: ye ke ca umetyṛcaṃ japtvā dīrghamāyurāpnuyāt //
english: By repeating the hymn ye ke ca jama one will gain long life.

sanskrit: jīmūtasūktena tathā senāṅgānyabhimantrayet /
english: One should consecrate the constituents of his army by the hymn jīmūta first like a liṅga.

sanskrit: yadhā liṅgaṃ tato rājā vinihanti raṇe ripūn //
english: Then the king will destroy the enemies in the battle.

sanskrit: āgneyeti tribhiḥsūktair dhanamāpnoti cākṣayaṃ /
english: One will gain undiminishing wealth by the recitation of the three hymns beginning with āgneya.

sanskrit: amīvaheti sūktena bhūtāni sthāpayenniśi //
english: One may fix goblins by the repetition of the hymn amīvaha in the night.

sanskrit: sabādhe viṣame durge bandhā vā nirgataḥ kvacit / palāyan vā gṛhīto vā sūktametattathā japet //
english: One should repeat this hymn in danger, difficulty, when caught in a fort, taken as a prisoner, while setting out some time, while running away, or when held as a captive.

sanskrit: trirātraṃ niyatopoṣya śrāpayet pāyasañcaruṃ / tenāhutiśataṃ pūrṇaṃ juhuyāt tryambaketyṛcā //
english: a One should fast for three nights with selfcontrol, boil sweat gruel and cast one hundred oblations with that with the repetition of the hymn tryambaka in honour of Lord Śiva.

sanskrit: samuddiśya mahādevaṃ jīvedabdaśataṃ sukhaṃ /
english: One will thus live happily for hundred years.

sanskrit: taccakṣurityṛcā snāta upatiṣṭheddivākaraṃ // udyantaṃ madhyagañcaiva dīrghamāyurjijīviṣuḥ /
english: One should worship the rising Sun and the Sun at the middle of the day after bathing and with the hymn taccakṣuḥ if one desires to have long life.

sanskrit: indrā someti sūktantu kathitaṃ śatrunāśanaṃ //
english: The hymn called indrā soma, when repeated, is said to destroy the enemy.

sanskrit: yasya luptaṃ vrataṃ mohādvrātyair vā saṃsṛjetsaha / upoṣyājyaṃ sa juhuyāttvamagne vratapā iti //
english: A person who has lost his vow by mistake or on account of association with the vrātyas, should fast and offer oblation with clarified butter with the recitation of the hymn tvamagne vratapā.

sanskrit: ādityetyṛk ca samrājaṃ japtvā vāde jayī bhavet /
english: A person who repeats the hymn āditya and samrāja will get victory in debate.

sanskrit: mahīti ca catuṣkeṇa mucyate mahato bhayāt //
english: One will become free from great fear by the repetition of the four hymns beginning with mahī.

sanskrit: ṛcaṃ mahīti japtvā yadi hy etat sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt /
english: One will get all the pleasures by the repetition of the hymn yadi hyetat.

sanskrit: dvācatvāriṃśatiṃ caindraṃ japtvā nāśayate ripūn //
english: One will destroy his enemies by the repetition of the fortytwo aindra hymns.

sanskrit: vācaṃ mahīti japtvā ca prāpnotyārogyameva ca /
english: One gets good health by repeating the hymn vācāmahī.

sanskrit: śanno bhaveti dvābhyāntu bhuktvānnaṃ prayataḥ śuciḥ // hṛdayaṃ pāṇinā spṛṣṭvā vyādhibhir nābhibhūyate /
english: A person who eats food repeating the two hymns śanno bhava after becoming clean and controlling the senses and touches the heart with the hand will not be attacked by diseases.

sanskrit: uttamedamiti snāto huttvā śatruṃ pramāpayet // śannogna iti sūktena hutenānnamavāpnuyāt /
english: One will destroy the enemy by offering oblations with the hymns uttamedaṃ after bathing. One will get food by making oblation with the hymn śannognir.

sanskrit: kanyā vārarṣisūktena digdoṣādvipramucyate //
english: One will get free from the defects of the quarters on journey by repeating the hymn kanyāvārarṣi.

sanskrit: yadatya kavyetyudite japte 'vaśyaṃ jagadbhavet /
english: One is able to subjugate the whole universe by the repetition of the hymn yadetya kavyaś at sun rise.

sanskrit: yadvāgiti ca japtena vāṇī bhavati saṃskṛtā // vāco viditamiti tvetāṃ japan vācaṃ samaśnute /
english: One’s speech gets refined by the repetition of the hymn yadvāk. One gill get good speech by repeating the hymn vāco vidaṃ.

sanskrit: pavitrāṇāṃ pavitrantu pāvamānyetyṛco matāḥ //
english: The pāvamāny hymns are considered to be most sacred.

sanskrit: vaikhānasā ṛcastriṃśatpavitrāḥ paramā matāḥ /
english: The thirty vaikhānasa hymns are considered to be extremely sacred.

sanskrit: ṛco dviṣaṣṭiḥ proktāś ca parasvetyṛṣisattama //
english: O Foremost among the sages! the parasva hymns are said to be sixtytwo.

sanskrit: sarvakalmaṣanāśāya pāvanāya śivāya ca / svādiṣṭayetisūktānāṃ saptaṣaṣṭirudāhṛtā //
english: The sixtyseven hymnssvādiṣṭayāare declared as destroyers of all sins, purifiers and conferrers of welfare.

sanskrit: daśottarāṇyṛcāñcaitāḥ pāvamānyaḥ śatāni ṣaṭ / etajjapaṃś ca juhvacca ghoraṃ mṛtyubhayaṃ jayet // āpohiṣṭeti vāristho japetpāpabhayārdane /
english: The six hundred and ten hymns of pāvamānya when repeated and used for making oblations will enable one to conquer the dread of death. One should repeat the hymns āpo hiṣṭha while standing in the water to destroy the fear of sin.

sanskrit: pradevanneti niyato japecca marudhanvasu //
english: A man passing through a desert should repeat the hymn pradevanna after the control of senses.

sanskrit: prāṇāntike bhaye prāpte kṣipramāyustu vindati /
english: When one is haunted by the fear of death, one will get the end of his life quickly.

sanskrit: prāveyāmityṛcamekāṃ japecca manasā niśi //
english: One should repeat the single hymn prāveyābhi mentally in the night.

sanskrit: vyuṣṭāyāmudite sūrye dyūte jayamavāpnuyāt /
english: If it is repeated at dawn or at sunrise one will get victory in gambling.

sanskrit: mā pragāmeti mūḍhaś ca panthānaṃ pathi vindati //
english: One who has lost his way will find his way by repeating the hymn mā pragāma. la.

sanskrit: yatteyamiti tu snātastasya mūrdhānamālabhet // sahasrakṛtvaḥ pañcāhaṃ tenāyurvindate mahat /
english: If one thinks that the life of a friend of himself is running out, he should bathe and touch the head of the friend reciting the hymn yatteyam thousand times for five days.

sanskrit: idaṃ medhyeti juhuyāt ghṛtaṃ prājñaḥ sahasraśaḥ //
english: A wise man should offer a thousand oblations with ghee with the repetition of the hymn idam medhya.

sanskrit: paśukāmo gavāṃ goṣṭhe arthakāmaś catuṣpathe /
english: One who desires to have cattle should do it at the cowpen and one who desires riches, at the crossroads.

sanskrit: vayaḥ suparṇa ity etāṃ japan vai vindate śriyaṃ //
english: One who repeats the hymn vayaḥ suparṇā will acquire wealth.

sanskrit: haviṣyantīyamabhyasya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate /
english: One will become free from all sins by the repetition of the hymn haviṣyantīyam.

sanskrit: tasya rogā vinaśyanti kāyāgnirvardhate tathā //
english: His diseases will get cured and the digestive power increased.

sanskrit: yā oṣadhayaḥ svastyayanaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanaṃ /
english: The hymn yā oṣadhayaḥ when repeated is a means of securing prosperity and curing all the diseases.

sanskrit: vṛhaspate atītyetadvṛṣṭikāmaḥ prayojayet //
english: One who wishes to have rain should employ the hymn bṛhaspate ati.

sanskrit: sarvatreti parā śāntirjñeyā pratirathas tathā /
english: The hymns sarvatra and pratiratha are known to confer supreme peace.

sanskrit: sūta sāṃkāśyapannityaṃ prajākāmasya kīrtitaṃ //
english: The recitation of the hymn sūta saṅkāśyapaṃ daily is commended for a person desirous to have progeny.

sanskrit: ahaṃ rudreti etadvāgmī bhavati mānavaḥ /
english: A person who recites the hymn ahaṃ rudra becomes an eloquent speaker.

sanskrit: na yonau jāyate vidvān japanrātrīti rātriṣu //
english: The learned person who recites the hymn rāti in the nights is not born again.

sanskrit: rātrisūktaṃ japannrātrī rātriṃ kṣemī jayennaraḥ /
english: The person who recites the rātrisūkta in the night spends the night safely.

sanskrit: kalpayantīti ca japannityaṃ kṛttvārināśanaṃ //
english: By doing the recitation of the hymn kalpayantī daily one will be able to destroy the enemies.

sanskrit: āyuṣyañcaiva varcasyaṃ sūktaṃ dākṣāyaṇaṃ mahat /
english: The recitation of the great Dākṣāyaṇa hymn confers longevity and radiance.

sanskrit: uta devā iti japedāmayaghnaṃ dhṛtavrataḥ //
english: A person who has undertaken a vow should recite the hymn uta devā, that will destroy the diseases.

sanskrit: ayamagne janityetajjapedagnibhaye sati /
english: When there is fear from fire, one should recite the hymn ayamagne janī.

sanskrit: araṇyānītyaraṇyeṣu japettadbhayanāśanaṃ //
english: One should repeat the hymn araṇyānī in the forests to destroy the fear therein.

sanskrit: brāhmnīmāsādya sūkte dve ṛcaṃ brāhmīṃ śatāvarīṃ / pṛthagadbhirghṛtair vātha medhāṃ lakṣmīñca vindati //
english: One who recites the two hymns with devotion to goddess Brāhmi the goddess of speech and makes use of brāhmī and śatāvarī the two herbs together with water or ghee separately will gain intelligence and wealth.

sanskrit: māsa ity asapatnaghnaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ vijigīṣataḥ /
english: One who desires to conquer his enemy in the battle should recite the hymn māsa.

sanskrit: brahmaṇo 'gniḥ saṃvidānaṃ garbhamṛtyunivāraṇaṃ //
english: The repetition of the hymn brahmaṇogniḥ saṃvidānaṃ prevents the death of the child in the womb.

sanskrit: apahīti japetsūktaṃ śucirdusvapnanāśanaṃ /
english: After getting pure one should recite the hymn apaihi, that destroys the effects of bad dreams.

sanskrit: yenedamiti vaijaptvā samādhiṃ vindate paraṃ //
english: One gains supreme concentration by the repetition of the hymn yenedaṃ.

sanskrit: mayo bhūrvāta ity etat gavāṃ svastyayanaṃ paraṃ /
english: The recitation of the hymn mayo bhūrvāto is an excellent means of securing the welfare of the cattle.

sanskrit: śāmbarīmindrajālaṃ vā māyāmetena vārayet //
english: One will ward off sorcery or jugglery by the repetition of this hymn.

sanskrit: mahītrīṇāmavarostviti pathi svastyayanaṃ japet /
english: One should repeat the hymn mahī trīṇāmavarostu for securing one’s welfare on his journey.

sanskrit: agnaye vidviṣannevaṃ japecca ripunāśanaṃ //
english: One should repeat the hymn agnaye vidviṣan, which will destroy the enemies.

sanskrit: vāstoṣpatena mantreṇa yajeta gṛhadevatāḥ /
english: The presiding deities of the houses should be worshipped with the hymn vāstoṣpate.

sanskrit: japasyaiṣa vidhiḥ prokto hute jñeyo viśeṣataḥ //
english: The procedure relating to the repetition has been told. That relating to the oblation has to be known as different.

sanskrit: homānte dakṣiṇā deyā pāpaśāntirhutena tu / hutaṃ śāmyati cānnena annahemapradānataḥ //
english: The prescribed fee has to be paid at the end of the oblation. There will be expiation of the sin by offering an oblation. The oblation done with food appeases by the offer of food and gold as gift.

sanskrit: viprāśiṣastvamoghāḥ syurbahiḥsnānantu sarvataḥ /
english: The blessings of brahmins will be unfailing. One should bathe outside in every case.

sanskrit: siddhārthakā yavā dhānyaṃ payo ghṛtaṃ tathā //
english: The same as in footnote above. ṚV. .0. ṚV. ...

sanskrit: kṣīravṛkṣāstathedhmantu homā vai sarvakāmadāḥ /
english: haviṣmatīr imā āpaḥ Taitt. Sam. ...a. MS. ..a ..

sanskrit: samidhaḥ kaṇṭhakinyaś ca rājikā rudhiraṃ viṣaṃ //
english: ahaṃ rudrebhir ṚV. ..la. Cf. rātriḥ ketunā Vaj. Sam.

sanskrit: abhicāre tathā śailaṃ aśanaṃ śaktavaḥ payaḥ /
english: Could not be traced. MS. ..a ., Cf. ayam agne jaritā ṚV.

sanskrit: dadhi bhaikṣyaṃ phalaṃ mūlamṛgvidhānamudāhṛtaṃ //
english: The flour of barley first fried and then ground.

sanskrit: yajurvidhānaṃ vakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu /
english: shall describe the use of the hymns of Yajur veda , that yield enjoyment and emancipation.

sanskrit: oṃkārapūrvikā rāma mahāvyāhṛtayo matāḥ //
english: Listen to me O Rāma The great vyāhṛtis are considered to be preceded by the syllable oṃ.

sanskrit: sarvakalmaṣanāśinyaḥ sarvakāmapradās tathā /
english: They destroy all sins and yield all pleasures.

sanskrit: ājyāhutisahasreṇa devānārādhayedbudhaḥ //
english: A wise man should worship the gods with thousand oblations of clarified butter.

sanskrit: manasaḥ kāṅkṣitaṃ rāma manasepsitakāmadaṃ /
english: O Rāma This confers the desired pleasures.

sanskrit: śāntikāmo yavaiḥ kuryāttilaiḥ pāpāpanuttaye // dhānyaiḥ siddhārthakaiś caiva sarvakāma karais tathā /
english: One who desires peace should offer oblation with barley. One should offer with sesamum for the destruction of sin. One should offer oblation with grains and white mustard that will confer all the pleasures.

sanskrit: audumbarībhiridhmābhiḥ pasukāmasya śasyate // dadhnā caivānnakāmasya payasā śāntimicchataḥ /
english: Offering oblations with the twigs of udumbara tree is commended for one who desires cattle. One who desires food should offer oblation with curd and one who desires peace should with milk.

sanskrit: apāmārgasamiddhastu kāmayan kanakaṃ bahu //
english: One who desires plenty of gold should offer oblation with the twigs of apāmārga.

sanskrit: kanyākāmo ghṛtāktāni yugmaśo grathitāni tu / jātīpuṣpāṇi juhuyādgrāmārthī tilataṇḍulān //
english: One who seeks a maiden should offer oblation of jāti flowers that have been strung together in pairs and soaked in ghee. One who desires to have governorship over a village should offer oblations of sesamum and rice.

sanskrit: vaśyakarmaṇi śākhoḍhavāsāpāmārgameva ca /
english: The oblations of the twigs of śākhoṭa, vāsā and apāmārga trees are commended for bringing others under control.

sanskrit: viṣāsṛṅmiśrasamidho vyādhighātasya bhārgava // kruddhastu juhuyātsamyak śatrūṇāṃ badhakāmyayā /
english: O Son of Bhṛgu Paraśurāma oblation of twigs mixed with poison and blood should be made for causing the death of one after becoming sick. One who is angry should act perfectly in the above manner in order to kill his enemies.

sanskrit: sarvavrīhimayīṃ kṛtvā rājñaḥ pratikṛtiṃ dvija // sahasraśastu juhuyādrājā vaśagato bhavet /
english: O Brahmin After having made an image of the king made up of rice one should offer a thousand oblations. The king will thus be subjected to one’s control.

sanskrit: vastrakāmasya puṣpāṇi darvā vyādhivināśinī //
english: Flowers are to be used by one who desires clothes. The offering of dūrvā grass destroys disease.

sanskrit: brahmavarcasakāmasya vāsograñca vidhīyate /
english: It is laid down that strong scents should be used by one who desires to gain the splendour of a realised soul.

sanskrit: pratyaṅgireṣu juhuyāttuṣakaṇṭakabhasmabhiḥ // vidveṣaṇe ca pakṣmāṇi kākakauśikayos tathā /
english: Oblation should be offered with the ash of husk and thorns in retaliatory enchantments. In incantation to cause animosity, the wings of a crow and owl should be offered.

sanskrit: kāpilañca ghṛtaṃ hutvā tathā candragrahe dvija // vacācūrṇena sampātātsamānīya ca tāṃ vacāṃ / sahasramantritāṃ bhuktvā medhāvī jāyate naraḥ //
english: O Brahmin! One should offer the ghee of a black cow to fire at the time of the lunar eclipse and partake of it after having mixed it with the residue of powdered vacā a kind of aromatic root after incantation a thousand times. This will make him intelligent.

sanskrit: ekādaśāṅgulaṃ śaṅku lauhaṃ khādirameva ca / dviṣato badhosīti japannikhanedripuveśmani //
english: A peg of eleven inches made of iron or khadira tree should be buried in the house of the enemy after repeating the hymn dviṣato vadhosi.

sanskrit: uccāṭanamidaṃ karma śatrūṇāṃ kathitaṃ tava /
english: This act of magical incantation for the destruction of the enemy has been narrated to you.

sanskrit: cakṣuṣyā iti japtvā ca vinaṣṭañcakṣurāpnuyāt //
english: By the recitation of the hymn cakṣuṣyā one will get back lost eyesight.

sanskrit: upayuñjata ity edanuvākantathānnadaṃ /
english: The repetition of the section of the hymn beginning with upayuñjata will procure food.

sanskrit: tanūnapāgne saditi dūrvāṃ hutvārtivarjitaḥ //
english: One will be free from difficulties by offering oblation of dūrvā grass with the recitation of the hymn tanūnapāgne sat.

sanskrit: bheṣajamasīti dadhyājyair homaḥ paśūpasarganut /
english: Oblation made with curd and clarified butter with the recitation of the hymn bheṣajamasi will cure the sickness of domestic animals.

sanskrit: tryamvakaṃ yajāmahe homaḥ saubhāgyavardhanaḥ //
english: Oblation made with the recitation of the hymn tryambakaṃ yajāmahe will increase one’s fortune.

sanskrit: kanyānāma gṛhītvā tu kanyalābhakaraḥ paraḥ / bhayeṣu tu japannityaṃ bhayebhyo vipramucyate //
english: One who makes an oblation with this hymn pronouncing the name of a maiden, will secure that maiden. One who repeats this hymn daily when he is stricken with fear, will get free from fears.

sanskrit: dhustūrapuṣpaṃ saghṛtaṃ hutvā syāt sarvakāmabhāk /
english: By making an oblation with the dhuttūra flower along with ghee repeating this hymn, one will get all the pleasures.

sanskrit: hutvā tu guggulaṃ rāma svapne paśyati śaṅkaraṃ //
english: O Rāma! One who makes an oblation with guggulu a fragrant gum resin with the recitation of the hymn will see Śaṅkara Śiva in the dream.

sanskrit: yuñjate mano 'nuvākaṃ japtvā dīrghāyurāpnuyāt /
english: One will get long life by repeating the section yuñjate mana.

sanskrit: viṣṇoravāṭamityetat sarvabādhāvināśanaṃ //
english: The repetition of the hymn viṣṇorarāṭaṃ destroys all the obstacles.

sanskrit: rakṣoghnañca yaśasyañca tathaiva vijayapradaṃ /
english: It is capable of destroying demons. It also confers victory.

sanskrit: ayatno agnirityetat saṃgrāme vijayapradaṃ //
english: The repetition of the hymn ayaṃ no agniḥ yields victory in battle.

sanskrit: idamāpaḥ pravahata snāne pāpāpanodanaṃ /
english: The hymn idamāpaḥ pravahata when repeated while bathing is capable of destroying sins.

sanskrit: viśvakarmannu haviṣā sūcīṃ lauhīndaśāṅgulām // kanyāyā nikhaneddvāri sānyasmai na pradīyate /
english: If one buries an iron nail of ten inches length at the threshold of the house of a maiden with the repetition of the hymn viśvakarmannu havis she will not be given in marriage to somebody else.

sanskrit: deva savitaretena juhuyādbalakāmo dvijottama //
english: One who makes an oblation with the repetition of the hymn devasavitaḥ will get food.

sanskrit: agnau svāheti juhuyādbalakāmo dvijottama / tilair yavaiś ca dharmajña tathāpāmārgataṇḍulaiḥ //
english: O Knower of virtue! The excellent brahmin who desires strength should do oblation with sesamum, barley, rice and twigs of apāmārga with the recitation of agnau svāhā oblations to fire.

sanskrit: sahasramantritāṃ kṛtvā tathā gorocanāṃ dvija / tilakañca tathā kṛtvā janasya priyatāmiyāt //
english: O Brahmin! One will win the affection of the people by making a mark on the forehead with gorocanā yellow pigment got from the belly of cow after having made the incantation of the sacred syllable a thousand times.

sanskrit: rudrāṇāñca tathā japyaṃ sarvāghavinisūdanaṃ /
english: The repetition of the Rudra hymns is capable of destroying all the sins.

sanskrit: sarvakarmakaro homas tathā sarvatra śantidaḥ //
english: The oblation made with that hymn accomplishes all tasks and ensures peace everywhere.

sanskrit: ajāvikānāmaśvānāṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ tathā gavāṃ / manuṣyāṇānnarendrāṇāṃ bālānāṃ yoṣitāmapi // grāmāṇāṃ nagarānāñca deśānāmapi bhārgava / upadrutānāṃ dharmajña vyādhitānāṃ tathaiva ca //
english: O Bhārgava! Knower of virtue! when the goats, sheep, horses, elephants, cows, men, kings, children, women, villages, cities and countries are being attacked or afflicted by diseases, when there is the outbreak of plague and there is fear from the enemies, then the offering of oblation with Rudra hymns with sweet porridge and ghee will confer supreme peace.

sanskrit: rudrahomaḥ parā śāntiḥ pāyasena ghṛtena ca // kuṣmāṇḍaghṛtahomena sarvān pāpān vyapohati /
english: One gets free from all sins by offering oblation with pumpkin and ghee with the Rudra hymns.

sanskrit: śaktuyāvakabhaikṣāśī naktaṃ manujasattama // bahiḥsnānarato māsānmucyate brahmahatyayā /
english: Excellent man! One gets free from the sin of killing a brahmin by eating the flour of barley, barley or alms in the night and bathing for a month outside.

sanskrit: madhuvāteti mantreṇa homādito 'khilaṃ labhet //
english: One will get everything by offering oblation with the repetition of the hymn madhuvātā.

sanskrit: dadhi krāvneti hutvā tu putrān prāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ / tathā ghṛtavatītyetadāyuṣyaṃ syāt ghṛtena tu //
english: One will certainly get children by offering oblation with the recitation of the hymn dadhikrāvṇa. Similarly oblation made with ghee with the recitation of the hymn ghṛtavatī will give life.

sanskrit: svastina indra ity etatsarvabādhāvināśanaṃ / iha gāvaḥ prajyāyadhvamiti puṣṭivivardhanam //
english: The recitation of the hymn svasti na indra would destroy all difficulties and the hymn iha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvaṃ would increase the strength.

sanskrit: ghṛtāhutisahasreṇa tathā lakṣmīvināśanaṃ /
english: A thousand oblations made with ghee with this hymn will ward off illluck.

sanskrit: śruveṇa devasya tveti hutvāpāmārgataṇḍulaṃ // mucyate vikṛtācchīghramabhicārānna saṃśayaḥ /
english: Oblations made with the twigs of apāmārga and rice with the recitation of the hymn sruveṇa devasya tvā will without any doubt free one quickly from the deformities inflicted by incantation.

sanskrit: rudra pātu palaśasya samidbhiḥ kanakaṃ labhet //
english: One would get gold by oblations with the twigs of palāśa with the hymn rudra pātu Rudra protect.

sanskrit: śivo bhavetyagnyutpāte vrīhibhirjuhuyānnaraḥ / yāḥ senā iti caitacca taskarebhyo bhayāpaham //
english: One should offer oblations with rice with the recitation of the hymn śivo bhava The repetition of the hymn yāḥ senā removes the fear of thieves.

sanskrit: yo asmabhyamavātīyāddhutvā kṛṣṇatilānnaraḥ / sahasraśo 'bhicārācca mucyate vikṛtāddvija //
english: O Brahmin! One who makes a thousand oblations with black sesamum with the recitation of the hymn yo asmabhyamayātīyāt will become free from deformities caused by incantation.

sanskrit: annenānnapatetyevaṃ hutvā cānnamavāpnuyāt / haṃsaḥ śuciḥ sadityetajjaptantoye 'ghanāśanaṃ //
english: One will get food by offering an oblation of food with the recitation of the hymn annapate The repetition of the hymn haṃsaḥ śuciṣad while remaining in the water destroys sins.

sanskrit: catvāri bhaṅgetyetattu sarvapāpaharaṃ jale /
english: The repetition of the hymn catvāri śṛṅgāḥ while remaining in the water will remove all sins.

sanskrit: devā yajñeti japtvā tu brahmaloke mahīyate //
english: By the repetition of the hymn devā yajña one will be respected in the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit: vasanteti ca hutvājyaṃ ādityādvaramāpnuyāt /
english: One will obtain the favour of the Sun by offering oblation with clarified butter with the repetition of the hymn vasanta.

sanskrit: suparṇosīti cetyasya karmavyāhṛtivadbhavet //
english: The rites relating to the use of the hymn suparṇosi are the same as for the seven vyāhṛtis.

sanskrit: namaḥ svāheti trirjaptvā bandhanānmokṣamāpnuyāt /
english: One will get released from bondage by repeating namaḥ svāhā three times.

sanskrit: antarjale trirāvartya drupadā sarvapāpamuk //
english: By repeating the hymn drupadā three times while remaining in the water will destroy all sins.

sanskrit: iha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvaṃ mantroyaṃ buddhivardhanaḥ / hutantu sarpiṣā dadhnā payasā pāyasena vā //
english: The sacred formula iha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvaṃ is capable of sharpening the intellect when oblations are offered with clarified butter, curd, milk and sweet porridge.

sanskrit: śatam ya iti caitena hutvā parṇaphalāṇi ca / ārogyaṃ śriyamāpnoti jīvitañca cirantathā //
english: Oblations made with leaves and fruits with the recitation of the hymn śataṃ yo confers health, wealth and long life.

sanskrit: oṣadhīḥ pratimodagdhvaṃ vapane lavane 'rthakṛt / aśvāvatī pāyasena homācchāntimavāpnuyāt //
english: The recitation of the hymn oṣadhīḥ pratimodadhvaṃ while mowing and cutting will give returns. Oblations made with sweet porridge with the repetition of the hymn aśvāvat will secure peace.

sanskrit: tasmā iti ca mantrena bandhanastho vimucyate /
english: One will be released from bondage by the repetition of the sacred formula tasmā.

sanskrit: yuvā suvāsā ity eva vāsāṃsyāpnoti cottamam //
english: One will get excellent dress by repeating the hymn yuvā suvāsāḥ.

sanskrit: muñcantu mā śapathyāni sarvāntakavināśanam /
english: The recitation of the hymn muñcantu mā śapathyāt is capable of destroying all the enemies.

sanskrit: mā māhiṃsīstilājyena hutaṃ ripuvināśanaṃ //
english: Oblation of sesamum while reciting the hymn mā mā hiṃsīḥ is capable of destroying enemies.

sanskrit: namo 'stu sarvasarpebhyo ghṛtena pāyasena tu / kṛṇudhavaṃ rāja ity etadabhicāravināśanaṃ //
english: Oblations of ghee and sweet porridge with the repetition of the hymns namostu sarvasarpebhyo and kṛṇudhvaṃ rāja destroys magic incantations.

sanskrit: dūrvākāṇḍāyutaṃ hutvā kāṇḍāt kāṇḍeti mānavaḥ / grāme janapade vāpi marakantu śamannayet //
english: One can control an epidemic in a village or country by making ten thousand oblations of pieces of dūrvā grass with the recitation of the hymn kāṇḍāt kāṇḍāt.

sanskrit: rogārto mucyate rogāt tathā duḥkhāttu duḥkhitaḥ /
english: One who is suffering from a disease will be cured and the griefstricken will become free from grief by this.

sanskrit: auḍumbarīś ca samidho madhumānno vanaspatiḥ // hutvā sahasraśo rāma dhanamāpnoti mānavaḥ /
english: O Rāma! A person who offers a thousand twigs of udumbara treeas oblation with the recitation of the hymn madhumānno vanaspatiḥ will get wealth.

sanskrit: saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti vyavahāre tathā trayam //
english: One will also get great fortune and victory in litigation.

sanskrit: apāṃ garbhamiti hutvā devaṃ varṣāpayeddhruvam / apaḥ piveti ca tathā hutvā dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu // pravartayati dharmajña mahāvṛṣṭimanantaraṃ /
english: One will make the gods rain by offering oblations of the same with the recitation of the hymn apāṃ garbhaṃ. O Knower of virtue! By making oblations of curd, ghee and honey with the repetition of the hymn apaḥ pinva one will make it rain heavily.

sanskrit: namaste rudra ity etat sarvopadravanāśanaṃ //
english: The repetition of the hymn namaste rudra destroys all misfortunes.

sanskrit: sarvaśāntikaraṃ proktaṃ mahāpātakanāśanaṃ /
english: The above hymn is also said to ensure all peace and destroy great sins.

sanskrit: adhyavocadityanena rakṣaṇaṃ vyādhitasya tu // rakṣoghnañca yaśasyañca cirāyuḥpuṣṭivardhanam /
english: One who is afflicted by a disease is protected by the repetition of the hymn adhyavocat. It is also capable of destroying demons, increasing fame, long life and strength.

sanskrit: siddhārthakānāṃ kṣepeṇa pathi caitajjapan sukhī //
english: One will be happy by scattering white mustard and repeating this hymn on the journey.

sanskrit: upatiṣṭheta dharmajña sāyaṃ prātaratandritaḥ // annamakṣayamāpnoti dīrghamāyuś ca vindati /
english: O Knower of virtue! One will get long life and undiminishing food by worshipping daily the sun morning and evening unweariedly repeating the hymn asau yastāmro.

sanskrit: pramuñca dhanvannityetat ṣaḍbhirāyudhamantraṇaṃ //
english: Weapons are consecrated by the six hymns pramuñca dhanvanas.

sanskrit: ripūṇāṃ bhayadaṃ yuddhenātrakāryā vicāraṇā /
english: It will frighten enemies in battle. One need not entertain any doubt.

sanskrit: māno mahānta ity evaṃ bālānāṃ śāntikārakaṃ //
english: The repetition of the hymn māno mahāntaṃ confers peace on children.

sanskrit: namo hiraṇyavāhave ity anuvākasaptakam / rājikāṃ kaṭutailāktāṃ juhuyācchatrunāśanīṃ //
english: One should offer oblations of black mustard soaked in pungent oil with the repetition of the seven sections beginning with namo hiraṇyabāhave that will destroy enemies.

sanskrit: namo vaḥ kirikebhyaś ca padmalakṣāhutair naraḥ / rājyalakṣmīmavāpnoti tathā bilvaiḥ suvarṇakam //
english: One becomes a sovereign by offering oblations of a lakh lotuses with the recitation of the hymn namo vaḥ kirikebhyo. By similar offerings of bilva leaves one will acquire gold.

sanskrit: imā rudrāyeti tilair homācca dhanamāpyate /
english: One will obtain wealth by oblations of sesamum with the repetition of imā rudrāya.

sanskrit: dūrvāhomena cānyena sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ //
english: Oblations with dūrvā grass will make one free from all diseases.

sanskrit: āśuḥ śiśāna ity etadāyudhānāñca rakṣaṇe /
english: The hymn āśuḥ śiśāna is used in the protection of weapons.

sanskrit: saṃgrāme kathitaṃ rāma sarvaśatrunivarhaṇaṃ //
english: O Rāma! It is said to destroy all the enemies in battle.

sanskrit: rājasāmeti juhuyāt sahasraṃ pañcabhirdvija / ājyāhutīnāṃ dharmajña cakṣūrogādvimucyate //
english: O Brahmin! Knower of virtue! One thousand oblations of clarified butter with the repetition of the five hymns rāja sāma will cure the eye disease of a person.

sanskrit: śanno vanaspate gehe homaḥ syādvāstudoṣanut /
english: The oblation done with the hymn śanno vanaspate gehe will destroy the defects of a building.

sanskrit: agna āyūṃsi hutvājyaṃ dveṣaṃ nāpnoti kenacit //
english: One will not earn enmity with anyone by offering oblations of clarified butter with the repetition of agna āyūṃṣi.

sanskrit: apāṃ pheneti lājābhirhutvā jayamavāpnuyāt /
english: One will gain victory by the oblation of fried paddy with the hymn apāṃ phena.

sanskrit: bhadrā itīndriyair hīno japan syāt sakalendriyaḥ //
english: He who has defective senseorgans will get sound ones by the repetition of the hymn bhadrā.

sanskrit: agniś ca pṛthivī ceti vaśīkaraṇamuttamam /
english: The hymn agniśca pṛthivī ca is an excellent charm.

sanskrit: adhvaneti japan mantraṃ vyavahāre jayī bhavet //
english: One who repeats the hymn adhvana will be victorious in litigation.

sanskrit: brahma rājanyamiti ca karmārambhe tu siddhikṛt /
english: The hymn brahma rājanyaṃ accomplishes the task when repeated at its commencement.

sanskrit: saṃvatsarosīti dhṛtair lakṣahomādarogavān //
english: One will be free from disease by the oblation of ghee a lakh times with the repetition of the hymn saṃvatsarosi.

sanskrit: ketuṃ kṛṇvannitītyetat saṃgrāme jayavardhanam /
english: The hymn ketuṃ kṛṇvan will confer victory in battle.

sanskrit: indrognirdharma ity etadraṇe dharmanibandhanam //
english: The hymn indrognirdharma ensures fair play in battle.

sanskrit: dhanvā nāgeti mantraś ca dhanurgrāhanikaḥ paraḥ /
english: The hymn dhanvanā gā is excellent for the bow wielder.

sanskrit: yajīteti tathā mantro vijñeyo hy abhimantraṇe //
english: The hymn yuñjīta is known to be used in consecrating the bow.

sanskrit: mantraścāhirathetyetaccharāṇāṃ mantraṇe bhavet / vahnīnāṃ pitarityetattūrṇamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ //
english: The hymn āhiratha should be used for the consecration of arrows. Bahvīnāṃ pitā is said to be the hymn for consecrating quiver.

sanskrit: yuñjantīti tathāśvānāṃ yojane mantra ucyate /
english: Yuñjantī is said to be the hymn for arranging horses.

sanskrit: āśuḥ śiśāna ity etadyatrārambhaṇamucyate //
english: The hymn āśuḥ śiśāna is said to be used while commencing a journey.

sanskrit: viṣṇoḥ krameti mantraś ca rathārohaṇikaḥ paraḥ /
english: The hymns viṣṇoḥ krama is said to be excellent for one who boards a chariot.

sanskrit: ājaṅghetīti cāśvānāṃ tāḍanīyamudāhṛtaṃ //
english: The hymn ājaṅghanti is said to be used for whipping the horses.

sanskrit: yāḥ senā abhitvarīti parasainyamukhe japet /
english: One should repeat the hymn yaḥ senā abhitvari when facing the army of the enemy.

sanskrit: dundubhya iti cāpyetaddundubhītāḍnaṃ bhavet //
english: The war drums are beaten with the recitation of the hymn dundubhya.

sanskrit: etaiḥ pūrvahutair mantraiḥ kṛtvaivaṃ vijayī bhavet /
english: One will become victorious by offering oblations earlier with these hymns.

sanskrit: yamena dattamityasya koṭihomādvicakṣaṇaḥ // rathamutpādayecchīghraṃ saṃgrāme vijayapradam /
english: A wise man who offers one crore oblations with the recitation of the hymn yamena dattam will soon produce a chariot that will give victory in the battle.

sanskrit: ā kṛṣṇeti tathaitasya karmavyāhṛtivadbhavet //
english: The ceremonies relating to the hymn ā kṛṣṇa are similar to that of the vyāhṛtis bhūḥ etc..

sanskrit: śivasaṃkalpajāpena samādhiṃ manaso labhet /
english: One will get the composure of mind by the repetition of the hymn of śivasaṅkalpa.

sanskrit: pañcanadyaḥ pañcalakṣaṃ hutvā lakṣmīmavāpnuyāt //
english: One will get fortune by making five lakh oblations with the repetition of the hymn pañcanadyaḥ.

sanskrit: yadā badhūndakṣāyaṇāṃ mantreṇānena mantritam / sahasrakṛtvaḥ kanakaṃ dhārayedripuvāraṇaṃ //
english: One should wear a golden plate after making incantations one thousand times with the hyymn yad ābadhnan dākṣāyaṇā.

sanskrit: imaṃ jīvebhya drati ca śilāṃ loṣṭrañcaturdiśaṃ / kṣipedgṛhe tadā tasya na syāccaurabhayaṃ niśi //
english: It will ward off the enemies. One will not have the fear of thieves by throwing stones and lumps of earth in all the four directions in the house after repeating the hymn imaṃ jīvebhyaḥ.

sanskrit: hantumabhyāgatastatra vaśībhavati mānavaḥ //
english: The hymn parī me gāmaneṣata is excellent for charming. One who has come to kill will be subdued.

sanskrit: bhakṣyatāmvūlapuṣpādyaṃ mantritantu prayacchati / yasya dharmajña vaśagaḥ somya śīghraṃ bhaviṣyati //
english: O Knower of Dharma! A person will be brought under one’s complete control soon by giving him food, betels, flowers and other things charmed with this hymn.

sanskrit: śanno mitra itītyetat sadā sarvatra śāntidaṃ /
english: The hymn śanno mitra always confers peace everywhere when repeated.

sanskrit: gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ kṛtvā homañcatuṣpathe // vaśīkuryājjagatsarvam sarvadhānyair asaṃśayam /
english: One will be able to charm the entire world by making oblations of all grains with the repetition of the hymn gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ at the junction of four roads.

sanskrit: hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayo mantroyamabhiṣecane //
english: The hymn hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ is used in consecration.

sanskrit: śanno devīrabhiṣṭaye tathā śāntikaraḥ paraḥ /
english: The hymn śanno devīr abhiṣṭaye is excellent for conferring peace.

sanskrit: ekacakreti mantreṇa hutenājyena bhāgaśaḥ // grahebhyaḥ śāntimāpnoti prasādaṃ na ca saṃśayaḥ /
english: There is no doubt that one will appease the planets and get their grace by offering oblations of clarified butter in parts to the respective planets with the repetition of the hymn ekacakra.

sanskrit: gāvo bhaga iti dvābhyāṃ hutvājyaṅgā avāpnuyāt //
english: One who makes oblations of clarified butter with the two hymns gāvo bhago will get cows.

sanskrit: pravādāṃśaḥ sopaditi gṛhayajñe vidhīyate /
english: The hymn pravādāṃṣaḥ sopat is used in the propitiatory rite in the house.

sanskrit: devebhyo vanaspata iti drumayajñe vidhīyate //
english: The hymn devebhyo vanaspate is prescribed for use in the rite for the consecration of a tree.

sanskrit: gāyatrī vaiṣṇavī jñeyā tadviṣṇoḥ paramampadaṃ /
english: The hymn tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ is known to be the gāyatrī for Lord Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvakāmakarantathā //
english: It is capable of destroying all the sins and granting all the pleasures.

sanskrit: yujurvidhānaṅkathitaṃ vakṣye sāmnāṃ vidhānakaṃ /
english: Sam. .. Cf. cākṣuṣmatyāya svāhā TB. .0...

sanskrit: saṃhitāṃ vaiṣṇavīñjaptvā hutvā syāt sarvakāmabhāk //
english: One will get all the pleasures by repeating the vaiṣṇavī hymns.

sanskrit: saṃhitāñchāndasīṃ sādhu japtvā prīṇāti śaṅkaraṃ /
english: One pleases Lord Śaṅkara Śiva by repeating the chāndasī Sāman hymns well.

sanskrit: skandīṃ paitryāṃ saṃhitāñca japtvā syāttu prasādavān //
english: One will get the grace by repeating the skāndī and paitrī hymns.

sanskrit: yata indra bhajāmahe hiṃsādoṣavināśanaṃ /
english: The repetition of the hymn yata indra bhayāmahe is capable of destroying the harmful effects of incantations.

sanskrit: avakīrṇī mucyate ca agnistigmeti vai japan //
english: One who has broken the vow of continence will be released from the fault by repeating the hymn agnistigmena.

sanskrit: sarvapāpaharaṃ jñeyaṃ paritoyañca tāsu ca /
english: The repetition of the hymn paritoṣaṃ ca is known to be capable of destroying all sins.

sanskrit: avikreyañca vikrīya japedghṛtavatīti ca //
english: One who has sold a thing that should not be sold, should repeat the hymn ghṛtavatī.

sanskrit: ayāno deva saviturjñeyanduḥsvapnanāśanaṃ /
english: The hymn adyā no deva savitaḥ is known to be capable of destroying bad dreams.

sanskrit: abodhyagniritimantreṇa ghṛtaṃ rāma yathāvidhi // abhyukṣya ghṛtaśeṣeṇa mekhalābandha iṣyate / strīṇāṃ yāsāntu garbhāṇi patanti bhṛgusattama //
english: O Rāma! The foremost of Bhṛgus! It is laid down that the girdle may be tied with the remnant of the ghee that has been sprinkled with the hymn abodhyagniḥ as laid down, in the case of the women who have a miscarriage.

sanskrit: maṇiṃ jātasya bālasya vadhnīyāttadanantaraṃ / somaṃ rājānametena vyādhibhirvipramucyate //
english: Then it should be tied on the wrist of the child that is born, with the repetition of the hymn somaṃ rājānaṃ. This will make the child free from all diseases.

sanskrit: sarpasāma prayuñjīno nāpnuyāt sarpajambhayaṃ /
english: By the use of sarpasāma one will not have the fear of serpents.

sanskrit: mādya tvā vādyatetyetaddhutvā vipraḥ sahasraśaḥ // śatāvarimaṇibaddhvā nāpnuyācchastrato bhayaṃ /
english: A brahmin will not have any fear from weapons by tying the śatāvarī a herb after making a thousand oblations with the hymn mādya tvā vādyate.

sanskrit: dīrghatamasorka iti huttvānnaṃ prāpnuyādbahu //
english: One will get plenty of food by making oblation with the hymn dīrghatamasorka.

sanskrit: svamadhyāyantīti japanna mriyeta pipāsayā /
english: One who repeats the hymn samamadhyāyantī will not die of thirst.

sanskrit: tvamimā oṣadhī hy etajjaptvā vyādhiṃ na vāpnuyāt //
english: One will not get a disease by repeating the hymn tvamimā oṣadhīḥ.

sanskrit: pathi devavratañjaptvā bhayebhyo vipramucyate /
english: One will become free from fears by repeating the hymn devavrata on the journey.

sanskrit: yadindro munaye tveti hutaṃ saubhāgyavardhanaṃ //
english: Oblations offered with the hymn yadindro munaye tvā increase fortune.

sanskrit: bhago na citra ity evaṃ netrayo rañjanaṃ hitaṃ / saubhāgyavardhanaṃ rāma nātra kārya vicāraṇā //
english: O Rāma! Collyrium applied to the eyes with the hymn bhago na citra will increase fortune. There need be no doubt.

sanskrit: japendreti vargañca tathā saunbhāgyavardhanaṃ /
english: The repetition of the hymn indreti varga will also increase fortune.

sanskrit: pari priyā hi vaḥ kāriḥ kāmyāṃ saṃśrāvayet striyaṃ //
english: A man who seeks the love of a woman should make her listen to the hymn pari priyā divaḥ kaviḥ.

sanskrit: sā taṅkāmayate rāma nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
english: O Rāma! There need be no doubt that she will love him in return.

sanskrit: rathantaraṃ vāmadevyaṃ brahmavarcasavardhanaṃ //
english: The repetition of the hymns rathantara and vāmadevya increases the divine splendour.

sanskrit: prāśayedbālakaṃ nityaṃ vacācūrṇaṃ ghṛtaplutaṃ / indramidgāthinaṃ japtvā bhavecchrutidharastvasau //
english: A child should be fed with the powder of vacā soaked in ghee daily with the repetition of the hymn indramidgāthino. It will give him good memory.

sanskrit: hutvā rathantarañjaptvā putramāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ /
english: There is no doubt that one will get progeny after repeating the hymn rathantara and offering oblations.

sanskrit: mayi śrīriti mantroyaṃ japtavyaḥ śrīvivardhanaḥ //
english: The hymn mayi śrīḥ has to be repeated for the increase of fortune.

sanskrit: vairūpyasyāṣṭakaṃ nityaṃ prayuñjānaḥ śriyaṃ labhet /
english: The repetition of the eight vairūpya hymns daily confers fortune.

sanskrit: saptāṣṭakaṃ prayuñjānaḥ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt //
english: One will get all the desires fulfilled by repeating the saptāṣṭaka hymns.

sanskrit: gavyeṣuṇeti yo nityaṃ sāyaṃ prātaratantritaḥ / upasthānaṃ gavāṃ kuryāttasya syustāḥ sadā gṛhe //
english: One who worships cows daily morning and evening with the repetition of the hymn gavyoṣuṇo unweariedly will always have cows in his house.

sanskrit: ghṛtāktantu yavadroṇaṃ vāta āvātu bheṣajaṃ / anena vidhivat sarvāṃ māyāṃ vyapohati //
english: One who offers a droṇa a measure of barley soaked in ghee into fire with the repetition of the hymn, vāta āvātu bheṣajaṃ as laid down will ward off all spells.

sanskrit: pradevo dāsena tilān hutvā kārmaṇakṛntanaṃ /
english: Oblations of sesamum with the repetition of the hymn pra daivo dāso destroys witchcraft.

sanskrit: abhi tvā pūrvapītaye vaṣaṭkārasamanvitaṃ // vāsakedhmasahasrantu hutaṃ yuddhe jayapradaṃ /
english: Repeating the hymn abhi tvā pūrva pītaye followed by the syllable vaṣaṭ while offering oblations made with perfumed fuel will yield victory in battle.

sanskrit: hastyaśvapuruṣān kuryādbudhaḥ piṣṭamayān śubhān // parakīyānathoddeśya pradhānapuruṣāṃs tathā /
english: A wise man should make good figures of elephants, horses and men with flour and represent the chief men of the enemy with oily cakes of flour and cut them into pieces with a knife.

sanskrit: abhi tvā śūra ṇonumo mantreṇānena mantravit / kṛtvā sarṣapatailāktān krodhena juhuyāttataḥ // etat kṛtvā budhaḥ karma saṃgrāme jayamāpnuyāt /
english: Then the knower of the sacred formulas should offer oblations with these cakes soaked in mustard oil with wrath while reciting the hymn abhi tvā śūranonumaḥ. The wise man gets victory in battle by this act.

sanskrit: gāruḍaṃ vāmadevyañca rathantaravṛhadrathau //
english: The hymns gāruḍa, vāmadevya, rathantara and bṛhadratha are without any doubt said to destroy all sins.

sanskrit: sarvapāpapraśamanāḥ kathitāḥ saṃśayaṃ vinā //25//
english: .a .0a. Cf. Vedic Concordance p. b. Could not be traced.

sanskrit: sāmnāṃ vidhānaṃ kathitaṃ vakṣye cātharvaṇāmatha /
english: The application of the hymns of Sāma veda has been described. shall describe to you the application of the hymns of Atharva veda .

sanskrit: śāntātīyaṃ gaṇaṃ hutvā śāntimāpnoti mānavaḥ // bhaiṣajyañca gaṇaṃ hutvā sarvānrogān vyāpohati /
english: One gets peace by offering oblations with the hymns of the peace class. One will get rid of all the diseases by offering oblations to the gods of the remedial class.

sanskrit: trisaptīyaṃ gaṇaṃ hutvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
english: One will get free from all sins by offering oblations to the gods of the trisaptīya class.

sanskrit: kvacinnāpnoti ca bhayaṃ hutvā caivābhayaṅgaṇaṃ / na kvacijjāyate rāma gaṇaṃ hutvā parājitaṃ //
english: One will never get fear by offering oblations to the gods of the protection class. O Rāma! one will never be born by offering oblations to the gods of the aparājita unconquered class.

sanskrit: āyuṣyañca gaṇaṃ hutvā apamṛtyuṃ vyapohati /
english: One will ward off untimely death by offering oblations to the gods of the lifegiving class.

sanskrit: svastimāpnoti sarvatra hutvā svastyayanaṅgaṇaṃ // śreyasā yogamāpnoti śarmavarmagaṇantathā /
english: One will get welfare everywhere by offering oblations to the gods of the welfare class. One will get united with good fortune by propitiating the gods of happiness and armour group.

sanskrit: vāstoṣpatyagaṇaṃ hutvā vāstudoṣān vyapohati //
english: One will remove the defects of a building by offering oblations to the class of deities presiding over the foundations of a house.

sanskrit: tathā raudragaṇaṃ hutvā sarvān doṣān vyapohati /
english: In the same way one will remove all the defects by offering oblations to the gods of the Raudra class.

sanskrit: etair daśaguṇair homī hy aṣṭādaśasu śāntiṣu //
english: Oblations are to be offered to these ten classes in eighteen propitiatory rites.

sanskrit: vaiṣṇavī śāntiraindrī ca brāhmī raudrī tathaiva ca / vāyavyā vāruṇī caiva kauverī bhārgavī tathā // prājāpatyā tathā tvāṣṭrī kaumārī vahnidevatā / mārudgaṇā ca gāndhārī śāntair nairṛtakī tathā // śāntirāṅgirasī yāmyā pārthivī sarvakāmadā /
english: The goddesses Vaiṣṇavī, Śānti, Aindrī, Brāhmī, Raudrī, Vāyavyā, Vāruṇī, Kauberī, Bhārgavī, Prājāpatyā, Tvāṣṭrī, Kaumārī, Vahnidevatā, Mārudgaṇā, Gāndhārī, Śānti Nairṛtakī, Śānti Āṅgirasī, Yāmyā and Pārthivī are the eighteen propitiatory items that yield all pleasures.

sanskrit: yastvāṃ mṛtyuriti hy etajjaptaṃ mṛtyuvināśanaṃ //
english: The recitation of the hymn yastvā mṛtyuḥ conquers death.

sanskrit: suparṇastveti hutvā ca bhujagair naiva bādhyate / indreṇa dattamityetat sarvakāmakarambhavet //
english: One will never be afflicted by serpents by offering oblations with the hymn suparṇastvā! The hymn indreṇa dattaṃ confers all the pleasures.

sanskrit: indreṇa dattamityetat sarvabādhāvināśanaṃ /
english: The hymn indreṇa dattam is capable of destroying all obstacles.

sanskrit: imā devīti mantraś ca sarvaśāntikaraḥ paraḥ // devā maruta ity etat sarvakāmakarambhavet /
english: The hymn imā devī is an excellent allappeasing hymn. The hymn devā maruta confers all the pleasures.

sanskrit: yamasya lokādityetat duḥsvapnaśamanamparaṃ //
english: The hymn yamasya lokāt is excellent for removing the effects of bad dreams.

sanskrit: indraś ca pañcabaṇijeti hutaṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanaṃ /
english: The hymn indraśca pañcavaṇijā is excellent for profit in trade.

sanskrit: kāmo me vājīti hutaṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanaṃ //
english: Oblations offered with the hymn kāmo me vāji increase the fortune of women.

sanskrit: tubhyameva javīmannityayutantu hutambhavet / agne gobhinna ity etat medhāvṛddhikaramparaṃ //
english: Oblation offered a lakh times with the repetition of the hymn tubhyameva jariman and with the hymn agne gobhir na will promote the intellect.

sanskrit: dhruvaṃ dhruveṇeti hutaṃ sthānalābhakaraṃ bhavet /
english: Offering oblation with the hymn dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa will ensure the acquisition of land.

sanskrit: alaktajīveti śunā kṛṣilābhakaraṃ bhavet // ahante bhagna ity etat bhavetsaubhāgyavardhanaṃ /
english: The repetition of the hymn alaktakajīva will ensure prosperous agriculture. The hymn ahaṃ te bhagna increases fortune.

sanskrit: ye me pāśas tathāpyetat bandhanāmnokṣakāraṇaṃ // śapantvahanniti ripūn nāśayeddhomajāpyataḥ /
english: The hymn ye mepāśāḥ secures release from bondage. Oblation offered with the repetition of the hymn śapatvahan destroys enemies.

sanskrit: tvamuttamamitītyetadyaśobuddhivivardhanaṃ //
english: The hymn tvamuttamam is capable of increasing fame and intellect.

sanskrit: yathā mṛgamatītyetat strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanaṃ /
english: The hymn yathā mṛgamatī increases the good fortune of women.

sanskrit: yena cehadidañcaiva garbhalābhakaraṃ bhavet //
english: The hymn yena cehadiśaṃ is advantageous for conception.

sanskrit: ayante yonirityetat putralābhakaraṃ bhavet /
english: The hymn ayaṃ te yoniḥ is favourable for progeny.

sanskrit: śivaḥ śivābhirityetat bhavetsaubhāgyavardhanaṃ //
english: The hymn śivaḥ śivābhiḥ increases good fortune.

sanskrit: vṛhaspatir naḥ paripātu pathi svastyayanaṃ bhavet /
english: The repetition of the hymn bṛhaspatirnaḥ paripātu secures safety on the journey.

sanskrit: muñcāmi tveti kathitamapamṛtyunivāraṇaṃ //
english: The hymn muñcāmi tvā is said to ward off untimely death.

sanskrit: atharvaśiraso 'dhyetā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate /
english: One who masters the atharvaśiras becomes free from all sins.

sanskrit: prādhānyena tu mantrāṇāṃ kiñcit karma taveritaṃ //
english: have described to you some procedures relating to some important hymns.

sanskrit: vṛkṣāṇāṃ yajñiyānāntu samidhaḥ prathamaṃ haviḥ /
english: The first material for oblations is the twigs of trees suitable for such rites.

sanskrit: akṣatāni tilāś caiva dadhikṣīre ca bhārgava / darbhāstathaiva dūrvāś ca vilvāni kamalāni ca // śāntipuṣṭikarāṇyāhurdravyāṇyetāni sarvaśaḥ /
english: O Bhārgava! Clarified butter, rice, white mustard, unbroken rice, sesamum, curd, milk, darbha grass, dūrvā grass, bilva leaves and lotuses are always said to be the materials that promote peace and prosperity.

sanskrit: tailaṅkaṇāni dharmajña rājikā rudhiraṃ viṣaṃ //
english: O Knower of righteousness! Mustard oil, blood, poison, twigs of thorny trees should be used in magic incantations.

sanskrit: samidhaḥ kaṇṭakopetā abhicāreṣu yojayet /
english: Sam. ..0.b. See note above. Could not be traced. Could not be traced.

sanskrit: ārṣaṃ vai daivataṃ chando viniyogajña ācaret //
english: Could not be traced. AV. ..a. Tait.

sanskrit: śrīsūktaṃ prativedañca jñeyaṃ lakṣmīvivardhanaṃ /
english: The śrīsūkta of each Veda is known to be capable of increasing fortune.

sanskrit: hiraṇyavarṇā hariṇīmṛcaḥ pañcadaśa śriyaḥ //
english: The fifteen hymns beginning with hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīṃ are considered to be conferring fortune.

sanskrit: ratheṣvakṣeṣu vājeti catasro yajuṣi śriyaḥ /
english: The four hymns ratheṣvakṣeṣu vṛṣabha in the Yajur Veda are said to confer fortune.

sanskrit: srāvantīyaṃ tathā sāma śrīsūktaṃ sāmavedake // śriyaṃ dhātarmayi dhehi prāktamātharvaṇe tathā /
english: The Sāma hymns srāvantīyaṃ is the śrīsūkta in the Sāmaveda. In the same way, the hymn śriyaṃ dhātamayi dhehi in the Atharvaveda is said to be conferring fortune.

sanskrit: śrīsūktaṃ yo japedbhaktyā hutvā śrīstasya vai bhavet //
english: One who repeats the śrīsūkta with devotion and offers oblation gets fortune.

sanskrit: padmāni cātha vilvāni hutvājyaṃ vā tilān śriyaḥ /
english: One will get fortune by offering oblations of lotuses, bilva leaves, clarified butter and sesamum.

sanskrit: ekantu pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ prativedantu sarvadaṃ //
english: The puruṣasūkta is the same for each one of the Vedas. It gives everything.

sanskrit: sūktena ddadyānniṣpāpo hy ekaikayā jalāñjaliṃ /
english: If libation of water is presented with the recitation of each one of the hymns, it will make one free from sin.

sanskrit: snāta ekaikayā puṣpaṃ viṣṇordatvāghahā bhavet //
english: One will destroy his sins by offering flowers to Viṣṇu with each one of the hymns after bathing.

sanskrit: snāta ekaikayā datvā phalaṃ syāt sarvakāmabhāk /
english: One would get all the pleasures by giving away a fruit with each one of the hymns after bathing.

sanskrit: mahāpāpopapānto bhavejjaptvā tu pauruṣaṃ //
english: By the repetition of the Puruṣasūkta major and minor sins are destroyed.

sanskrit: kṛcchrair viśuddho japtvā ca hutvā snātvātha sarvabhāk /
english: One gets everything by repeating the kṛcchra hymns and offering oblations with them after becoming clean by bathing.

sanskrit: aṣṭādaśabhyaḥ śāntibhyastisro 'nyāḥ śāntayo varāḥ //
english: Three other appeasing hymns besides the eighteen appeasing hymns are excellent.

sanskrit: amṛtā cābhayavā saumyā sarvotpātavimardanāḥ /
english: Amṛtā, abhayā and saumyā destory all the calamities.

sanskrit: amṛtā sarvadavatyā abhayā brahmadaivatā //
english: Amṛtā is governed by all the gods. Abhayā is governed by Brahmā and Saumyā by all gods.

sanskrit: saumyā ca sarvadaivatyā ekā syātsarvakāmadā /
english: Any one of them will confer all the pleasures.

sanskrit: abhayāyā maṇiḥ kāryo varuṇasya bhṛgūttama //
english: O Foremost among Bhṛgus! The wristlet with the Varuṇa hymn is to be prepared for the abhayā appeasement.

sanskrit: śatakāṇḍo 'mṛtāyāś ca saumyāyāḥ śaṅkajo maṇiḥ /
english: Similarly śatakāṇḍa is for the wristlet for amṛtā and conch for saumyā.

sanskrit: taddaivatyās tathā mantrāḥ siddhau syānmaṇibandhanaṃ //
english: In order to accomplish the desired results the respective hymns of the deities should be used for the wristlets.

sanskrit: divyāntarīkṣabhaumādisamutpātārdanā imāḥ /
english: These are capable of destroying the calamities relating to the heavens, atmosphere and earth.

sanskrit: divyāntarīkṣabhaumantu adbhutaṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu //
english: Listen to me! shall describe the supernatural events relating to the heavens, atmosphere and the earth.

sanskrit: graharkṣavaikṛtaṃ divyamāntarīkṣannibodha me /
english: You learn from me that the phenomena relating to the heavens are caused by the ruling asterisms of the day.

sanskrit: ulkāpātaś ca digdāhaḥ pariveśastathaiva ca // gandharvanagarañcaiva vṛṣṭiś ca vikṛtā ca yā / carasthirabhavaṃ bhūmau bhūkampamapi bhūmijaṃ //
english: Those of the sky are the fall of a meteor, scorching glow in the directions, the halo around the sun or moon, the appearance of fairy towns and rains. The phenomena relating to the earth are the extraordinary events affecting the movable and immovable things and earthquake.

sanskrit: saptāhābhyanatare vṛṣṭāvadbhutaṃ bhayakṛdbhavet /
english: The portent will not bear any fruit if it rains within seven days.

sanskrit: śāntiṃ vinā tribhirvaṣair adbhutaṃ bhayakṛdbhavet //
english: A portent without any appeasement within three years is very dangerous.

sanskrit: devatārcāḥ pranṛtyanti vepante prajvalanti ca / āraṭhanti ca rodanti prasvidyante hasanti ca // arcāvikāropaśamo 'bhyarcya hutvā prajāpateḥ /
english: The images of gods will dance, shake, glow, shout, weep, perspire and laugh. These are portents. The changes in the images can be pacified by worshipping Lord Prajāpati Brahmā and offering oblations.

sanskrit: anagnirdīpyate yatra rāṣṭre ca bhṛśanisvanaṃ // na dīpyate cendhanavāṃstadrāṣṭraṃ pāḍyate nṛpaiḥ /
english: When there is blaze in a country without fire, with loud noise and without fuel that burns, that country will be tormented by kings.

sanskrit: agnivaikṛtyaśamanamagnimantraiś ca bhārgava //
english: O Son of Bhṛgu! The change in the fire is appeased with the hymns of Fire god.

sanskrit: akāle phalitā vṛkṣāḥ kṣīraṃ raktaṃ sravanti ca / vṛkṣotpātapraśamanaṃ śivaṃ pūjya ca kārayet //
english: When the trees bear fruit out of season, ooze out milk and blood, one should do the appeasing rite for the portents after worshipping Lord Śiva.

sanskrit: ativṛṣṭiranāvṛṣṭirdurbhikṣāyobhayaṃ mataṃ /
english: Both excessive rains and draught are considered to give rise to famine.

sanskrit: anṛtau tridinārabdhavṛṣṭirjñeyā bhayāya hi //
english: Rain occurring consecutively for three days out of season is known to be a portent of danger.

sanskrit: vṛṣṭivaikṛtyanāśaḥ syātparjaṇyendvarkapūjanāt /
english: The change in the pattern of rain is nullified by the worship of Parjanya Rain god, Moon and Sun.

sanskrit: nagarādapasarpante samīpamupayānti ca // nadyo hradapraśravaṇā virasāś ca bhavanti ca / śalilāśayavaikṛtye japtavyo vāruṇo manuḥ //
english: If rivers recede from the cities or come near them, if they flow gushing forth or get dried up, then the Varuṇa hymn should be recited as also in the case of deterioration in the state of the reservoirs.

sanskrit: akālaprasavā nāryaḥ kālato vāprajās tathā /
english: The women may deliver prematurely or may not deliver at the appropriate time.

sanskrit: vikṛtaprasavāś caiva yugmaprasavanādikaṃ // strīṇāṃ prasavavaikṛtye strīviprādiṃ prapūjayet /
english: They may deliver children with deformities or deliver twins etc. One should worship the women and brahmins in the case of such deviations in the delivery as above.

sanskrit: vaḍavā hastinī gaurvā yadi yugmaṃ prasūyate // vijātyaṃ vikṛtaṃ vāpi ṣaḍbhirmāsair mriyeta vai /
english: If a mare or sheelephant or cow gives birth to twins or to deformed younger or to ones different from the species, it will die within six months.

sanskrit: vikṛtaṃ vā prasūyante paracakrabhayaṃ bhavet //
english: In the case of deformed youngs there will be danger from hostile forces.

sanskrit: homaḥ prasūtivaikṛtye japo viprādipūjanaṃ /
english: The recitation and oblation as well as worship of brahmins should be done in such cases.

sanskrit: yāni yānānyayuktāni yuktāni na vahanti ca // ākāśe tūryanādāś ca mahadbhayamupasthitaṃ /
english: If vehicles run without being yoked to steeds, if vehicles yoked to steeds do not run, or trumpet sounds are heard in the sky, then it forebodes great impending danger.

sanskrit: praviśanti yadā grāmamāraṇyā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ // araṇyaṃ yānti vā grāmyāḥ jalaṃ yānti sthalodbhavāḥ / sthalaṃ vā jalajā yānti rājadvārādike śivāḥ // pradoṣe kukkuṭo vāse śivā cārkodaye bhavet / gṛhaṅkapotaḥ praviśet kravyāhā mūrdhni līyate //
